title: Technical Specialist - MS, Security
description:
**Make an impact with NTT DATA**
Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.
  
  
**Your day at NTT DATA**
Provides technical support to field engineers, technicians, and product support personnel who are diagnosing, troubleshooting, repairing, and debugging complex electro/mechanical equipment, computer systems, complex software, or networked and/or wireless systems.
  
  
Responds to situations where first-line product support has failed to isolate or fix problems in malfunctioning equipment or software. Reports design, reliability, and maintenance problems or bugs to design engineering/software engineering. May be involved in customer installation and training.
  
  
Provides support to customers/users where the product is highly technical or sophisticated in nature.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**
The MS Engineer is responsible for providing a service to clients by proactively identifying and resolving technical incidents and problems. Through preemptive service incident and resolution activities, as well as product reviews, operational improvements, operational practices, and quality assurance this role will maintain a high level of service to clients. Their primary objective is to ensure zero missed service level agreement (SLA) conditions .The MS Engineer s responsible for managing tickets of low to high complexity.
  
  
**Key Roles and Responsibilities:**

* Ensure that assigned infrastructure at the client site is configured, installed, tested, and operational
* Perform necessary checks, apply monitoring tools and respond to alerts
* Identify problems and errors prior to or when it occurs and log all such incidents in a timely manner with the required level of detail
* Assist in analyzing, assigning, and escalating support calls
* Investigate third line support calls assigned and identify the root cause of incidents and problems
* Report and escalate issues to 3rd party vendors if necessary
* Provide onsite technical support to clients and provide field engineering services to clients
* Conduct a monthly random review of incidents and service requests, analyze and recommend improvement in quality
* Provide continuous feedback to clients and affected parties and update all systems and/or portals as prescribed by NTT
* Proactively identify opportunities for work optimization including opportunities for automation of work

**Knowledge, Skills, and Attributes:**

* Ability to communicate and work across different cultures and social groups
* Ability to plan activities and projects well in advance, and takes into account possible changing circumstances
* Ability to maintain a positive outlook at work
* Ability to work well in a pressurized environment
* Ability to work hard and put in longer hours when it is necessary
* Ability to apply active listening techniques such as paraphrasing the message to confirm understanding, probing for further relevant information, and refraining from interrupting
* Ability to adapt to changing circumstances
* Ability to place clients at the forefront of all interactions, understanding their requirements, and creating a positive client experience throughout the total client journey

**Academic Qualifications**

* Advanced diploma, degree, or relevant qualification in IT/Computing (or demonstrated equivalent work experience)

**Required Experience:**

* Demonstrated work experience
* Demonstrated experience required in Engineering function within a medium to large ICT organization
* Demonstrated experience of Managed Services
* Demonstrated working knowledge of ITIL processes
* Demonstrated experience working with vendors and/or 3rd parties

**Workplace type:**
**About NTT DATA**
NTT DATA is a $30+ billion trusted global innovator of business and technology services. We serve 75% of the Fortune Global 100 and are committed to helping clients innovate, optimize and transform for long-term success. We invest over $3.6 billion each year in R&D to help organizations and society move confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have diverse experts in more than 50 countries and a robust partner ecosystem of established and start-up companies. Our services include business and technology consulting, data and artificial intelligence, industry solutions, as well as the development, implementation and management of applications, infrastructure, and connectivity. We are also one of the leading providers of digital and AI infrastructure in the world. NTT DATA is part of NTT Group and headquartered in Tokyo.
  
  
**Equal Opportunity Employer**
NTT DATA is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer with a global culture that embraces diversity. We are committed to providing an environment free of unfair discrimination and harassment. We do not discriminate based on age, race, colour, gender, sexual orientation, religion, nationality, disability, pregnancy, marital status, veteran status, or any other protected category. Join our growing global team and accelerate your career with us. Apply today.

title: Technical Support Engineer Associate
description:
This role has been designed as 'Hybrid' with a requirement that you will work on average 2 days per week from an HPE office.
  
  
**Who We Are**
Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Aruba**
is an HPE Company, and a leading provider of next-generation network access solutions for the mobile enterprise. Helping some of the largest companies in the world modernize their networks to meet the demands of a digital future, Aruba is redefining the “Intelligent Edge” – and creating new customer experiences across intelligent spaces and digital workspaces. Join us redefine what’s next for you.
  
  
**Job Family Definition**
The job family spans across multiple engineering disciplines. Work consists of designing, developing, analyzing, troubleshooting and debugging systems, software and solutions for research and/or research development of product, services, and solutions for HPE’s portfolio. Requires a broad knowledge and application of engineering disciplines, methodologies and tools.
  
  
Job Family Definition for Executive Levels only: Directs and manages a diverse team of engineering professionals performing research, development, design and/or implementation of products, services, solutions for the company’s portfolio. Responsible for creating and communicating technical strategy within the organization and/or across the function.
  
  
**Management Level Definition**
Contributes to assignments of limited scope by applying technical concepts and theoretical knowledge acquired through specialized training, education, or previous experience. Acts as team member by providing information, analysis and recommendations in support of team efforts. Exercises independent judgment within defined parameters.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* The L1 TAC Aruba Switching Engineer serves as the first line of technical support for customers using HPE Aruba enterprise switching solutions. This role focuses on initial troubleshooting, issue isolation, basic configuration validation, and case triage for Aruba AOS-CX and AOS-S platforms. The engineer ensures accurate problem identification, SLA adherence, and smooth escalation to L2/L3 teams.

**What You Need To Bring**
**Customer Case Management**

* Act as first point of technical contact for Aruba Switching customers via phone, web, and email.
* Create, prioritize, and manage TAC cases in HPE case management systems.
* Accurately determine issue severity (Sev 1–4) and apply correct response procedures.
* Maintain timely customer communication with professional case updates.
* Ensure proper documentation of symptoms, topology, logs, and troubleshooting steps.

**Technical Troubleshooting – Switching Focus**
**Supported Products**

* Aruba CX Series (6200, 6300, 6400, 8100, 8320, 8360, 8400)
* Aruba AOS-S Switches (2530, 2540, 2930F/M)
* Aruba Central – Switching (basic operations)
* VSF (basic), VSX (awareness level)

Core Troubleshooting Areas
  
  

* Layer 2
* VLANs, Trunking (802.1Q)
* STP / RSTP / MSTP (basic)
* MAC address table behavior
* Port-security
* Layer 3 (Foundational)
* Static routing
* Basic OSPF understanding (awareness)
* Default gateways, ARP behavior
* Power & Hardware
* PoE issues
* Interface errors (CRC, drops)
* Transceivers, cabling diagnostics
* System Operations
* Boot issues
* Image upgrade / downgrade support
* Configuration backup & restore
* Log collection and basic analysis

**Diagnostic & Escalation Responsibilities**

* Collect and validate:
* show tech, show logging, interface outputs, VSF/stack logs
* Follow standard runbooks and troubleshooting workflows.
* Perform impact analysis and identify when immediate escalation is required.
* Escalate clean, structured cases to \*\*L2/L3 TAC with:
* Reproducible steps
* Logs
* Network topology
* Customer impact summary\*\*

**Knowledge & Process Adherence**

* Use and contribute to HPE Knowledge Base (KBA).
* Follow HPE support processes, compliance policies, and quality standards.
* Participate in:
* Weekly enablement sessions
* Product update briefings
* Technical readiness programs

**Required Technical Skills (L1 Level)**
Networking Fundamentals
  
  

* TCP/IP, OSI Model
* Subnetting & IP addressing
* VLANs, Access vs Trunk ports
* STP fundamentals
* Basic routing concepts

**Switching Fundamentals**

* Aruba AOS-CX & AOS-S CLI (basic commands)
* Interface configuration
* VLAN creation & assignment
* PoE configuration basics
* Config save, restore, and image management

**Operating Systems & Tools**

* Basic Linux & Windows troubleshooting
* CLI access via SSH/Telnet/Console
* Log interpretation
* Case management tools (HPE ServiceNow, internal TAC tools)

**Soft Skills & Professional Competencies**

* Strong customer communication & empathy
* Ability to work in high-severity outage situations
* Analytical and structured troubleshooting mindset
* Attention to detail and documentation discipline
* Ability to work in rotational shifts
* Team-oriented with strong collaboration skills

**Education & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, Networking, or related field
* 2 - 4+ years of experience in:
* o Network operations
* o NOC
* o TAC support
* o Field networking

**Preferred Certifications (Nice To Have)**

* ACSA / ACSP
* CCNA / Network+
* ITIL Foundation

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* First Contact Resolution (FCR)
* Case Quality Score
* SLA Adherence
* Escalation Accuracy
* Customer Satisfaction (CSAT)
* Documentation Quality

**Accessibility**
HPE is committed to creating an inclusive and accessible workplace and encourages applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities. If you believe you require accommodation during any stage of the application or interview process, please submit your request by completing our secure form linked here.
  
  
Note: This option is reserved for applicants needing assistance/reasonable accommodation related to a disability.
  
  
**What We Can Offer You**
**Health & Wellbeing**
We strive to provide our team members and their loved ones with a comprehensive suite of benefits that supports their physical, financial and emotional wellbeing.
  
  
**Personal & Professional Development**
We also invest in your career because the better you are, the better we all are. We have specific programs catered to helping you reach any career goals you have — whether you want to become a knowledge expert in your field or apply your skills to another division.
  
  
**Unconditional Inclusion**
We are unconditionally inclusive in the way we work and celebrate individual uniqueness. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good.
  
  
**Let's Stay Connected**
Follow @HPECareers on Instagram to see the latest on people, culture and tech at HPE.

title: Technology Services Engineer III
description:
**About Team**
Join Walmart Business Technology Services and help ensure the reliability, availability, and operational excellence of platforms that power business customers globally. Our team serves as a critical link between engineering, product, and business operations, helping resolve complex challenges and maintain exceptional customer experiences.
  
  
You will work with modern observability tools, cloud technologies, and automation solutions while contributing to the stability and continuous improvement of large-scale enterprise systems.
  
  
What You'll Do· Provide L2 technical support for production and non-production environments, managing escalated incidents, service requests, and problem records end-to-end.
  
  

* Troubleshoot and resolve complex issues spanning applications, infrastructure, and system integrations; engage engineering and product teams as required to drive resolution.
* Monitor system health metrics and platform telemetry, proactively identify risks, and implement corrective or preventive actions before they impact business operations.
* Conduct root cause analyses (RCA) on critical incidents; document findings, corrective actions, and lessons learned in the team knowledge base.
* Lead change management activities including pre/post-implementation validation, stakeholder coordination, and rollback planning for production changes.
* Mentor and upskill L1 support associates; facilitate structured knowledge transfer to reduce recurring escalations.
* Define and improve support processes, runbooks, and automation opportunities to reduce MTTR and increase team efficiency.
* Collaborate across time zones with global engineering, product, and business teams to ensure continuity of service.
* Leverage AI-assisted observability and anomaly detection tools to accelerate incident identification and reduce noise in alerting pipelines.
* Contribute to the evaluation and adoption of AI/ML-powered support automation — intelligent ticket routing, auto-remediation workflows, and predictive incident detection.
* Collaborate with engineering teams on integrating AI-driven features into production platforms, providing operational feedback to improve model reliability and service stability.

What You'll Bring· 3–5 years of experience in application or platform support, with demonstrated L2 or escalation-tier ownership.
  
  

* Strong troubleshooting capability across distributed systems — applications, APIs, databases, and infrastructure.
* Solid understanding of ITIL practices: incident, problem, change, and knowledge management.
* Proficiency in reading logs, traces, and monitoring dashboards (e.g., Splunk, Grafana, Dynatrace, or equivalent).
* Ability to write or interpret scripts (Python, Shell, or PowerShell) for diagnostic or automation purposes.
* Experience with production change validation and rollback procedures in high-availability environments.
* Clear technical communication — able to write precise RCAs, runbooks, and stakeholder updates.
* Awareness of how AI/ML models are deployed and monitored in production environments, including familiarity with model inference pipelines or AI-powered SaaS tooling.

Preferred Qualifications· Exposure to cloud platforms (GCP, Azure, or AWS) and containerized workloads (Kubernetes/Docker).
  
  

* Familiarity with eCommerce or retail platforms and related business workflows.
* SQL proficiency for querying operational databases during incident triage.
* Experience supporting CI/CD pipelines and understanding of software release processes.
* Exposure to AI/ML platforms or LLM-based tooling (generative AI features in eCommerce, recommendation engines, or AI-assisted support tools).
* Experience supporting or monitoring AI-powered application features in a production environment.
* Curiosity and willingness to adopt AI-native workflows for diagnostics, knowledge management, and incident response.
* ITIL Foundation certification or equivalent.

**Required SkillsTechnical**

* Incident Management & Troubleshooting (L2/L3 support)
* Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and Problem Management
* Application Support & Production Monitoring
* ITIL Framework / Service Management
* Knowledge Base Documentation
* Cross-functional Collaboration (Engineering & Product teams)
* Change Management & Validation

AI & Emerging Technology
  
  

* AI-Assisted Development Tooling (GitHub Copilot, Wibey, or equivalent)
* Prompt Engineering — crafting effective prompts for code generation, summarization, and analysis

Optional SkillsTechnical
  
  

* SQL / Database querying
* Scripting (Python, Shell, or PowerShell) for support automation
* Cloud platform familiarity (GCP, Azure, or AWS)
* Observability tooling (Splunk, Grafana, Dynatrace, or equivalent)
* Agile / Scrum exposure
* Experience with eCommerce or Retail platforms
* Mentoring / L1 team coaching

AI & Emerging Technology
  
  

* Generative AI / LLM API fundamentals (OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Vertex AI)
* AI/ML feature integration in production applications
* Vector search & embeddings (semantic search, RAG patterns)
* Responsible AI practices — bias awareness, output validation, graceful fallback
* AI agent workflows and multi-step orchestration (LangChain, LlamaIndex, or equivalent)

**About Walmart Global Tech**
Imagine working in an environment where one line of code can make life easier for hundreds of millions of people. That’s what we do at Walmart Global Tech. **Benefits**
Beyond our great compensation package, you can receive incentive awards for your performance. Other great perks include a host of best-in-class benefits maternity and parental leave, PTO, health benefits, and much more.
  
  
Belonging
  
  
We aim to create a culture where every associate feels valued for who they are, rooted in respect for the individual. Our goal is to foster a sense of belonging, to create opportunities for all our associates, customers and suppliers, and to be a Walmart for everyone.

That means understanding, respecting and valuing unique styles, experiences, identities, ideas and opinions – while being inclusive of all people.

title: PLM Operations & Maintenance Engineer (Teamcenter / 3DEXPERIENCE)
description:
**PLM Operations & Maintenance Engineer (Teamcenter / 3DEXPERIENCE)**

**Location: Chennai & Hyderabad**

**Job Overview**

We are seeking an experienced
**PLM Operations & Maintenance Engineer**
to support, maintain, and optimize enterprise PLM environments, with a primary focus on Teamcenter and 3DEXPERIENCE (3DE) platforms. The ideal candidate will be responsible for ensuring system stability, resolving technical issues, supporting users, and collaborating with engineering and development teams to continuously improve PLM operations.

**Key Responsibilities**

**System Monitoring & Maintenance**

• Monitor the performance and health of Teamcenter environments, including RAC (Rich Application Client) and Active Workspace (AWC).

• Perform routine system maintenance activities such as service monitoring, release deployments, log reviews, temporary file cleanup, and system health checks.

• Ensure proper functioning of standard and customized PLM components, integrations, and services.

• Manage and resolve support tickets within defined SLA timelines using ITSM tools.

**Troubleshooting & Issue Resolution**

• Investigate and resolve user-reported issues related to data integrity, Teamcenter functionality, custom-developed modules and utilities, and integrated engineering applications such as CATIA, NX, and SolidWorks.

• Analyze application logs, server logs, and system errors to identify root causes.

• Collaborate with development teams to implement permanent fixes and enhancements for complex issues.

**User Support & Training**

• Provide remote and end-user support for PLM-related queries and technical issues.

• Conduct user demonstrations, knowledge-sharing sessions, and training workshops.

• Create and maintain user guides, training materials, and process documentation for new features and business processes.

**Collaboration & Continuous Improvement**

• Work closely with Engineering, Business, and Development teams to understand operational requirements and improve system performance.

• Participate in PLM enhancement, customization, migration, and integration projects.

• Provide operational insights and recommendations to improve system reliability and user experience.

**Documentation & Reporting**

• Maintain comprehensive documentation covering system configurations, maintenance activities, troubleshooting procedures, and upgrade/deployment records.

• Generate periodic reports on system performance, incident trends, risks, and improvement opportunities.

**Required Qualifications**

**Education**

• Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.

**Experience**

• 5–7+ years of experience in PLM system administration, support, operations, or maintenance.

• Minimum 3 years of hands-on experience with Siemens Teamcenter.

• Experience supporting, administering, or maintaining 3DEXPERIENCE (3DE) platforms.

• Experience working in engineering product development environments preferred.

**Technical Skills**

**Teamcenter & PLM**

• Strong understanding of Teamcenter architecture, including server-side and client-side components.

• Hands-on experience with RAC, Active Workspace (AWC), BMIDE, and Teamcenter OOTB utilities.

• Knowledge of engineering change management processes including ECR, ECN, DA, and PR.

**Database & SQL**

• Strong SQL skills with experience querying and troubleshooting Teamcenter databases.

• Experience with Oracle and/or Microsoft SQL Server.

**Operating Systems & Scripting**

• Good understanding of Linux and Windows environments.

• Experience with system administration, troubleshooting, and automation.

• Proficiency in Shell scripting and Batch (BAT) scripting.

**Programming & Customization**

• Working knowledge of Java, C++, and JavaScript.

• Ability to understand, troubleshoot, and maintain custom-developed PLM components.

**3DEXPERIENCE**

• Hands-on experience with 3DEXPERIENCE administration and support.

• Experience in environment monitoring, maintenance, user issue resolution, and integration with engineering tools, especially CATIA.

**Soft Skills**

• Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

• Ability to work effectively with cross-functional and global teams.

• Self-motivated with a continuous learning mindset.

• Adaptable to changing technologies and business requirements.

title: Operation Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
KONE is a global leader in the elevator and escalator industry, making people’s journeys safe, convenient, and reliable with smart and sustainable People Flow®. In a world where cities are constantly evolving and more and more people choose to live in them, we at KONE stand with one clear aim: to shape the future of cities. We make urban life more vibrant and livable. And we do it by enabling safe, sustainable, and effortless people flow for all. We help cities leave a positive mark on the planet - for the next century and beyond. We shape the future of cities.
  
  
**KONE Technology and Innovation Unit (KTI)**
is where the magic happens at KONE. It's where we combine the physical world – escalators and elevators – with smart and connected digital systems. We are changing and improving the way billions of people move within buildings every day. We are on a mission to expand and develop new digital solutions that are based on emerging technologies.
  
  
**KONE R&D**
brings together top talent from different disciplines into an industry-leading product and technology organization. We thrive in solving complex customer challenges, connecting legacy with the latest technologies across hardware and software engineering. In fact, roughly half of our R&D roles are in software. Agile ways of working mean that we are better able to meet our customers’ rapidly evolving needs for speed and innovation, in a global environment.
  
  
R&D unit in KTI is responsible for developing digital services at KONE. It’s the development engine for our Digital Services such as KONE 24/7 Connected Services, Office Flow and Partnership Ecosystem. Our common goal at KONE is to keep the end users safe and people flow uninterrupted. KONE moves 2 billion people every day and that means our services can really make cities better places to live
  
  
We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced
**Operations Engineer**
to join our Solution Operations team. This role focuses on ensuring system stability, driving operational excellence, and supporting end-to-end incident management across multiple platforms. Founded in 2004 and headquartered in Chennai, the company has expanded into multiple major metropolitan cities, serving over 4,000 clients across diverse industries. Its offerings include Internet Leased Lines, VoIP Solutions, Cloud Telephony, Virtual Numbers, SIP Internet Calling, custom CRM integrations, and advanced spam monitoring and CNAM services. Pulse Telesystems is a trusted telecom partner for top enterprises such as Zoho, MGM Healthcare, Larsen & Toubro, CEAT, India Cements Ltd., and PVR Cinemas, helping them improve performance and reliability. Team members join a growing organization focused on innovation, service quality, and long-term client relationships.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a highly proactive, disciplined and accountable Support Shift Lead to own day-to-day support operations during an assigned shift. The person will actively monitor tickets and incidents from logging through resolution, enforce response and resolution SLAs, coordinate the team, and communicate clearly with stakeholders. This role requires a hands-on leader who follows up relentlessly, escalates risks early, maintains accurate updates, and holds the team to agreed processes and commitments.

**Key Responsibilities**

1.  Support Ticket & Incident Ownership

●      Monitor the support queue continuously and ensure every issue has a clear owner, priority, next action and target time.

●      Track tickets end-to-end—from acknowledgement and triage to troubleshooting, resolution, validation and closure.

●      Review ageing, overdue, stalled, reopened and high-priority tickets; drive action plans to prevent avoidable delays.

●      Enforce response, update and resolution SLAs; escalate potential breaches before they occur.

●      Coordinate major incidents, ensure timely technical escalation, and maintain an accurate incident timeline and handover notes.

2.  Team Leadership & Performance

●      Allocate and rebalance work based on severity, skills, workload and urgency; confirm ownership of every active issue.

●      Run shift kick-offs, periodic queue reviews and end-of-shift handovers.

●      Set clear expectations, monitor productivity and quality, and address missed commitments promptly and fairly.

●      Coach team members on troubleshooting, ticket hygiene, customer handling and escalation discipline.

●      Identify repeated performance gaps, document facts, and raise persistent issues to the Support Manager.

3.  Proactive Communication & Stakeholder Management

●      Provide timely, concise and factual updates to customers, internal teams, management and relevant stakeholders.

●      Communicate impact, current status, actions underway, blockers, ownership and the next update time—without waiting to be chased.

●      Alert stakeholders early when an issue risks breaching SLA or affecting business operations.

●      Coordinate with engineering, infrastructure, vendors and other teams until dependencies are resolved.

●      Ensure no critical issue goes silent and no shift ends without a documented handover of open risks.

4.  Process, Reporting & Continuous Improvement

●      Maintain accurate ticket records, incident notes, escalation details, workaround steps and resolution summaries.

●      Prepare shift reports covering ticket volumes, SLA performance, open/overdue incidents, major risks and follow-up owners.

●      Identify recurring incidents and recommend problem-management actions, knowledge-base updates and process improvements.

●      Follow support procedures, access controls, customer communication standards and incident-management policies.

●      Use ticketing and monitoring tools consistently; keep dashboards and operational trackers current.

Required Skills & Competencies

●      Strong ownership, urgency, discipline and follow-through; comfortable enforcing standards and holding people accountable.

●      Excellent written and verbal communication; able to provide clear updates to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

●      Sound incident triage, prioritisation, escalation and problem-solving skills.

●      Experience coordinating a support/helpdesk/service desk/NOC/application support team.

●      Strong organisation skills, attention to detail and confidence handling competing priorities.

●      Ability to remain calm, firm and professional during high-severity incidents or customer escalations.

●      Working knowledge of SLAs, ticket lifecycle, incident management, shift handovers and operational reporting.

Experience & Qualifications

●      Typically 3–6 years of experience in technical support, IT operations, service desk, application support or a related environment.

●      At least 1–2 years in a team-lead, shift-lead, senior support or incident-coordination capacity preferred.

●      Experience with ticketing tools such as Jira Service Management, ServiceNow, Zendesk, Freshservice or similar.

●      Exposure to monitoring dashboards, SLA reports, escalation matrices and knowledge-base processes.

●      ITIL Foundation or equivalent incident/service-management training is an advantage.

Success Measures (KPIs)

●      SLA compliance for first response, stakeholder updates and resolution.

●      Reduction in overdue, ageing and unassigned tickets.

●      Quality and timeliness of incident communications and shift handovers.

●      Ticket documentation completeness and resolution quality.

●      Escalation timeliness, repeat-incident trends and customer/stakeholder feedback.

●      Team adherence to process, ownership and agreed action deadlines.

The Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is firm but fair, highly visible in the support queue, and proactive by default. They do not wait for reminders, allow issues to drift, or accept vague status updates. They establish clear owners and deadlines, communicate risks early, verify that actions are completed, and maintain professional accountability without resorting to disrespectful or aggressive behaviour.

Application Note

* Applicants should highlight examples where they improved SLA performance, managed critical incidents, coordinated a support team, prevented escalations through proactive communication, or reduced ticket backlog.
* Please share the resume to hr@pulse.in/ samuel@pulse.in

title: Operations Specialist
description:
**About the Role**

OEC is in the middle of a multi-year journey to modernise its infrastructure and applications, transforming how we build, deploy, and operate software at global scale. The Operations Specialist (L2) is a core member of the Monitoring Team within the Enterprise Operations Team, responsible for the configuration, maintenance, and continuous improvement of OEC’s observability stack, primarily powered by Datadog.

In this role you will own L2 alert triage, incident response, dashboard development, and service onboarding — contributing to the team’s tooling standards and best practices. You will also handle day-to-day server monitoring, infrastructure support, and service management tasks that keep OEC’s global platforms running reliably.

**Key Responsibilities & Duties (essential to the job)**

**Monitoring & alerting**

* Design, configure, and maintain Datadog monitors, composite alerts, and notification channels for production and non-production environments.
* Own the L2 alert triage process — investigate, diagnose, and resolve escalated alerts from L1, ensuring timely root cause identification.
* Tune alert thresholds and suppression rules to minimise noise and reduce false positive rates.
* Manage SLO (Service Level Objective) definitions, tracking, and reporting across assigned services.
* Participate in the on-call rotation for critical monitoring alerts and P1/P2 incident response.

**Dashboards & observability**

* Build and maintain Datadog dashboards covering infrastructure health, application performance, log analytics, and business KPIs.
* Configure and manage Datadog APM (Application Performance Monitoring), distributed tracing, and error tracking for key services.
* Implement and manage log ingestion pipelines, parsing rules, and log-based monitors.
* Develop and maintain Synthetic monitors (API and browser tests) for uptime and user experience validation.

**Service onboarding & integrations**

* Onboard new services and infrastructure components into the Datadog monitoring framework in collaboration with DevOps, Cloud, and Engineering teams.
* Configure and maintain Datadog integrations with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Rackspace), Kubernetes, containerised workloads, and third-party tools.
* Support the migration of legacy monitoring tooling (SCOM, Dynatrace, Grafana, Prometheus, Pingdom, Apigee, Redgate, IDERA) into Datadog.

**Incident response & runbooks**

* Act as L2 escalation point during incidents — perform deep-dive investigations using metrics, logs, traces, and dashboards.
* Create, maintain, and improve runbooks for common alert scenarios, incident response procedures, and post-incident remediation steps.
* Contribute to post-incident reviews, documenting root cause findings and identifying monitoring gaps to prevent recurrence.
* Alerts system owners, stakeholders, and management of degraded system status and Priority 1 and Priority 2 incidents; issues tickets for incident and problem escalation.

**AI & automation**

* Leverage Datadog AI capabilities including Watchdog, anomaly detection, outlier detection, and Bits AI to improve proactive issue detection.
* Implement forecast-based monitors for capacity management (CPU, memory, disk).
* Use AI-based alert correlation and deduplication features to reduce alert fatigue.
* Contribute to automation of repetitive monitoring tasks using Datadog’s API and scripting tools.

**Standards & governance**

* Adhere to and actively contribute to monitoring standards, tagging strategies, and naming conventions.
* Participate in regular alert quality reviews, dashboard audits, and SLO compliance checks.
* Maintain accurate documentation of monitoring configurations, integrations, and architectural decisions.
* Creates and maintains knowledge articles to be used internally and/or externally for training, best practices, solutions, or processes relating to applications, environments, and related technologies.

**Infrastructure operations & support**

* Analyses and troubleshoots Microsoft and UNIX/Linux server configurations and processes.
* Performs moderately complex database administration.
* Monitors data centre networks, infrastructure bandwidth, application health, servers, and other infrastructure; coordinates and communicates with vendors.
* Diagnoses and researches (using knowledge base) application incidents, monitoring alerts, and service requests; provides assistance and guidance to associate operations specialists.
* Adheres to all incident and service request processes and procedures in accordance with established Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
* Diagnoses, researches, and resolves Level-2 technical hardware and software incidents, monitoring alerts, and service requests.
* Works on ad-hoc projects to support Infrastructure Engineering or other departments, as requested.
* Demonstrates a flexible and adaptable approach to work and adjusts to shifts in priorities as the needs of the business change.
* Collaborates with DevOps, Cloud, and application teams to align monitoring coverage with service requirements.

**Education**

A bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline is required. In the absence of a degree, equivalent work experience directly related to the key responsibilities of the role will be considered as a substitute for the degree.

**Experience, Skills and Key Competencies**

At least 5+ years of experience in an infrastructure, DevOps, SRE, or monitoring engineering role is required, with hands-on experience in Datadog and working knowledge of cloud infrastructure and containerised environments.

Must also be able to demonstrate the following skills and abilities:

**Technical skills**

* Hands-on experience with Datadog — monitors, dashboards, APM, log management, SLOs, and synthetic monitoring.
* Solid understanding of cloud infrastructure (AWS required; Azure or GCP a plus) and containerised environments (Docker, Kubernetes).
* Familiarity with observability concepts: metrics, traces, and logs.
* Experience with at least one scripting language (Python, Bash, or PowerShell) for automation and tooling.
* Working knowledge of monitoring and alerting tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, Dynatrace, or similar platforms.
* Understanding of ITSM concepts and ticketing workflows (Jira, JSM, or ServiceNow).
* Good working knowledge of Microsoft and UNIX/Linux server configurations, Active Directory, and internet protocols (HTTP, FTP, DNS, IP, SSH).

**Soft skills & competencies**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to diagnose complex infrastructure issues under pressure.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills; able to produce runbooks and incident summaries for both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Collaborative team player who can work effectively across Engineering, DevOps, and Operations disciplines.
* Self-motivated with a continuous improvement mindset and a proactive approach to identifying and resolving issues before they escalate.
* Flexible and adaptable approach to work; able to adjust to shifts in priorities as the needs of the business change.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Datadog Fundamentals or Datadog APM certification (or actively working towards one).
* At least 2 year of experience with CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or Azure DevOps).
* Knowledge of network monitoring and distributed systems architecture.
* Exposure to ITIL or ITSM frameworks (Incident, Problem, and Change Management).
* Familiarity with Atlassian tools (Jira, JSM, Confluence) for documentation and ticket management.

**Special Position Requirements**

* Must be able to read, write, understand, and speak fluent English.
* Must be able to work flexible shifts including holidays and weekends, to provide support across locations and time zones.
* Must be able to participate in an on-call rotation for critical monitoring alerts and P1/P2 incident response.

title: IT Operations Administrator
description:
**Overview**
**Job Description:**
We don’t simply hire employees. We invest in them. When you work at Chatham, we empower you — offering professional development opportunities to help you grow in your career, no matter if you've been here for five months or 15 years. Chatham has worked hard to create a distinct work environment that values people, teamwork, integrity, and client service. You will have immediate opportunities to partner with talented subject matter experts, work on complex projects, and contribute to the value Chatham delivers every day.
  
  
**WHY CHATHAM**
We don’t simply hire employees — we invest in them. When you join Chatham, you are empowered with professional development opportunities designed to help you grow at every stage of your career, whether you’ve been here five months or fifteen years. You will have immediate opportunities to partner with talented subject-matter experts, contribute to complex projects, and deliver the kind of value our clients depend on every day.
  
  
**About The Team**
The IT Operations Team serves as the first point of contact for all technical issues across Chatham’s global organization. We partner closely with the Desktop Services, Infrastructure, Digital Workplace, and InfoSec teams to ensure that every end-user technical issue is resolved thoroughly and without delay. Our reach spans five continents, and the work we do every day keeps Chatham’s people productive and connected.
  
  
**Role Overview**
The IT Operations Administrator is a senior-level role within the IT Operations Team. In addition to handling a full scope of end-user support responsibilities, the Administrator serves as a technical leader and mentor for junior analysts, owns the administration and continuous improvement of Chatham’s ITSM platform, and acts as a key liaison between front-line support and senior IT stakeholders. This role demands a high degree of technical proficiency, sound judgment under pressure, and a genuine commitment to service excellence.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**End-User Support & Service Delivery**

* Serve as a primary point of contact for inbound technical inquiries via phone, secure chat, walk-up, and email, ensuring every interaction reflects Chatham’s commitment to world-class service.
* Apply advanced conversational and diagnostic techniques to rapidly identify root causes, build end-user trust, and resolve issues at first contact whenever possible.
* Take full ownership of complex or escalated tickets, coordinating across IT teams to drive issues to complete resolution.
* Proactively identify patterns in inbound inquiries and share insights with management to drive systemic improvements to IT services, operations, and policies.
* Document all end-user correspondence and technical actions clearly, concisely, and in accordance with established standards.

**Administration & Systems Ownership**

* Manage end-to-end IT administration for the Chennai location, including IT asset management, user provisioning, hardware and software support, vendor coordination, and workplace technology operations.
* Own the administration and ongoing improvement of Chatham’s ITSM solution, including ticket workflows, data integrity, reporting, and knowledge base content.
* Administer end-user account management, hardware inventory, software procurement, and related systems.
* Conduct regular audits to validate ticket data accuracy and overall ITSM hygiene.
* Deliver timely, accurate, and actionable operational data to IT leadership as needed.

**Mentorship & Team Development**

* Serve as a primary resource and mentor for IT Operations Analysts, actively advancing their technical knowledge, troubleshooting skills, and professional development.
* Provide guidance on escalation decisions and help analysts build confidence in handling complex support scenarios.
* Contribute to knowledge base development and team training initiatives to continuously raise the team’s capability baseline.

**YOUR IMPACT**
As an IT Operations Administrator, you are both a practitioner and a force multiplier. Your technical depth enables you to resolve the most complex end-user issues the team encounters, while your mentorship directly elevates the effectiveness of the analysts around you. Your ownership of the ITSM platform ensures the team operates on a reliable, accurate foundation — and your insights into root-cause trends help leadership make better decisions for Chatham’s people and systems.
  
  
**Required**
**QUALIFICATIONS & COMPETENCIES**

* CompTIA A+ certification or equivalent demonstrated experience in an IT support role
* Proficiency with Microsoft Active Directory and PowerShell scripting
* Strong working knowledge of Microsoft 365 / Office suite
* Proven ability to resolve complex technical issues independently, with sound judgment and minimal supervision
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to adapt messaging for technical and non-technical audiences
* Demonstrated ability to mentor or coach peers in a professional environment
* Ability to perform effectively under pressure, managing competing priorities in a fast-paced environment
* Strong organizational and time management skills; ability to shift fluidly between concurrent tasks
* Comfortable working on-site in an open office environment
* Availability to participate in rotating after-hours on-call schedule (one week at a time)

**Preferred**

* Experience administering an ITSM platform (e.g., Freshservice, ServiceNow, Jira Service Management)
* Familiarity with networking fundamentals and/or information security concepts
* Experience with enterprise endpoint management tooling
* Track record of process improvement or automation initiatives in a support context

**PERSONAL ATTRIBUTES**

* Genuinely service-oriented — you care about the people you’re helping, not just closing tickets
* Analytical and pattern-oriented — you see signal in the noise and act on it
* Accountable and self-driven — you take ownership without being asked
* Collaborative — you make the people around you better
* Composed — you perform at your best when things get complicated

**About Chatham Financial**
Chatham Financial is the leading independent capital markets advisor, delivering an integrated blend of expert advice and powerful technology to help you reduce risk and seize opportunity. With decades of capital markets strategy, execution, monitoring, and performance expertise, we serve as an unwavering advocate for your best interests and your innovation partner. Our technology platform unifies data across assets, debt, and derivatives, giving you unmatched agility, transparency, and insight.
  
  
**It’s clear ahead.**
Our commitment is to carry that light forward in every partnership, every solution, and every market we serve.
  
  
We help guide the way—giving clients the insight and momentum to move forward with confidence, no matter what lies ahead.

title: Technical Support Engineer
description:
Join our global team for a career filled with opportunities to solve challenges both small and large, local and global, simple and complex.
  
  
**Wilhelmsen Ship Management**
is a third-party ship manager providing a wide range of maritime services worldwide. With a strong workforce of shore-based employees and seafarers, we operate one of the world's largest maritime networks across more than 70 countries.
  
  
**Wilhelmsen Ship Management Chennai**
is looking for a
**Technical Support Engineer (PMS)**
to join the
**Global PMS Support Team**
. This role combines Planned Maintenance System (PMS) technical support and PMS database project activities, requiring close interaction with vessel personnel, Technical Managers, Fleet Managers, and other stakeholders.
  
  
The successful candidate will be responsible for providing PMS support to vessels, maintaining PMS technical data, supporting database improvement initiatives, and ensuring accuracy and quality of PMS spare parts data. The role requires excellent communication skills, strong customer service orientation, and the ability to work effectively with both vessel and shore-based stakeholders.
  
  
**Main Responsibilities**

* Provide first-line technical support for the Planned Maintenance System (PMS), responding to vessel and stakeholder queries in a timely and professional manner.
* Liaise with vessel crews, Technical Managers, Fleet Managers, and other stakeholders to investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve PMS-related issues.
* Maintain and update PMS databases, including equipment hierarchies, maintenance tasks, spare parts records, and technical documentation in accordance with company standards.
* Review maker's manuals, drawings, and technical documents to extract, validate, and standardize spare parts, component, and maintenance information.
* Perform quality assurance and data validation activities to ensure accuracy, completeness, and consistency of PMS data.
* Support PMS database Projects, migration, standardization, and continuous improvement across the fleet.
* Execute bulk data updates, cleaning, and verification activities to maintain high data quality standards.
* Prepare reports, analyze PMS data, and provide insights using Microsoft Excel and other reporting tools.
* Contribute to process improvement initiatives and special PMS-related projects.
* Deliver a high level of customer service while supporting vessels and internal stakeholders.
* Support team objectives and undertake additional responsibilities assigned by the Team Lead.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Diploma or bachelor’s degree in marine engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* Minimum 1 year of experience in PMS support, maintenance planning, PMS database building, or related technical functions.
* Experience in PMS data management and technical support for vessels or maritime operations is preferred.
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including formulas, lookups, filtering, data analysis, and reporting.
* Basic knowledge of SQL is desirable.
* Good understanding of vessel equipment, maintenance practices, and technical documentation.
* Experience in spare parts extraction, data standardization, and quality assurance activities.
* Knowledge of PMS component structure and maintenance job extraction from maker's manuals is an advantage.
* Previous onboard sailing experience will be considered an added benefit.

**Key Competencies**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication abilities.
* Effective stakeholder management and customer service orientation.
* High attention to detail with a focus on quality and accuracy.
* Proactive, self-motivated, and results-oriented approach.
* Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within a team environment.

Work Location: Chennai, India

description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. **GDS – IAM MS SSO– Senior**
**Job Summary**
The SSO & Access Management Senior Consultant is responsible for providing operational support, administration, and continuous improvement of enterprise Single Sign-On (SSO) and Access Management platforms. This role supports global IAM operations through monitoring, troubleshooting, incident resolution, application onboarding, access governance, and platform optimization activities.

**Key Responsibilities**

title: SecOps Lead
description:
**Job Description**
**About the Role:**
We are seeking a Systems Engineer to own patch management, configuration automation, and vulnerability remediation across our Linux and Windows server and endpoint fleets. This role combines Puppet/Ansible-based automation for Linux OS patching and configuration enforcement with SCCM/Intune-based endpoint management and PowerShell-driven remediation on Windows, ensuring systems across both platforms stay compliant, secure, and up to date with minimal manual intervention.
  
  
**Requirements**
**Key Responsibilities — Linux (Puppet/Ansible)**

* Manage end-to-end patch lifecycle (assessment, testing, staged rollout, validation) across RHEL servers.
* Develop, maintain, and version-control Puppet/Ansible modules and manifests for OS patching, software installation, and configuration enforcement.
* Design staged/canary patch rollout groups to minimize production risk.
* Automate software installation and configuration across environments to reduce manual provisioning.
* Troubleshoot patch failures, configuration drift, and Puppet/Ansible run errors across the fleet.
* Lead remediation of End-of-Life (EOL) / End-of-Support (EOS) operating systems and software — upgrading, re platforming, or migrating affected servers ahead of support cutoff dates.
* Execute EOL remediation plans in coordination with infrastructure and application owners, escalating and documenting formal risk acceptance only where remediation isn't feasible within the required timeline.

**Key Responsibilities — Windows (SCCM / Intune / PowerShell)**

* Manage and maintain endpoint security configurations using SCCM and Intune.
* Develop and implement PowerShell scripts to automate vulnerability remediation, security tasks, and processes.
* Create and manage imaging and task sequences in SCCM and Intune.
* Package and deploy patches on Windows servers and workstations based on a monthly schedule.
* Deploy collections in SCCM and push relevant missing patches to remediate vulnerabilities.
* Write PowerShell scripts to fix vulnerabilities based on testing on a few devices and implement them through Qualys or SCCM.

**Shared Responsibilities — Vulnerability Management & Compliance**

* Prioritize and remediate critical/high findings within SLA.
* Define and manage maintenance windows, rollback procedures, and exception/risk-acceptance workflows for unpatchable systems.
* Collaborate with security and application teams to align patch cadence with compliance requirements (CIS Benchmarks, STIG, PCI, etc.).
* Document processes, runbooks, and standard operating procedures for patch, configuration, and remediation management.

**Required Qualifications — Linux**

* Minimum 3+ years of Linux systems administration experience (RHEL).
* Hands-on experience with Puppet/Ansible (manifests, modules, Hiera, PuppetDB, r10k or similar control-repo workflow).
* Experience with package management (yum/dnf, apt).
* Hands-on experience remediating EOL/EOS operating systems and software — performing OS upgrades, migrations, or replat forming to bring systems back into supported status.

**Required Qualifications — Windows**

* Proven experience in vulnerability management and security operations.
* Strong knowledge of Qualys, SCCM, and Intune.
* Experience with imaging and task sequencing in SCCM and Intune.

**Required Qualifications — Shared**

* Scripting proficiency in Bash and/or Python, and proficiency in PowerShell scripting.
* Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with strong communication and teamwork abilities.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with patch orchestration tools (Red Hat Satellite, Spacewalk, or equivalent).
* Familiarity with vulnerability management/scanning tools (Qualys or similar).
* Understanding of CIS Benchmarks, STIG, or other security hardening standards.
* Experience with Git-based version control and CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitLab CI, or similar).
* Red Hat Certified System Administrator (RHCSA) or higher; Puppet/Ansible Certified Professional.
* Experience in a regulated industry (financial services, healthcare) with formal exception/risk-acceptance processes.
* Experience running EOL remediation projects at scale (e.g., fleet-wide OS version upgrades, distro migrations) in coordination with cross-functional teams.
* Familiarity with Ansible or other configuration management tools as a secondary skill.
* Experience building compliance dashboards (Grafana, Splunk, or similar).

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, IT, or related field — or equivalent practical experience.

title: SAP PM Consultant
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**SAP PM – Consultant, Managed Services**
**Enterprise Performance**
Our Enterprise Performance team helps organizations improve business performance through enterprise platforms, digital operations, and technology-enabled transformation. Within this practice, professionals work across finance, supply chain, manufacturing, and IT to support complex business process and system needs. As an SAP PM Functional Consultant, you will work with cross-functional teams to design, support, and enhance plant maintenance solutions, align business requirements to SAP capabilities, and help clients improve maintenance operations through scalable, technology-enabled processes.
  
  
**Level**
: Consultant or equivalent
  
  
As an experienced Consultant at Deloitte Consulting Services, you will be responsible for individually delivering high quality work products within due timelines. Need-basis you will be mentoring and/or directing junior team members/liaising with onsite/offshore teams to understand the functional requirements.
  
  
**Work you'll do**
As a Consultant, Managed Services on the Enterprise Performance team, you will be responsible for:
  
  

* Support SAP Plant Maintenance (PM) managed services activities across design, build, test, deployment, and post-production support.
* Gather business requirements, perform fit-gap analysis, and translate requirements into functional specifications and configuration design.
* Configure SAP PM processes and support integration with other SAP modules and external systems.
* Participate in unit testing, regression testing, and user acceptance testing, and support cutover, go-live, and hyper-care activities.
* Collaborate with client stakeholders and onsite/offshore teams to resolve issues, maintain documentation, and support ongoing process improvement.

**The team**
Our Enterprise Performance team is at the forefront of enterprise package insights and platform technology, working across finance, supply chain, manufacturing, and IT operations to support delivery of holistic performance improvement and package led large scale digital transformation. Join our team of strategic advisors and architects, differentiated by our industry depth to help collaborate and leverage your experience in strategy, process design, technology enablement, and operational services to enable the heart of business insights and collaborate with the businesses as they navigate their enterprise growth and transformation journeys.
  
  
The Enterprise Operations Portfolio is a suite of offerings designed to help clients maximize value from their Finance, Supply Chain, and IT operations. By taking a holistic approach—from strategy development to process design and technology enablement—we support clients in overcoming operational challenges and managing key business functions. As organizations pursue digital transformation, these areas become vital in shaping interactions with customers, suppliers, and stakeholders. By integrating strategy, operational improvement, implementation, and managed services, we creatively deploy resources and drive innovation, ensuring clients achieve impactful, sustainable results at the speed demanded by today’s dynamic market.

Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/Chennai
  
  
**Shift Timings:**
24\*7 rotational shifts including night shifts as per business requirements
  
  
**Qualifications**
Required:
  
  

* 3-6 years of experience with SAP Plant Maintenance (PM)
* Experience delivering SAP PM solution design, build, test, and deployment activities
* Experience with preventive maintenance and breakdown maintenance processes in SAP PM
* Experience configuring SAP PM and supporting integration with other SAP modules and external systems
* Experience contributing to at least 1 SAP Enterprise Asset Management (EAM) implementation or support project
* Experience writing functional specifications and supporting unit, regression, and user acceptance testing
* Bachelor of Engineering, Bachelor of Technology, Master of Computer Applications, or Master of Science in Computer Science from an accredited university

Preferred:
  
  

* 2+ years of experience in asset-intensive industries
* Experience identifying custom development requirements through fit-gap analysis
* Experience supporting cutover, go-live, and hyper-care activities
* Experience with Information Technology Infrastructure Library (ITIL) service management processes
* Experience using Information Technology Service Management (ITSM) tools
* Master’s degree

Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
  
  
**Our people and culture**
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
  
  
**Professional development**
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. description:
**About Brite**

Brite Systems Inc. is a U.S.-based, AI-led digital transformation company and a Top 1% Salesforce Summit Partner. Since 2006, we have helped government and nonprofit organizations modernize their technology, improve operations, and deliver better outcomes for the communities they serve.

Headquartered in Indianapolis with a Global Delivery Hub in Chennai, Brite brings together expertise across Salesforce, AWS, MuleSoft, AI, and our proprietary Enlite Accelerator to solve complex challenges and create meaningful impact.

At Brite, you’ll be part of a collaborative, people-first team where innovation, continuous learning, and meaningful work come together. We’re proud to be recognized among Indiana’s fastest growing companies, named to the Inc. 5000 list of America’s fastest-growing private companies, and recognized as a Great Place to Work in Indiana for seven years. Join Brite to build innovative technology, grow your career, and make a difference.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a proactive and customer-focused IT Administrator to provide first-level IT support to employees. The ideal candidate should possess strong troubleshooting skills, excellent communication, and a service-oriented mindset to ensure timely resolution of technical issues while maintaining high customer satisfaction.

**Roles and Responsibilities**

**Key Responsibilities**

**End User Support**

* Provide first-level technical support for desktops, laptops, printers, mobile devices, and peripherals.
* Diagnose and resolve hardware, software, network, and application-related issues.
* Install, configure, and maintain Windows operating systems and standard business applications.
* Support Microsoft 365 applications including Outlook, Teams, Word, Excel, and OneDrive.



**User Administration**

* Create, modify, and deactivate user accounts.
* Manage password resets and access permissions.
* Configure email accounts, distribution groups, and shared mailboxes.

**Asset Management**

* Maintain the IT asset inventory, including laptops, desktops, monitors, and accessories.
* Track asset allocation, returns, warranty details, and lifecycle.
* Coordinate procurement and replacement of IT equipment.



**Ticket Management**

* Log, prioritize, and resolve support tickets within defined SLAs.
* Escalate unresolved issues to Level-2 or specialized support teams.
* Maintain proper documentation of incidents, resolutions, and root causes.



**Infrastructure Support**

* Assist in configuring and troubleshooting LAN, Wi-Fi, VPN, and internet connectivity.
* Support printers, scanners, meeting room equipment, and video conferencing systems.
* Assist with software deployment and patch management.



**Employee Onboarding & Offboarding**

* Prepare laptops and user accounts for new employees.
* Configure required software, licenses, and access rights.
* Recover company assets and revoke system access during employee exit.



**Documentation & Compliance**

* Maintain knowledge base articles and standard operating procedures (SOPs).
* Ensure compliance with IT security policies.
* Support periodic audits related to IT assets and access management.

**Qualification**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Computer Applications, or a related field.

**Equal Employment Opportunity**

Brite Systems is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status.

Recruitment Fraud Alert! There has been an increase in fraud that targets job seekers. Scammers may present themselves to job seekers as Brite Systems employees or recruiters. Please be aware that Brite Systems does not request sensitive personal data from applicants via text/instant message or any unsecured method; does not promise any advance payment for work equipment set-up; and does not use recruitment or job-sourcing agencies that charge candidates an advance fee of any kind. We encourage you to review and apply to our available job openings at Brite Systems website. For more information on avoiding and reporting scams, please visit the Federal Trade Commission’s job scams website

title: Customer Support Agent (Trading Platform)
description: About GoChartingGoCharting is one of the most advanced platforms for seeing and trading the markets. Traders use it to read price and volume through professional orderflow tools - footprint charts, volume profile, cumulative delta, DOM - to analyse the market and to place orders through their broker, all in the browser.Our users are active traders in India, the US and around the world: from people learning to read orderflow to professionals who trade every session. 3M+ registered traders, PE-backed since 2025, profitable, with a mandate to scale 10x over four years.The roleYou'll be the person traders talk to when they need help with GoCharting - and the person who actually solves it.The questions are rarely simple. A footprint chart looks different from what a trader expects. Data for a symbol is delayed. A broker connection drops just before the market opens. An order didn't go through. A subscription didn't renew. Behind each message is a trader who is in the middle of a session and is losing time or money while they wait.Your job is to understand the product deeply enough to find the real cause, give a complete answer, and - when it's a bug - give our engineers everything they need to fix it. Over time, you become one of the people in the company who knows the product best and knows what traders struggle with.What you'll doSolve product questions end to end. Charts and indicators, orderflow tools, market data, broker connections and order execution, account and billing. Reproduce the problem in the platform yourself, check the obvious causes, and come back with an answer that closes the question.Write answers that close the question. One complete, professional reply instead of several chat bubbles. You'll work to our Communication Standards - a short guide on tone, structure and what a complete answer looks like.Explain the product to traders. Help people set up and read footprint charts, volume profile, DOM and other tools - clearly, in their terms, without a script.Troubleshoot technical issues. Check what the trader sees, look at the browser console, compare accounts and settings, narrow it down before escalating.Escalate bugs with evidence. Write bug reports an engineer can act on without asking a follow-up question: what the trader did, what happened, what was expected, environment, screenshots, whether it reproduces.React fast during incidents. When data or the platform has a problem during market hours, flag it immediately and keep traders informed.Turn repeated questions into knowledge. At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!
  
  
**Global Business Services**
Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations.
  
  
Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation.
  
  
In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.
  
  
**Process Overview\***
Core Technology Infrastructure (CTI), part of the Global Technology & Operations organization, consists of more than 6,600 employees worldwide. With presence in more than 35 countries, TI designs, builds, and operates end-to-end technology infrastructure solutions and manages critical systems and platforms across the bank. TI delivers industry-leading infrastructure products and services to the company’s employees, customers, and clients around the world.
  
  
**Job Description**
An Infrastructure Engineer for Db2 z/OS is required to support software installation, upgrades, maintenance, 24x7 on-call coverage, disaster recovery testing, automation, monitoring, alerting, and security administration for resilient mainframe database and replication services.
  
  
The role contributes to the installation, upgrade, maintenance, certification, and operational support of IBM Db2 for z/OS and replication products, including Q Replication, SQL Replication, and CDC.
  
  
The engineer will help maintain service stability through monitoring, automation, security administration, documented operational procedures, disaster recovery readiness, and effective coordination with internal support teams, software vendors, and management.
  
  
**Responsibilities\***
Responsibilities include but are not limited to:
  
  

* Install, upgrade, maintain, test, and support IBM Db2 for z/OS and replication products, including Q Replication, SQL Replication, CDC etc.
* Perform software certification testing and maintain clear operational, maintenance, and recovery procedures.
* Support disaster recovery planning and testing to validate service recoverability and operational resilience.
* Develop and enhance automation, monitoring, alerting, health checks, and operational controls.
* Administer security-related activities, including access controls, RACF coordination, TCP/IP connectivity, and network certificates.
* Analyze and resolve complex Db2, replication, infrastructure, performance, and production support issues.
* Work with support teams, software vendors, and management; communicate technical risks, status, and resolution plans clearly.
* Participate in a 24x7 on-call rotation and provide off-hours support as required.

**Requirements\***
**Education\***
B.E/B.Tech/M.E/M.Tech/Computer Science degree preferred or substantially equivalent experience.
  
  
Certifications If Any: NA
  
  
**Experience Range\***
8-10+ years
  
  
**Foundational Skills**

* Hands-on experience supporting IBM Db2 for z/OS and replication products, including Q Replication, SQL Replication, and CDC.
* Experience with software installation, version upgrades, maintenance, certification testing, operational documentation, and disaster recovery testing.
* Ability to participate in 24x7 on-call rotation and provide off-hours production support when required.
* Strong analytical, debugging, problem-solving, and production incident resolution skills.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with support teams, software vendors, and management.

**Desired Skills**

* Experience supporting BMC for Db2 tools, IBM z/OS Connect, and Software AG ADABAS and Natural products.
* Programming or automation experience with REXX.
* Working knowledge of SQL, JIRA, SMP/E, RACF, TCP/IP, network certificates, and Splunk.
* Working knowledge of other mainframe subsystems, including CICS, IMS, and MQ.

**Work Timings\***
11:30 to 20:30 IST (Monday-Friday)
  
  

* The schedule would likely start later in the India day initially to perform cross training

Hyderabad, Chennai, Mumbai & Gurugram

title: Product Support Engineer
description:
**About the job**

Founded in 2021, Complyance is a developer-first e-invoicing SaaS company. Through a single API, we help businesses connect their invoicing workflows and meet e-invoicing mandates across markets, including the UAE and Saudi Arabia’s ZATCA requirements, without rebuilding e-invoicing every time they enter a new market.

After five years of bootstrapped investment in engineering, we recently raised US$1.5 million in pre-series funding to accelerate an already-operating platform serving enterprise customers. We support e-invoicing projects for brands including L’Occitane, Mothercare Malaysia, LC Waikiki and RedBus, alongside Abu Dhabi-based Tadweer Group. Behind those names are real integrations, busy finance teams and business workflows that need to keep moving.

We connect ERP, billing and business systems with the tools to map invoice data, validate documents, submit invoices and track their status. Product work such as ERP Reconciliation, AI Reports and our AI Support Assistant shows the range of practical problems we are building for.

**Life at Complyance :**

We take initiative, write down what matters and share what we learn. We ask good questions, communicate uncertainty honestly and use feedback to improve.

Ownership also means judgement: we protect customer information, respect tenant boundaries and use approved access. And Support and Core Engineering are complementary specialisms, not junior and senior tiers.

**The mission :**

Product Support Engineering at Complyance is not about forwarding queries or closing as many tickets as possible. It is about understanding why something isn’t working, helping the customer through it, and improving the product or tools behind the experience.

You will build technical depth by investigating APIs, integrations and invoicing workflows alongside Core Product Engineering, and own the customer’s conversation through a verified resolution or an accepted handover. When you are not handling client issues, you will keep building, maintaining and enhancing our internal support bot.

If you enjoy helping people and want writing code to remain part of your work, this role brings both together.

**Where you’ll leave your mark :**

**•    Get to the bottom of technical problems:**
 Reproduce issues in a safe environment, test hypotheses and connect evidence across browser developer tools, APIs, logs and product behaviour. Learn to tell configuration issues, integration failures, product defects and expected behaviour apart.

**•    Own the customer’s experience:**
 Explain what you know in clear language, agree the next action and update, keep customers informed while engineering investigates, and verify the affected workflow before calling it restored.

**•    Write code that makes support better:**
 Write and debug diagnostic or reproduction scripts, regression tests and support-tool improvements, and, as your skills grow, contribute reviewed bug fixes.

**•    Build and own our internal support bot:**
 Turn recurring support needs into useful capabilities, fix defects, add tests and keep documentation current.

**•    Work alongside Core Product Engineering:**
 Bring clear evidence, useful reproduction steps and a specific technical request, while keeping the customer conversation.

**•    Make the next case easier:**
 Turn recurring patterns into better troubleshooting guides, diagnostics, automation and product feedback that help the next person.

**•    Learn how e-invoicing works in practice:**
 Build knowledge of supported-country workflows, customer integrations and document journeys, working with Product, Customer Success, delivery and the ERP/Integration role.

**The kind of builder we’re looking for :**

You’ll likely thrive in this role if you:

**•**
Have experience in product support, software engineering or API/integration troubleshooting, or are a fresher with strong foundations and learning potential.

**•**
Genuinely want to work in a customer-facing product support environment.

**•**

**•**
