title: ERP Implementation Executive
description:
**ERP Implementation Executive – BOS**

**Location:**
Chennai, Tamil Nadu

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**About BOS**

**BOS is a next-generation Business Operating System designed to help companies manage and connect their operations across areas such as sales, procurement, inventory, manufacturing, finance, workforce management and other business functions.**

**BOS goes beyond traditional ERP software by adapting to the operational processes of each organisation rather than forcing every business into a rigid, predefined system.**

**We are currently implementing BOS with businesses across multiple industries and are looking for an ERP Implementation Executive to work directly with customers and our product and development teams.**

**About the Role**

**As an ERP Implementation Executive, you will help businesses successfully adopt and implement BOS.**

**This is not primarily a software development role. You will work closely with business owners, department heads and operational users to understand how their business works, configure BOS around their processes, coordinate data migration, train users, support testing and take departments through go-live.**

**You will act as the bridge between the customer and the BOS product/development team**
.

The role provides significant exposure to real business operations and is suited to someone who wants to develop a career in ERP implementation, business analysis and enterprise technology consulting.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Meet customers, department heads and operational users to understand their existing business processes.
* Study how departments currently operate using ERP systems, Excel, documents and manual processes.
* Document business processes, requirements, approval flows, user roles and operational rules.
* Map existing customer processes to BOS and identify configuration or product requirements.
* Work with the BOS product and development teams to translate business requirements into system requirements.
* Configure customers, users, roles, permissions, departments, workflows and other implementation settings within BOS.
* Assist with collection, cleaning, validation and migration of master and transactional data.
* Coordinate implementation activities across departments such as Commercial, Procurement, Inventory, Manufacturing, Finance and HR/Workforce.
* Conduct product demonstrations and user training for department heads and end users.
* Prepare test scenarios and coordinate functional testing and User Acceptance Testing (UAT).
* Record issues, gaps and enhancement requirements identified during implementation.
* Work with developers to verify that issues have been correctly resolved.
* Support customers during go-live and post-implementation stabilization.
* Monitor adoption after go-live and help users transition from their existing processes to BOS.
* Maintain implementation documentation, meeting notes, action items and implementation status.
* Visit customer offices and operational locations when required.

**What We Are Looking For**

**We are looking for someone who combines business understanding, communication skills and technology aptitude**
.

The ideal candidate should:

* Be comfortable speaking with business owners, managers and operational staff.
* Be curious about how businesses actually operate.
* Be able to understand a business process and translate it into a software workflow.
* Have strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Be organised and capable of following multiple implementation activities simultaneously.
* Be comfortable working with Excel and business data.
* Have good written and verbal communication skills.
* Be comfortable learning complex enterprise software.
* Be willing to visit customer locations and work closely with customers during implementations.
* Take ownership of problems rather than simply passing requirements between the customer and development team.

**Preferred Experience**

**Candidates with 1–4 years of experience**
in any of the following would be particularly suitable:

* ERP implementation
* ERP functional consulting
* Business analysis
* Software implementation
* Customer onboarding for enterprise software
* Manufacturing ERP
* Inventory or warehouse systems
* Procurement systems
* HRMS / payroll implementation
* Accounting or finance software implementation

Experience with systems such as
**SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, Odoo, Zoho, Tally, ERPNext or similar ERP/business applications**
would be beneficial but is not mandatory.

Candidates who have worked inside manufacturing or other operational businesses and have strong systems knowledge may also be considered.

**Educational Background**

**Relevant qualifications may include:**

* B.Com / M.Com
* BBA / MBA
* BCA / MCA
* BE / B.Tech
* Information Systems
* Operations / Supply Chain
* Finance / Accounting
* or another relevant discipline

We value practical ability and willingness to learn more than a specific degree.

**Skills That Will Be Valuable**

* ERP implementation
* Business process mapping
* Requirements gathering
* Functional documentation
* User Acceptance Testing (UAT)
* Data migration
* Microsoft Excel
* User training
* Customer communication
* Project coordination
* SQL knowledge – advantageous but not required
* Understanding of APIs/integrations – advantageous but not required
* Understanding of AI and modern business software – advantageous

**Why Join BOS?**

**BOS is being built as an alternative to the traditional approach to enterprise software.**

**Rather than joining an organisation where you repeatedly implement the same predefined ERP modules, you will have the opportunity to understand different businesses and help shape how their operations are represented within a new generation of business software.**

**You will work closely with the BOS leadership, product and engineering teams and gain exposure to:**

* Enterprise software implementation
* Business process design
* Manufacturing and operational businesses
* Product development
* Business analysis
* AI-enabled enterprise software
* Customer consulting
* Implementation project management

As BOS grows, this role can develop into
**Implementation Consultant, Senior Implementation Consultant, Implementation Manager and Implementation/Operations leadership roles**
.

We are seeking an experienced Network Engineer to design, implement, maintain, and support enterprise network infrastructure across multiple locations. * Provide after-hours support and participate in an on-call rotation as required.

* DNS
  
  
* DHCP
  
  
* VLANs
  
  
* VPNs
  
  
* Network Security
  
  
* Wireless Networking
  
  
* Proven experience implementing and troubleshooting:

* EIGRP
  
  
* OSPF
  
  
* Experience troubleshooting network-related issues on both Windows and macOS endpoints.
  
  
* Experience with network architecture, deployment, and operational support.
  
  
* Strong analytical, documentation, and problem-solving skills.
  
  
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills.
  
  
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

  

  
* Cisco CCNA, CCNP, or equivalent certification.

Education Qualification: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field or higher with minimum 06 years of relevant experience
  
  
**Job Summary**
Experience Required: 6–9+ Years
  
  
**Job Summary**
We are seeking a high caliber Senior AS/400 (IBM i) Systems Administrator / Infrastructure Engineer (L3 Support) to serve as the senior technical authority for our enterprise IBM Power Systems platform. In this lead engineering role, you will be responsible for platform architecture, operating system upgrades, virtualization design, deep tier incident forensics, high availability/disaster recovery (HA/DR) design, storage engineering, and performance optimization.
  
  
The successful candidate will act as the final internal escalation tier for mission critical IBM i infrastructure incidents, drive complex OS migrations across releases (IBM i 7.3, 7.4, and 7.5), architect PowerVM and VIOS environments, optimize enterprise storage configurations (IASP, SAN integration), and orchestrate automated HA/DR replication architectures (PowerHA, MIMIX). This role focuses purely on system architecture, operating system engineering, security hardening, and infrastructure resilience, serving as the technical liaison to IBM Support (PMR/Escalations), enterprise architects, and executive IT management.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Level 3 Escalation, Deep Diagnostics & Root Cause Analysis (RCA)
* Serve as the supreme technical escalation authority for severe (P1/Major) system outages, abnormal IPLs, kernel exceptions, hung partitions, and machine check conditions.
* Conduct advanced system crash investigations using System Service Tools (SST), Dedicated Service Tools (DST), Main Storage Dumps (MSD), and LIC trace analysis.
* Interrogate advanced logs (PAL, QHST, Advanced Job Logs) to diagnose complex intermittent hardware faults, bus channel errors, and memory corruptions.
* Own and author definitive Root Cause Analysis (RCA) documentation; engineer preventative architecture changes to permanently eliminate systemic failure modes.
* Manage and drive complex technical support cases (PMRs / IBM Support Cases), coordinating directly with IBM Level 3 labs and Rochester development teams.
* Operating System Lifecycle, Version Migrations & PTF Engineering
* Architect, plan, and execute major OS release upgrades (e.g., migrations from IBM i 7.3/7.4 to 7.5) and Technology Refresh (TR) cycles across large scale enterprise estates.
* Formulate comprehensive PTF management policies; perform cross subsystem prerequisite/corequisite analysis, microcode/firmware compatibility matrices, and regression risk assessments.
* Manage system level configurations including dynamic tuning system values, Workload Groups, Subsystem Descriptions (SBSD), Class parameters, and memory pool allocations.
* Oversee system initialization scripts, startup programs (QSTRUP), subsystem routing architectures, and operational configurations.
* Power Systems Architecture, PowerVM & VIOS Engineering
* Architect, configure, and maintain enterprise IBM Power Systems hardware (Power9, Power10) managed via redundant Hardware Management Consoles (HMC).
* Design and implement PowerVM virtualization solutions, including Virtual I/O Server (VIOS) clustering, Shared Ethernet Adapter (SEA) failover, and N\_Port ID Virtualization (NPIV) SAN mapping.
* Engineer enterprise LPAR topology, configuring shared processor pools, capped/uncapped partitions, Virtual Processors, and dynamic processor/memory optimization.
* Lead HMC firmware lifecycles, service processor firmware upgrades, and disaster recovery replication for HMC configurations.
* Enterprise HA/DR Architecture & Disaster Recovery Orchestration
* Design, implement, and fine tune enterprise High Availability (HA) replication architectures using solutions such as Precisely MIMIX, IBM PowerHA SystemMirror, or Maxava HA.
* Architect journal environments: Remote Journaling (RJ), asynchronous/synchronous network transport, dual journal receivers, and threshold management.
* Architect and lead scheduled enterprise Disaster Recovery (DR) and full role swap (switchover / failover) tests, guaranteeing stringent Recovery Time Objectives (RTO) and Recovery Point Objectives (RPO).
* Develop and maintain automated failover scripts, audit validation procedures, and emergency split brain recovery playbooks.
* Storage Engineering, IASP & Resiliency Architecture
* Architect auxiliary storage topologies, balancing internal NVMe/SAS drives and external SAN arrays (IBM FlashSystem, DS8000) using San Volume Controller (SVC).
* Implement and manage Independent Auxiliary Storage Pools (IASP) to isolate databases for modular switchover and flash copy operations.
* Formulate enterprise wide BRMS (Backup, Recovery, and Media Services) architecture, including network synced BRMS clusters, media lifecycle policies, and VTL encryption.
* Author and validate bare metal disaster recovery procedures, cold start installation plans, and full scale recovery runs (SAVSYS / Option 21 rebuilds).
* Advanced Performance Tuning, Profiling & Capacity Planning
* Conduct deep tier system performance profiling utilizing IBM i Performance Data Investigator (PDI), Collection Services, Job Watcher, Disk Watcher, and IBM i Doctor.
* Optimize system memory allocation by tuning dynamic system values (QPFRADJ), defining private memory pools, and resolving object lock contention.
* Analyze disk subsystem bottlenecks, arm contention, queue depths, and optimize paging space allocation.
* Formulate multi year capacity planning models predicting CPU (CPW), memory, and SAN storage expansion aligned with corporate business growth.
* Security Hardening, Audit Forensics & Compliance Architecture
* Architect and enforce OS security hardening in accordance with IBM i Security Level 40 and 50 standards.
* Establish comprehensive security auditing architectures via QAUDJRN, configuring journal filters for security critical actions and unauthorized object manipulation.
* Implement adopted authority controls, secure system values (QSECURITY, QPWD\*, QALWUSRDMN), and service program access controls.
* Drive compliance and vulnerability management programs (SOX, PCI DSS, ISO 27001), designing automated scripts to remediate non compliant configurations.
* Infrastructure Automation, Modernization & Technical Mentorship
* Architect reusable operational automation utilizing advanced Control Language (CL) programs and modern Db2 for i / IBM i Services (QSYS2).
* Evaluate and implement modern administration frameworks, such as IBM i open source integration (PASE, Bash, Python), Ansible for IBM i automation, and REST APIs.
* Serve as the technical mentor and escalation lead for L1 and L2 system administrators, conducting peer technical reviews and establishing enterprise engineering standards.
* Participate in architectural review boards (ARB) for major business applications and enterprise infrastructure projects.

Key skills :
  
  
Backup strategies, disaster
  
  
Recovery plans
  
  
Performance tuning,
  
  
Capacity/resource planning
  
  
Data Restoration
  
  
System Upgrades
  
  
**Required Qualifications**

* Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, or equivalent industry experience.
* Experience: Minimum of 6–10+ years of dedicated, hands on enterprise experience in IBM i (AS/400) System Engineering, Power Systems Architecture, and L3 Support.

**JOB DESCRIPTION**
Senior Administrator, Systems
  
  
**Position Summary**
The Senior Systems Administrator is responsible for overseeing and providing the installation, maintenance, support and enhancement to the Company computing infrastructure. Areas of responsibility include Windows and Linux Operating Systems , Active Directory , Azure/Entra, Office365, VMWare, Backup and Cloud technologies. The Senior Systems Administrator recommends technology decisions to Management and directs operational processes to Systems Administrators for the ICU Medical Global Computing environment.
  
  
**Essential Duties & Responsibilities**

* Create the Architecture; implement, configure, and support all enterprise computing systems globally.
* Create standards and documentation for the Global computing environments.
* Participate in creating and following the directives in the Infrastructure Strategic plan.
* Adhere to all Service Level Agreements established with the user community.
* Create reports and establish operational guidelines for the Global Computing Environments.
* Create automated monitoring to alert Systems Administrators and Service Desk staff of disruptions of service.
* Participate in vendor management under the direction of the department manager.
* Architect, implement, and support virtual and standalone server and storage solutions.
* Benchmark, evaluate and make recommendations for the selection of server and storage management software and hardware products.
* Develop and implement business continuity practices for server and storage management.
* Monitor server and storage performance, diagnose server issues, and perform emergency and scheduled maintenance.
* Provide support to operations relating to server and storage administration problems.
* Maintain server and storage configurations to provide performance monitoring/tuning of enterprise environments.
* Keep the Information Systems staff and customers informed of the status and resolution of issues; update the Service Desk software with resolutions and status.
* Participate in strategic initiatives by performing technical project activities.
* Evaluate server system and storage upgrades and management software patches.
* Prepare monthly status reports (or implement web-based reports) quantitatively reporting server and storage capacity, performance and uptime.
* Responsible for securing server and storage resources including password maintenance, new user logon and setup, and data protection procedures.
* Create and maintain automated systems and procedures for storage and server operations.
* Assist Service Desk staff in streamlining daily operations.
* Coordinate with user community scheduling times and user procedures necessary for server and storage system upgrades and/or maintenance.
* Work to minimize downtime impact on users through accurate planning of scheduled downtimes and quick problem resolution for unscheduled downtimes.
* Follow the established standards for writing and documenting projects and server and storage configurations.
* Contribute to the development of new standards and/or the modification of existing standards.
* Participate in the 24/7 department on-call program.
* Work on special assignments as they arise.

**Knowledge & Skills**

* Strong knowledge of Microsoft Operating Systems
* Strong knowledge of Office 365 environments
* Experience with PowerShell and using scripting to automate configuration management
* Experience with automation platforms such as SCORCH, MoveIT Automate, VMWare Orchestrator
* Experience with Azure cloud services
* Experience with DFS, CIFS, and print services
* Experience with VDI technologies. Preferably RDS and Horizon
* Experience with MSSQL and basic MSSQL management functions
* Strong knowledge in supporting enterprise backup solutions and troubleshooting backup issues
* Strong knowledge of data center technologies; Virtualization, Storage, Servers
* Understanding or experience supporting .Net application servers
* Knowledge of budget reductions, standardized processes, and operational automation.
* Strong customer service skills
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
* Excellent collaboration skills and able to work in a team environment
* Able to work quickly and effectively under pressure and to efficiently handle multiple priorities simultaneously

**Minimum Qualifications, Education & Experience**

* Must be at least 18 years of age
* Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related IT field
* Minimum 7 years of experience in server/user administration, virtualization and storage in a global enterprise environment
* Microsoft certification preferred
* Strong experience in virtual/physical server and storage technologies
* Experience in developing and implementing business continuity and disaster recovery practices
* Experience in data backup technologies
* Experience planning and leading global small to medium scale server related projects

**Work Environment**

* This is largely a sedentary role.
* This job operates in a professional office environment and routinely uses standard office equipment.
* Typically requires travel less than 15% of the time.

title: Telecom Operations Specialist
description:
**Be the one building AI-powered experiences where they matter most.**
At Genesys, we help organizations create better customer experiences through AI-powered experience orchestration. Our platform connects people, systems, data and AI to help organizations deliver more personalized service, improve operational efficiency and build stronger customer relationships.
  
  
Help build, support and operate technology used by more than 8,000 organizations in over 100 countries – moving AI from possibility to production in real-world enterprise environments every day.
  
  
**Telecom Operations Specialist for Genesys Cloud Voice**
Are you someone who likes to work with the latest in cloud technology to solve interesting and challenging problems? If so, Genesys might be the place for you!
  
  
**Why Genesys needs you**
Connections matter, at certain times with greater urgency. Whenever the moment, our technology facilitates those connections creating experience as a service. Our team members own their critical services and words like scalability, resiliency, and automation are at the heart of every line of code we write.
  
  
**What is Genesys Cloud Voice:**
Genesys Cloud Voice is an Internet-based telephony service entirely hosted on the Amazon Web Services platform. Genesys Cloud utilizes micro-services to build a powerful carrier voice platform. You will contribute to an architecture that delivers over 105 million calls and 230 million billed minutes every month – and growing every day. You will work in a fast-paced, startup culture, where our environment is one of continuous change, innovation and experimentation. If you are interested in learning more about Genesys Cloud Voice and its features then check out this link on our Resource Center here.
  
  
**Successful Telecom Operations Specialist will...**

* Be detail-oriented and collaborative with your team and teams throughout the company
* Thrive in a high performance, fast-paced environment
* Be an excellent multitasker
* Be a self-starter and someone that can manage their day to day tasks and goals independently
* Have a positive attitude and willingness to take on new tasks as they arise
* Be very customer focused and eager to engage when issues are encountered
* Have excellent communication skills (verbal & written)
* Be a solution-oriented problem solver
* Create and update processes and policies as needed to improve customer experience
* Follow set team procedures and instructions to complete daily tasks

**Major Responsibilities/Activities**

* Work with customers and providers to facilitate customer number porting and purchasing
* Communicate with customers via email to provide status of their orders in real time
* Enter customer order information into a variety of carrier systems with a high level of accuracy and time sensitivity while adhering to company and industry standards
* Maintain high level of accuracy for all customer orders
* Manage, create, and coordinate requests through multiple databases
* Work with our telecom providers to diagnose and resolve issues
* Monitor existing telecom utilization and help in capacity planning
* Communicate regularly with colleagues and management

**Additional expectations in this role:**

* Attend daily stand-ups with team members for communication, sharing of ideas and for supporting fellow team members in resolving any blocking issues
* Provide assistance and support for our Customer Care organization in resolving cases

**What kind of team are we?**
We are an extremely knowledgeable and friendly team. We are always helping our fellow team members with challenges and providing assistance with solutions. We are very collaborative and support each other in many aspects throughout the development process.
  
  
**Minimum Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree and a minimum of 2 years of related experience
* Experience managing projects and driving successfully to completion
* Knowledge of Microsoft Office; Intermediate knowledge of Excel preferred
* Experience with carrier telecom operations, such as number purchasing, porting, and provisioning
* Excellent communication skills (verbal, non-verbal & written)
* Must be a solution-oriented problem solver
* Self-motivated and must work well independently

**Ideal Candidates Will Also Have Experience With**

* Telecom provisioning, carrier support and number porting
* Telecom regulations
* Project Management

**Working at Genesys**

* AI at enterprise scale – Build, support and operate AI-powered technology used by more than 8,000 organizations worldwide. 150+ new AI features were released in the last fiscal year
* A flexible-first culture – Join a global team of nearly 7,000 employees with flexible ways of working designed to help people do their best work
* Growth in the AI era – Build future-ready skills through mentorship, learning programs, leadership development and education support
* Time to recharge and give back – Benefits include paid volunteer time, August Free Fridays, well-being resources and regionally tailored programs for employees and their families
* Recognized globally – Genesys is Great Place to Work® certified in 17 countries and 94% of employees are proud to tell others they work at Genesys

Learn more about our culture, AI innovation and sustainability commitments through our Careers site and Sustainability Report.
  
  
**What Happens After You Apply**
After you apply, here's what you can typically expect:
  
  

* Our Talent Acquisition team reviews your application with the hiring team
* A Talent Acquisition Partner will review your application and, if your background is aligned, schedule a Zoom interview.
* Next, you'll meet the hiring manager and other members of the interview team
* We aim to keep the process focused and respectful of your time, with no more than five interviews in most cases
* After interviews are complete, our team will follow up with the final steps

Every application is reviewed by a person. Response times may vary by role and location, but our team will keep you informed throughout the process.
  
  
**Stay Connected**
Stay connected to learn more about how we're applying AI to customer and employee experience challenges and get notified when relevant opportunities become available.
  
  
Get notified about relevant opportunities.
  
  
**Be the one building what's next - where AI, experience and impact come together.**
**Employee Referral**
If a Genesys employee referred you, please apply using the link they shared so we can connect your application to their referral.
  
  
**About Genesys:**
Genesys® empowers more than 8,000 organizations worldwide to create the best customer and employee experiences. Genesys Cloud™ is the Agentic Orchestration Platform that securely connects people, systems, data and AI across the enterprise with built-in governance and control. As a result, organizations can drive customer loyalty, growth and retention while increasing operational efficiency and teamwork across human and AI workforces. To learn more, visit www.genesys.ai.
  
  
**Reasonable Accommodations:**
If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, or are limited in your ability to access or use this online application and need an alternative method for applying, you or someone you know may contact us at reasonable.accommodations@genesys.com.
  
  
You can expect a response within 24–48 hours. To help us provide the best support, click the email link above to open a pre-filled message and complete the requested information before sending. If you have any questions, please include them in your email.
  
  
This email is intended to support job seekers requesting accommodations. Messages unrelated to accommodation—such as application follow-ups or resume submissions—may not receive a response.
  
  
**Genesys is an equal opportunity employer committed to fairness in the workplace. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, domestic partner status, national origin, genetics, disability, military and veteran status, and other protected characteristics.**
*Please note that recruiters will never ask for sensitive personal or financial information during the application phase.*

description:
****Career Area:****
Product Support
  
  
****Job Description:****
**Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.**
When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.
  
  
**Role Definition**
Provides first line of support, coordination of services, problem resolution and/or recommendations on selected products and services.
  
  
****Responsibilities****

* Addressing minor coverage issues and resolving minor complaints. Ensuring all customer communication is clearly documented.
* Answering inbound customer service inquiries. Providing health analysis or troubleshooting and redirecting them when appropriate.
* Identifying issues and determining appropriate course of action for effective resolution.
* Processing results from analysis of technical data
* Understand prime product or component health or status, if action is needed, and required next steps.

**Skill Descriptors**
**Customer Focus:**
Knowledge of the values and practices that align customer needs and satisfaction as primary considerations in all business decisions and ability to leverage that information in creating customized customer solutions.
  
  
**Level Working Knowledge:**

* Communicates the importance of customer needs/expectations and commits to resolving them.
* Researches and verifies customer needs and expectations.
* Solicits customer satisfaction feedback and acts on improvement opportunities.
* Helps link organizational objectives to customer needs and expectations.
* Meets regularly with customers to understand their wants, needs and expectations.

**Data Gathering & Analysis:**
Knowledge of data gathering and analysis tools, techniques, and processes; ability to collect and synthesize data from a variety of stakeholders and sources in an objective manner to reach a conclusion, goal, or judgment.
  
  
**Level Working Knowledge:**

* Follows proper data gathering and analysis processes and policies.
* Reports problems that arise in the data collection process.
* Participates in gathering and analyzing an organization's data based on requirements.
* Documents data from various sources and in various formats.
* Utilizes basic data collection and evaluation tools and techniques.

**Service Excellence:**
Knowledge of customer service concepts and techniques; ability to meet or exceed customer needs and expectations and provide excellent service in a direct or indirect manner.
  
  
**Level Working Knowledge:**

* Provides a quality of service that customers describe as excellent.
* Resolves common customer problems.
* Responds to unexpected customer requests with a sense of urgency and positive action.
* Provides direct service to internal or external customers.
* Documents customer complaints in a timely manner.

**Consulting:**
Knowledge of techniques, roles, and responsibilities in providing technical or business guidance to clients, both internal and external; ability to apply consulting knowledge appropriately.
  
  
**Level Basic Understanding:**

* Explains the roles and responsibilities of a consultant.
* Lists the typical phases of a consulting assignment or project.
* Presents a professional image, especially when dealing with customers.
* Describes the consulting process and relationship with clients.

**Decision Making and Critical Thinking:**
Knowledge of the decision-making process and associated tools and techniques; ability to accurately analyze situations and reach productive decisions based on informed judgment.
  
  
**Level Basic Understanding:**

* Explains characteristics and steps in an effective decision-making process.
* Identifies issues and communicates with others when a decision needs to be made.
* Names decision makers in own environment and cites examples of past decisions.
* Describes types of decisions incumbent may and may not make in own job or function.

**Effective Communications:**
Understanding of effective communication concepts, tools and techniques; ability to effectively transmit, receive, and accurately interpret ideas, information, and needs through the application of appropriate communication behaviors.
  
  
**Level Working Knowledge:**

* Delivers helpful feedback that focuses on behaviors without offending the recipient.
* Listens to feedback without defensiveness and uses it for own communication effectiveness.
* Makes oral presentations and writes reports needed for own work.
* Avoids technical jargon when inappropriate.
* Looks for and considers non-verbal cues from individuals and groups.

**Problem Solving:**
Knowledge of approaches, tools, techniques for recognizing, anticipating, and resolving organizational, operational or process problems; ability to apply knowledge of problem solving appropriately to diverse situations.
  
  
**Level Working Knowledge:**

* Identifies and documents specific problems and resolution alternatives.
* Examines a specific problem and understands the perspective of each involved stakeholder.
* Develops alternative techniques for assessing accuracy and relevance of information.
* Helps to analyze risks and benefits of alternative approaches and obtain decision on resolution.
* Uses fact-finding techniques and diagnostic tools to identify problems.

**Relationship Management:**
Knowledge of relationship management techniques; ability to establish and maintain healthy working relationships with clients, vendors, and peers.
  
  
**Level Working Knowledge:**

* Provides prompt and effective responses to client requests and interactions.
* Monitors client satisfaction levels on a regular basis.
* Alerts own team to problems in client satisfaction.
* Differentiates the roles and responsibilities in a business relationship.
* Works with clients to address critical issues and resolve major problems.

This Job Description is intended as a general guide to the job duties for this position and is intended for the purpose of establishing the specific salary grade. It is not designed to contain or be interpreted as an exhaustive summary of all responsibilities, duties and effort required of employees assigned to this job. At the discretion of management, this description may be changed at any time to address the evolving needs of the organization. It is expressly not intended to be a comprehensive list of “essential job functions” as that term is defined by the Americans with Disabilities Act.

October 22, 2026 - November 29, 2026

description:

The Indian Public School (TIPS) Globeducate India is part of an international education network focused on delivering high-quality, future-ready schooling. The institution emphasizes academic excellence, digital readiness, and holistic development in a multicultural learning environment. TIPS integrates modern technology into everyday teaching and administration to create efficient, safe, and learner-centric campuses. The school values collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement, offering education professionals opportunities to grow and contribute to a progressive academic community.

**Role Description**
The IT Admin is a full-time, on-site role based at TIPS Globeducate India in Coimbatore. The role involves managing and maintaining the school’s IT infrastructure, including servers, computers, printers, and classroom technology. Responsibilities include providing technical support to staff and students, handling user accounts, ensuring data backups, installing and updating software, and monitoring network performance. The IT Admin will troubleshoot hardware and software issues, maintain network security, and coordinate with vendors for IT equipment and services. title: SAP Basis consultant
description:
**Job Description**
**Role Summary :**
As an SAP Basis Consultant specializing in EWM on cloud. You will be responsible for the installation, configuration, performance optimization, and maintenance of our SAP EWM landscape in a cloud environment. You will bridge traditional Basis administration with cloud-native, automated operations to drive maximum warehouse efficiency.
  
  
**Key responsibilities and activities include, but is not limited to :**
Cloud Infrastructure Management
  
  

* Provision, configure, and monitor SAP EWM systems on cloud VMs.
* Ensure High Availability (HA) and Disaster Recovery (DR) for EWM using HANA System Replication (HSR) and cloud Site Recovery.
* Optimize cloud resource utilization and cost.

SAP EWM System Administration & Support
  
  

* Manage end-to-end technical administration of SAP EWM.
* Perform SAP kernel upgrades, HANA database patching, and SP updates in a critical 24/7 warehouse environment.
* Monitor and tune SAP EWM performance, background jobs.
* Provide 24/7 technical support for P1/P2 issues, managing incidents through resolution.

Integration & Optimization
  
  

* Maintain integrations with SAP EWM interfaces : Material Flow Systems (MFS), RF/Handheld devices, and 3PL connections.
* Perform EWM system refreshes and data volume management (data aging/archiving).
* Collaborate with functional teams to ensure seamless integration between SAP EWM and ERP (ECC or S/4HANA).

Automation & DevOps
  
  

* Automate SAP Basis operations using cloud Automation.
* Develop documentation and maintain SOPs for system operations.
* Communication & Working Relationships

* IT Service & Product Management Digital App & ERP TO
* Deputy SAP EWM Manager Cross Function Communication
* Plant operations
* For PM´s in the business as MM, PM and PP.

* 3-5 years of experience as an SAP Basis Administrator/Consultant.
* Hands-on experience migrating or managing SAP HANA on cloud.
* Strong knowledge of Linux/Windows OS and cloud networking.
* Relevant SAP or cloud certifications (e.g. SAP Workloads, SAP Certified Technology Associate - SAP HANA).

**Skills & Experience - Desirable**

* Experience with warehouse automation scenarios.
* Knowledge with DevOps practices and Infrastructure-as-Code tools. (Terraform/Ansible).

description:
**Shape the Future of Connected Systems as a TechOps Engineer**
Are you a highly skilled technical professional ready to bridge the gap between complex software solutions and seamless operations? As a TechOps Engineer, you will play a crucial role in the successful implementation and deployment of Application solutions on hosted and on-premise customer servers. Working closely with cross-functional teams, you will provide critical technical expertise, troubleshooting assistance, and vital user support during the deployment process.
  
  
**About Us**
Dedicated to the world’s tomorrow, Trimble is a technology company delivering solutions that enable our customers to work in new ways to measure, build, grow and move goods for a better quality of life. Core technologies in positioning, modeling, connectivity and data analytics connect the digital and physical worlds to improve productivity, quality, safety, transparency and sustainability. From purpose-built products and enterprise lifecycle solutions to industry cloud services, Trimble is transforming critical industries such as construction, geospatial, agriculture and transportation to power an interconnected world of work. For more information about Trimble (NASDAQ: TRMB), visit: www.trimble.com
  
  
**Our Division:**
We provide industry-leading digital construction and enterprise lifecycle solutions that increase precision, reduce costly errors, and promote seamless collaboration throughout the asset management lifecycle.
  
  
**What Makes This Role Great**
In this role, you will have a massive impact by owning the success of infrastructure deployments and system rollouts for our global clients. You will blend cloud-based platform orchestration with hands-on systems engineering, giving you full technical autonomy across diverse server environments. You will interface directly with stakeholders, product teams, and end-users, quickly becoming the ultimate product expert while driving automation and optimization strategies across our deployment pipeline.
  
  
Key Exciting Responsibilities
  
  

* Deployment Planning & Coordination: Collaborate with cross-functional teams and stakeholders to plan deployment activities. Develop deployment strategies, timelines, and resource requirements while coordinating across groups to ensure smooth execution.
* Technical Architecture & Guidance: Understand the technical deep-dive aspects of deployed systems or software. Provide ongoing guidance and support to teams involved in the deployment process while identifying technical risks and proposing workarounds.
* User Support & Training: Assist end-users in understanding and utilizing the deployed software. Provide training sessions to familiarize users with new functionalities, address user queries, and provide timely, high-quality resolutions.
* Documentation & Progress Tracking: Create and maintain comprehensive deployment documentation, including procedures, user guides, and troubleshooting resources. Prepare deployment progress reports and track issues for future reference.
* Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities to optimize the deployment process and enhance efficiency. Propose and implement process improvements, automation workflows, or tools to systematically streamline deployments.

**Essential Skills & Experience**

* Education & Background: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, combined with proven experience in deployment support, software implementation, or a similar role.
* Cloud Platform Mastery: Strong knowledge and hands-on experience with cloud platforms such as Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure, or similar providers, including compute, storage, networking, databases, and deployment models (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS).
* Systems Administration & Networking: Proficient in system administration tasks (server provisioning, configuration management, and troubleshooting) and networking concepts (IP addressing, subnets, routing, load balancing, firewalls). Familiarity with virtualization technologies like VMWare, Hyper-V, or KVM.
* Cloud Security Infrastructure: Solid understanding of cloud security best practices, including identity and access management (IAM), encryption, network security groups, and data protection.
* Professional Competence: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, active listening capabilities, a highly organized and self-directed approach to problem-solving, and the ability to maintain absolute professionalism, discretion, and accuracy.

**Bonus Points For**

* Automation Capabilities: High proficiency in scripting languages like Python, Bash, or PowerShell for automation scripting and system integration.
* Cross-Functional Domain Knowledge: Foundational understanding of Business Accounting (analyzing financial statements, invoice processing in accounts payable/receivable) and basics of Payroll Management.
* Product Knowledge: Ability to quickly develop and maintain a high level of knowledge of Viewpoint software products and remain an expert from both an internal and user perspective.

**Logistics**

* Location: Chennai, India
* Work Mode: Onsite
* Job Type: Full-Time

At Trimble, we're not just a company that "does good"—we are a team dedicated to making a tangible, positive Real-World Impact. We build innovative solutions designed to solve the world's most critical challenges. From construction sites to transportation hubs, our work tangibly improves how people live, build, move, and grow.

The individual demonstrates strong analytical, problem‑solving, and communication skills, and operates with a moderate level of autonomy while influencing outcomes through expertise and judgment.
  
  
The role has a direct impact on application stability, release readiness, testing effectiveness, and time‑to‑market, ensuring that technology platforms meet business expectations and Citi’s risk and control standards.

* Provide Level 2 / Level 3 technical and business support for Citi applications across Non‑Production environments, ensuring availability, stability, and readiness for testing and deployments.
* Manage, maintain, and support application platforms and their operating environments post‑development lifecycle, with emphasis on environment stability, configuration consistency, and functional integrity.
* Perform Start‑of‑Day / End‑of‑Day checks, ongoing health monitoring, and regional handovers across global support teams.
* Conduct same‑day risk checks and reconciliations to ensure environment and application integrity.
* Support and troubleshoot CI/CD pipelines across Non‑Production environments, including build failures, deployment issues, rollback scenarios, and promotion defects.
* Participate actively in application releases, including deployment coordination, validation, verification, and post‑release stabilization.
* Work closely with DevOps and Development teams to enable automation, reduce manual intervention, and improve deployment reliability.
* Support deployment dry runs, rehearsal activities, and environment readiness assessments ahead of major releases.

**Monitoring, Stability**

* Proactively monitor applications using tools such as ITRS Geneos, Splunk, Kibana, and similar platforms.
* Assess the risk and business impact of application and environment incidents, escalating appropriately in line with SLAs and Citi incident management standards.
* Perform root cause analysis (RCA) and drive preventive actions to reduce recurring issues.
* Ensure logging, alerting, storage, and archiving procedures are implemented and functioning correctly.

Act as a technical liaison between business users, developers, infrastructure teams, and third‑party vendors.
  
  

* Support applications running on Linux platforms, databases (Oracle, SQL Server, MongoDB), middleware, and web/application servers (WebSphere, WebLogic).
* Provide middleware support including MQ, NDM, and SFTP configurations.
* Support batch scheduling and workload automation using Autosys.
* Develop and maintain support documentation, runbooks, and deployment procedures.

* Serve as a subject matter expert (SME) for assigned applications and environments.

* Exercise sound judgment and autonomy while operating under Citi’s risk, compliance, and control framework.
* Ensure decisions demonstrate consideration for Citi’s reputation, regulatory obligations, and client impact.

**Qualifications Required**

* 7+ years of experience in QA / Testing, Application Support, Production Support, or Technical Operations roles.
* Strong experience supporting Non‑Production environments in fast‑paced delivery models.
* Hands‑on experience with Linux operating systems.
* Proficiency with databases (Oracle, SQL Server, MongoDB).
* Experience supporting web and middleware platforms (WebSphere, WebLogic, MQ, NDM, SFTP).
* Working knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and DevOps delivery practices.
* Experience using monitoring and logging tools (Geneos, Splunk, Kibana or equivalent).
* Experience with Autosys or enterprise scheduling tools.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem‑management skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with ability to explain technical issues to non‑technical stakeholders.

**Preferred / Added Advantage**

* Exposure to Cloud technologies and container platforms (ECS / Kubernetes – support perspective).
* Experience working in Agile / DevOps operating models.
* Proven record of driving stability, efficiency, and automation initiatives.

Hewlett Packard Enterprise is an innovative, dynamic company with a rich past and a promising future. Originally Hewlett-Packard Company, HPE has continuously reinvented itself. Today, HPE is one of the world's leading technology companies and provides wired and wireless networking, core and edge networking, servers, storage, IT and Cloud services for the next generation of IT infrastructure. We are hiring senior level Advanced Customer Engineering (ACE) engineers to work with our largest and most important customers. This position will be primarily responsible for working with our Critical Account Program customers. This work includes senior level case oversight/review, facilitating software engineering needs for defects, remote and/or onsite support depending on the nature of the issue. You must be able to deal with high pressure situations and know how to manage frustrated customers whilst being proactive in getting the information you need to be effective in these environments.
  
  
The ACE team is highly respected in the organization and is considered a senior level engineering team that is relied upon to get things done others can’t. The average tenure with Aruba is approximately 10 years and the average level of industry experience is 15-20 years. You will need to have excellent technical skills in your area of expertise but must also have outstanding communication skills. You must be able to effectively communicate to company IT executives as well as the front-line engineering staff. You must be willing to learn new technologies and be self-starter when it comes to training.

* Build strong customer relationships and become a trusted advisor.

* Typically, 10-15+ years’ experience.

**Knowledge And Skills**

* A deep understanding of one or more of the following areas of enterprise networking
* Modern enterprise network design, implementation and troubleshooting, including DNS, DHCP, spanning tree, network access control technologies, including 802.1X, IGRP routing protocols and remote access technologies including IPSec and/or SSL VPN.
* WAN/Data Center Design including IGRP and EGRP Routing Protocols, Spine/Leaf topologies and virtualization technologies.
* 802.11 wireless solutions, including design, implementation and troubleshooting in all current industry protocols including 802.11b, 802.11g, 802.11a, 802.11n, 802.11ac and 802.11ax.
* Security solutions, including IPSec, SSL/TLS, Public Key Infrastructure/Certificates, 802.1X, radius and LDAP directories, as well as how they are implemented in networking environments to meet the needs of the modern enterprise.

title: Engineering - Systems Analyst
description:
**About Us:**
Barry-Wehmiller is a diversified global supplier of engineering consulting and manufacturing technology for the packaging, corrugating, sheeting and paper-converting industries. By blending people-centric leadership with disciplined operational strategies and purpose-driven growth, Barry-Wehmiller has become a $3 billion organization with nearly 12,000 team members united by a common belief: to use the power of business to build a better world.
  
  
**Job Description:**
**Join Us. Build a Better World Through Business.**
At Barry-Wehmiller Companies, we believe business can be a powerful force for good. Headquartered in St. Louis, Missouri, we are a global leader in manufacturing technology and services. Since our founding in 1885 as a maker of brewing machinery, we’ve grown through the acquisition of more than 80 companies, serving industries such as packaging, paper converting, sheeting, corrugating, engineering, and IT consulting. In 2016, we ranked No. 10 on the St. Louis Business Journal list of the city’s Top 150 Privately Held Companies.
  
  
What truly sets us apart is our culture—rooted in Truly Human Leadership, a philosophy that prioritizes the well-being and growth of every individual. We measure success by the way we touch lives, not just by financial results.
  
  
In India, Barry-Wehmiller operates as a hub of innovation and collaboration through our Global Competency Center (GCC) and other strategic functions. The GCC houses centers of excellence in engineering, content management, sourcing, software development, global IT operations, and shared financial services—providing critical support to Barry-Wehmiller divisions worldwide.
  
  
**Our culture is built on:**

* Ownership – Drive features end-to-end, from design to deployment.
* Flexibility – A friendly, results-oriented environment that respects your time.
* Empowerment – Your ideas matter, and your work creates visible impact.
* Learning and Growth – Tackle complex challenges alongside passionate peers, with continuous support for your development.

**Career Development and Global Exposure**
At Barry-Wehmiller, your growth is our priority. You’ll have access to world-class learning programs, leadership development opportunities, and mentorship from industry experts. Our global footprint means you’ll collaborate with teams across continents, gaining exposure to diverse markets, cutting-edge technologies, and best practices from around the world. Whether you aspire to deepen your technical expertise or take on leadership roles, we provide the resources and support to help you thrive.
  
  
If you’re ready to bring your best thinking to a high-impact, future-focused environment—where long-term stability meets start-up agility—and be part of a company that cares deeply about people, we’d love to hear from you.
  
  
**Position Description:**
Under general direction, the Engineering Systems Analyst drives strategies to improve engineering processes and ensure systems and tools are efficient and optimized. The individual will provide functional and technical expertise in identifying, evaluating, and developing systems and procedures that are cost effective and meet user requirements while directly supporting engineering initiatives from the business. They will assist in designing the structure of our engineering systems and carry out programs to ensure the proper architecture is implemented. Provide hands-on experience in software development and be able to manage complex programs. They will also assist in designing, building, and updating database structures and SQL queries. You will then deploy engineering solutions assuring its implementation, effectiveness, adaptability, responsiveness, quality, governance, and the continuous improvement. This role is responsible for providing technical assistance to other engineers. This role also frequently provides guidance to engineering staff, using extensive experience to manage the prioritization, development and completion of technology projects.
  
  
**Principal Duties and Responsibilities (Essential Functions):**

* Maintain and administer PDM and CAD systems, databases, and infrastructure. Optimize systems for efficiency and security.
* Partner with users to understand PDM, CAD, and drafting concerns, troubleshoot issues, and propose process improvements to increase user efficiency and experience.
* Troubleshoot PDM and CAD issues with the end user base. Perform root cause analysis to develop, test, and implement fixes that prevent recurrence.
* Develop and deliver training for PDM and CAD products. Establish and communicate PDM and CAD best practices. Standardize PDM and CAD environments across all workstations.
* Work with IT to develop and support communication protocols between PDM and other data systems as required.
* Manage licenses for PDM and CAD software and add-ons.
* Evaluate, maintain, and develop new tools to support the end user base.
* Evaluate operating systems and upgrades to manage impact on CAD servers and workstations
* Attends and participates, as an ‘ambassador’ for testing, in project meetings regarding solution of the requirements, design, and test plan review.
* Maintain a working knowledge of advancing technologies. Identify applicable solutions and implement with existing networks when appropriate.
* Identify creative ways to reduce cost by streamlining processes and systems (i.e. modification of responsibilities, consolidation or tasks, elimination of non-value added processes and re-engineering processes and systems).
* Drive continuous improvement through trend reporting analysis and metrics management leveraging PowerBI and other similar tools.
* Participate in blueprinting and mapping sessions with customers for PDM, Change Management, and Migrations.
* Analyze requirements and contribute to the design of CAD/PDM solutions to complex requirements
* Design and execute implementations for PDM, Change Management, and Migrations
* Mentor and collaborate with services team members on design, documentation, and implementations
* SQL queries and analysis
* Participate in large project support, system/application implementations and upgrades.
* Assist with the long term migration to standard engineering tools.
* Designing and maintaining custom applications.
* Collaborate with DBAs and Infrastructure teams.

**Job Specifications:**

* Extensive knowledge and experience in Engineering PDM and CAD applications including SolidWorks and Autodesk products
* Broad understanding of the engineering new product development process and how CAD and PDM/PLM play a role within that process.
* Excellent team player.
* Strong logic, problem solving ability, takes initiative.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills

**Required Education and Experience:**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in engineering, IT, or related technical field required
* Typically has 4+ years’ engineering or IT experience
* BlueStar PLM experience preferred

**Supervisory/Responsibility:**

* Indicate if individual contributor w/no direct reports or if supervise direct reports & level of reports (individual contributors, supervisors, managers, etc.)

**Work Environment:**
Works in an office environment but may occasionally be exposed to manufacturing conditions to include noise, fumes, Odors, gases, dust, and hazards such as moving mechanical and electrical machinery. Required Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) will be provided to mitigate or eliminate these hazards and all employees will be trained on appropriate use of PPE.
  
  
**Position Type:**
This is a regular, full-time position with the understanding that a regular workweek will require extended days and hours as needed to meet business needs.
  
  
**Travel:**
No travel is expected for this position
  
  
**Physical Demands:**
OFFICE
  
  
The physical demands described here are representative of the those performed in the job duties. The employee sits at a desk and uses a computer for prolonged periods of time. Performing the role frequently uses close vision, speech, hearing, and dexterity to operate office equipment. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 15 pounds.

**About SRM Tech**

SRM Technologies is a global digital and engineering partner delivering capabilities across data and AI, enterprise platforms, embedded and platform engineering, supply chain, and design-to-manufacturing services.

We work across high-impact industries such as Mobility, Life Sciences, Healthcare, and Logistics, supporting enterprises across North America, APAC, and Europe in building intelligent, future-ready ecosystems and driving transformation at scale.

At SRM Tech, every contribution matters, and we are always looking for passionate individuals who are eager to shape their careers with us.

**Work Mode**
: Rotating 4-day on / 3-day off shift, 32 hrs/week, part of 24/7 coverage across three 8-hour shifts

Work location : Chennai , WFO.

**Preferred Experience**
: 5 - 10 years

**What You'll Do**

* Serve as Incident Commander for Sev 1–4 incidents, owning coordination,
* communication, and resolution from declaration to closure.
* Perform initial triage — gather basic diagnostics, follow runbooks — then escalate to the
* right owner with a clear summary of findings and impact.
* Own the incident retro process: scheduling, facilitating blameless postmortems, and
* driving action items to closure.
* Debrief with engineering teams each shift to capture lessons learned and flag process
* gaps.
* Create and maintain incident playbooks with SMEs, keeping documentation current.
* Lead monthly dry runs and readiness exercises across teams.
* Facilitate weekly on-call debriefs to surface pain points and track improvement tickets.
* Report incident metrics (MTTR, retro completion time) to leadership on a regular
* cadence.
* Support operational governance, including change management reviews.

**What You Bring**

* Experience leading incident response as an Incident Commander or Major Incident
* Manager during high-severity outages.
* Strong composure and decision-making under pressure, able to direct SMEs without
* being the deepest technical expert.
* Excellent communication skills, translating technical situations for engineers and
* executives alike.
* Experience running structured postmortems or root-cause analysis.
* Strong organizational skills to track multiple action items and deadlines.
* Ability to follow documented playbooks and exercise judgement regarding the need for
* escalation.
* Experience with Jira/Confluence for incident tracking and documentation.
* Ability to work rotating shifts, including nights/weekends.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Background in IT service management, operations, or program management.
* Familiarity with basic monitoring/dashboard concepts.
* Experience facilitating cross-functional meetings or change initiatives.
* Data analysis or reporting experience for leadership updates.
* ITIL certification or equivalent incident/problem management training

title: Security Managed Services Engineer (L2)
description:
**Make an impact with NTT DATA**
Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.
  
  
**Your day at NTT DATA**
As a Security Managed Services Engineer (L2) at NTT DATA, your role will be to ensure that our clients' security infrastructures and systems remain operational. With a proactive approach, you'll monitor, identify, investigate, and resolve technical incidents and problems, restoring service efficiently. Your primary objective will be to handle client requests or tickets with technical expertise, ensuring they are resolved within the agreed service level agreement (SLA).
  
  
You'll actively manage work queues, perform operational tasks, and update tickets with resolution actions. By identifying issues and errors early on, you'll log incidents promptly and provide second-level support, communicating effectively with other teams and clients to extend support when needed. Your role includes executing changes responsibly, flagging risks and mitigation plans, and ensuring all changes have proper approvals.
  
  
Collaborative efforts are at the heart of this role. You'll work closely with automation teams to optimize efforts and automate routine tasks, ensuring seamless handovers during shift changes. Your analytical skills will be key in auditing incident and request tickets for quality, recommending improvements, and contributing to trend analysis reports to identify automation opportunities.
  
  
As a go-to for initial client escalations, you'll assist L1 Security Engineers with triage and troubleshooting, and support project work when required. Your contributions to the change management process will ensure thorough documentation, effective planning and execution of maintenance activities, and compliance with standard procedures.
  
  
**To thrive in this role, you need to have:**

* Experience with managed services handling security infrastructure and working knowledge of ticketing tools, preferably ServiceNow.
* Proficiency in active listening, with techniques like paraphrasing and probing for further information.
* Excellent planning skills, able to anticipate and adjust to changing circumstances.
* Strong ability to communicate and engage across different cultures and social groups.
* Adaptability to changing conditions and flexibility in approach.
* Client-focused mindset, always putting their needs and positive experience first.
* A positive outlook and the ability to work well under pressure.
* Willingness to put in longer hours when necessary.

On-site Working

title: IAM Operations Specialist
description:
**Job Description:**
IAM Operations Specialist
  
  
**Location:**
Pune / Mumbai / Bangalore / Chennai / Hyderabad / Noida
  
  
**Experience Required:**
11–15 Years
  
  
**Number of Positions:**
1
  
  
**Client Interview:**
No
  
  
**Primary Skill:**
IAM Operations
  
  
**Technical Skills:**
Entra ID / OKTA / CyberArk L2
  
  
**Prerequisite Skill:**
IAM Operations
  
  
**Job Summary**
We are seeking an experienced IAM Operations Lead/Specialist to oversee offshore operations, drive service level compliance, and manage end-to-end L2 support for Identity and Access Management (IAM) systems. This role requires strong hands-on experience with core IAM platforms (Entra ID, Okta, CyberArk), operational governance, team leadership, and scripting capabilities to drive process improvements and automation.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Oversee offshore operations team handling IAM L2 support.
* Ensure SLA compliance and maintain high quality in request handling.
* Coordinate with the Global Service Desk and other IT teams for escalations.
* Manage workload distribution and monitor team performance metrics.
* Create and manage shift rosters to ensure continuous coverage.
* Define and maintain operational processes, including tracking and managing the ticket queue.
* Drive process improvements in account creation, access provisioning, and directory services.
* Act as the primary point of contact for offshore escalations and ensure proper redirection of invalid requests.
* Collaborate with senior engineers (L3) to troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues.
* Maintain ticket management hygiene by assigning, reassigning, or escalating tickets to the correct owners and queues.
* Create ServiceNow dashboards and generate operational reports on SLA compliance.
* Perform detailed ticket analysis to suggest system improvements and automation opportunities.

**Requirements & Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* 8–10+ years of dedicated experience in IT operations and Identity and Access Management (IAM).
* Proven leadership experience in managing offshore operational teams.
* Strong working knowledge of IAM tools including Entra ID, Okta, and CyberArk.
* Solid understanding of the broader ecosystem, including Active Directory (AD/AAD), ServiceNow, and HR Systems integration.
* Hands-on experience with PowerShell scripting for automation features and Postman for API testing and troubleshooting.
* Excellent communication, reporting, and stakeholder management skills.

title: Solution Engineer
description:
**Your role**
**What You'll Be Doing**
Solution Engineer
  
  
What We Need
  
  
Corpay is seeking a Solutions Engineer for our Cross-Border division, within the Corporate Payments line of business department, located in Chennai, India.
**Reports to:**
Payment Solutions Manager (Chennai)
  
  
**About Corpay Cross-Border**
Corpay Cross-Border helps businesses move money globally, manage currency risk, and streamline international payments. Our technology supports customers operating across markets, currencies, and regulatory environments, where reliability, security, and scale matter every day.
  
  
As part of Corpay, Inc. (NYSE: CPAY), a global corporate payments company, we combine the pace of a product-led technology team with the reach and stability of a global financial services business. To learn more, visit Payments.corpay.com/cross-border.
  
  
How We Work
  
  
As a Solutions Engineer at Corpay, Corpay will set you up for success by providing:
  
  

* Assigned workspace in our Chennai office
* Company-issued equipment
* Formal, hands-on training

Role Overview
  
  
As a Solutions Engineer at Corpay Cross-Border, you will support the technical onboarding and implementation of clients integrating with Corpay's digital payment and FX solutions.
  
  
The role will primarily support clients and internal stakeholders across North America, with working hours aligned to the US Eastern Time (ET) timezone, while also providing technical support to client implementations and initiatives across other global regions as required.
  
  
You will work closely with Technical Sales Consultants and other Payment Solutions teams to support clients across integration modalities including REST APIs, File Upload, SFTP, ERP and other digital payment capabilities. The role requires strong technical aptitude, analytical problem-solving skills and the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  
  
In addition to client implementations, Solutions Engineering is regularly relied upon to support special projects, new product initiatives and ad-hoc business requirements. The successful candidate should therefore be comfortable working across a variety of technical challenges and adapting to evolving business priorities.
  
  
The position will be primarily remote; however, the successful candidate will initially attend the Chennai office for induction and training and will be expected to attend occasionally thereafter for team meetings, training and other business requirements.
  
  
Role Responsibilities
  
  
**The Responsibilities Of The Role Will Include**
Client Implementation & Solutioning
  
  

* Support end-to-end technical implementation activities from onboarding through testing, certification and Production go-live.
* Support clients integrating through Corpay's REST APIs, File Upload, SFTP, ERP and other supported integration modalities.
* Participate in technical discovery and solutioning discussions to understand client requirements and determine appropriate implementation approaches.
* Support clients with test environment setup, configuration and integration readiness activities.
* Provide clear and timely responses to client and internal technical implementation questions.
* Support certification testing, Production readiness and post-go-live warranty activities to ensure successful client adoption.
* Take ownership of assigned implementation activities while escalating complex technical or delivery risks appropriately.
* Maintain accurate and timely implementation documentation and project updates.

Technical Analysis & Troubleshooting
  
  

* Investigate integration, configuration and implementation issues using appropriate diagnostic tools and available system information.
* Analyse API requests and responses, file structures, payment workflows, logs and other technical data to identify potential causes and solutions.
* Work collaboratively with Technical Sales, Product, Engineering, Client Engagement, Support and other teams to resolve technical blockers.
* Clearly document technical findings, troubleshooting steps and recommended solutions.
* Contribute to testing and validation of new or enhanced product capabilities where Solutions Engineering support is required.

Global Team & Stakeholder Collaboration
  
  

* Work closely with Technical Sales Consultants and the Solutions Engineering Lead to support successful client delivery across North America and, where required, other global regions.
* Collaborate effectively with colleagues across different geographies and time zones.
* Share lessons learned, technical knowledge and implementation best practices with the wider Solutions Engineering team.
* Contribute to team documentation, implementation standards and knowledge-sharing initiatives.
* Maintain effective communication with North American stakeholders while remaining connected to the wider Chennai and global Payment Solutions organisation.

Special Projects, Automation & Continuous Improvement
  
  

* Support special and ad-hoc business initiatives requiring technical analysis, implementation support, testing, reporting or other Solutions Engineering expertise.
* Support Product and other stakeholders with the testing, analysis and rollout of new technical capabilities where appropriate.
* Identify opportunities to improve implementation and business processes through automation and improved tooling.
* Develop, maintain or enhance automated workflows using tools such as Microsoft Power Automate where appropriate.
* Work with stakeholders to understand automation requirements and translate them into practical and supportable solutions.
* Identify opportunities to reduce manual effort and improve operational efficiency, scalability and delivery quality.
* Contribute to the continued standardisation and improvement of Solutions Engineering processes, documentation and implementation approaches.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* 3–5 years of experience in Solutions Engineering, Technical Sales, implementation consulting, technical support, or a comparable client-facing technical role, ideally within payments, fintech or financial services.
* Demonstrated ability to work independently, take ownership of client-facing technical issues and implementations, and exercise sound judgement when determining when escalation is required.
* Hands-on experience with REST APIs, file-based integrations, SFTP and/or ERP solutions.
* Strong troubleshooting, analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Experience using tools such as Postman, SQL, Kibana, SEQ, Jira, Confluence or equivalent would be advantageous.
* Experience within payments, fintech, banking or financial services would be advantageous.
* Experience supporting North American clients or working across US time zones would be beneficial.
* Exposure to workflow automation tools such as Microsoft Power Automate or equivalent would be advantageous.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities effectively while maintaining ownership of assigned deliverables.
* Ability to adapt to ad-hoc projects, new technical requirements and changing business priorities.
* Strong organisational skills with attention to delivery timelines, quality and stakeholder communication.

Benefits & Perks
  
  

* Leaves: Earned, sick, casual, national holidays, maternity, paternity, bereavement, and adoption/surrogacy leave.
* Medical & Insurance: Group medical coverage for self and dependents; personal accident insurance.
* Wellness & Health: Wellness allowance and annual health check-ups for self and family.
* Tech & Meals: Broadband reimbursement and meal card support.
* Commute & Retirement: Commuting allowance, provident fund, gratuity, voluntary provident fund, and pension.
* Culture & Engagement: Support for philanthropic initiatives, fun contests, and an inclusive work environment.

**About Corpay**
**About Corpay**
Corpay is a global technology organization that is leading the future of commercial payments with a culture of innovation that drives us to constantly create new and better ways to pay. Our specialized payment solutions help businesses control, simplify, and secure payment for fuel, general payables, toll and lodging expenses. Millions of people in over 80 countries around the world use our solutions for their payments.
