title: SPE-CX-Backoffice Helpdesk
description:
**Job Summary**
This role focuses on delivering responsive backoffice helpdesk support within a high tech environment ensuring efficient resolution of issues for internal and external stakeholders. The specialist will use strong spoken English communication and analytical skills to manage tickets support cross functional teams and uphold service quality. The position is work from office with rotational shifts and enables meaningful impact on customer satisfaction and operational excellence.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Handle backoffice helpdesk tickets with accuracy and empathy ensuring timely resolution of issues that directly improve service reliability and overall customer satisfaction.
* Provide clear spoken English communication during interactions with internal teams and external stakeholders promoting transparency and trust in every support engagement.
* Maintain detailed documentation of incidents requests and resolutions in the ticketing system supporting data driven improvements and audit ready operational records.
* Coordinate with high tech product and engineering teams to clarify complex issues enabling faster root cause analysis and reduced downtime for critical services.
* Monitor queues and prioritize tasks based on impact and urgency helping the organization maintain stable operations and meet agreed service commitments.
* Collaborate with cross functional colleagues in finance operations and customer service to resolve multi dimensional problems that affect customer experience and business continuity.
* Apply analytical thinking to identify recurring problems in high tech processes contributing insights that guide preventive actions and long term optimization efforts.
* Follow established standard operating procedures and compliance guidelines reinforcing consistent and secure handling of data and sensitive information.
* Escalate high impact incidents to appropriate levels with structured summaries and clear spoken explanations ensuring rapid response and informed decision making.
* Support rotational shift operations by maintaining reliable attendance and handover practices enabling seamless continuity of support across different time windows.
* Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives by suggesting enhancements in workflows tools and knowledge base content that benefit both the company and its customers.
* Assist in training new team members on helpdesk systems and communication standards strengthening team capability and overall support performance.
* Engage in periodic quality reviews and feedback sessions using findings to refine personal performance and elevate the consistency of customer outcomes.

**Qualifications**

* Demonstrate strong spoken English proficiency with the ability to explain technical and procedural information in a clear and accessible manner to diverse audiences.
* Show proven experience of two to five years in a high tech or technology oriented support environment handling backoffice or helpdesk responsibilities.
* Exhibit familiarity with ticketing tools and basic office productivity applications enabling efficient logging tracking and reporting of support activities.
* Display solid problem solving skills and attention to detail that support accurate issue analysis and effective resolution within defined timeframes.
* Maintain adaptability for rotational shifts and fast paced high tech operations showing resilience and focus during changing workloads and priorities.
* Possess strong collaboration and interpersonal skills that enable effective coordination with technical and nontechnical stakeholders across the organization.
* Illustrate customer centric thinking and ethical conduct ensuring all actions contribute to trustworthy service organizational reputation and positive societal impact.

**Certifications Required**
Preferred certifications include customer service or helpdesk specific credentials such as HDI Customer Service Representative or equivalent.

description:
**Presidio, Where Teamwork and Innovation Shape the Future**
At Presidio, we're at the forefront of a global technology revolution, transforming industries through cutting-edge digital solutions and next-generation AI. We empower businesses - and their internal customers - to achieve more through innovation, automation, and intelligent insights.

The Mobile Device Management (MDM) Engineer is responsible for monitoring, managing and supporting customer mobile device environments using the NinjaOne platform under the guidance of the MDM Team Lead. This role serves as the primary point of contact for assigned incidents and service requests, maintaining ownership through resolution while ensuring compliance with contracted SLAs.
  
  
The ideal candidate is customer focused, technically skilled and thrives in a fast paced operations environment. This position requires shift flexibility, including participation in rotating on call schedules and the ability to work varying shifts as business needs evolve.
  
  
The MDM Engineer will regularly collaborate with customers, peers, vendors and leadership through phone, email, chat, video conferencing and ticketing systems such as ServiceNow to ensure timely and effective issue resolution.

* Monitor and manage enrolled mobile devices across iOS, Android and Windows platforms using the NinjaOne MDM platform.

* Administer device configuration profiles, security policies and compliance baselines within NinjaOne to enforce organizational standards across managed endpoints.

* Experience with PowerShell or scripting tools for automating device management tasks and reporting.

* Adaptability and flexibility

title: System Integrator
description:
**Job Summary**
We are looking for a System Integrator with hands-on experience in network infrastructure implementation, integration, and troubleshooting. The candidate will be responsible for deploying and integrating network devices, switches, firewalls, load balancers, authentication systems, and monitoring solutions to ensure seamless connectivity, security, and high availability across enterprise environments.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Implement and integrate enterprise network infrastructure based on HLD and LLD documents.
* Install, configure, and integrate network switches and routers from Cisco, HPE, Aruba, and Juniper.
* Configure VLANs, Layer 2/Layer 3 switching, inter-VLAN routing, STP, VRRP, BGP, and link aggregation.
* Install and configure Fortinet FortiGate and SonicWALL firewalls, including security policies, firewall rules, and access controls.
* Configure and integrate F5 BIG-IP LTM load balancers, including virtual servers, pools, and health monitors.
* Integrate network devices with RADIUS/ISE authentication and SNMP-based monitoring platforms.
* Perform connectivity testing, integration testing, troubleshooting, and issue resolution during deployment.
* Coordinate with customers, vendors, and internal technical teams for implementation and system integration activities.

title: Senior Technical Support Engineer
description:
**Tier 2 — Technical Support Engineer**

**Job Description**

**Additional CSR Qualifications / Requirements / Waivers**

**Tier 2 — Technical Support Engineer:**

* Proficient in Networking (Layer 2 & 3 topology, networking hardware, cabling, WAPs, routing protocols)
* Proficient in VoIP technologies (QoS, SIP Flow, Codec Negotiations, RTP, DTMF, SIP traces)
* Strong communication skills and a customer-first attitude
* High attention to detail with the ability to manage multiple complex cases simultaneously
* Ability to:
* Independently develop solutions to complex technical, process, and systems problems
* Thrive in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment
* Perform advanced root cause analysis and drive issues to resolution
* CCNA, Network+, or equivalent networking certification preferred

**Job Description**

**Why this role matters**
To customers, Tier 2 Technical Support Engineers are the escalation backbone of our support organization. When Tier 1 specialists encounter issues beyond initial troubleshooting, our Tier 2 engineers’ step in to own the resolution. We go deeper — into SIP traces, network captures, platform configurations, and engineering-level diagnostics — to deliver the answers our customers and teammates need. The Technical Support Engineer is a mid-level, high-impact position requiring strong technical aptitude and independent problem-solving.

IF THIS SOUNDS LIKE YOU, CONTINUE READING BELOW…….

**What you will do**

* Serve as the primary escalation point for Tier 1 Technical Support Specialists, receiving and owning complex cases that require advanced technical investigation.
* Perform in-depth troubleshooting on call quality, call completion, SIP registration, call flow builds, features, and network-related issues across the platform.
* Analyze SIP traces, packet captures (PCAPs), and platform logs to diagnose and resolve voice and network issues.
* Independently resolve complex issues and collaborate with Tier 3 engineers, Voice Engineering, and Advanced Operations Support (AOS) on issues requiring escalated technical expertise.
* Manage and drive cases to resolution, ensuring timely updates to customers and adherence to SLA commitments.
* Follow up with customers and Tier 1 agents to confirm resolution and ensure a high level of satisfaction.
* Document customer issues, troubleshooting steps, and resolutions thoroughly within the ticketing system.
* Identify trends, recurring issues, and systemic problems; escalate patterns to management and Tier 3 for root cause analysis.
* Contribute to the development of internal knowledge base articles (IKBs) and training materials for Tier 1 upskilling.
* Participate in on-call rotation for after-hours and weekend support coverage.
* Mentor and coach Tier 1 team members on advanced troubleshooting methodologies and platform knowledge.

**What you will bring**

* Proficient knowledge of Networking (Layer 2 & 3 topology, networking hardware, cabling, WAPs, routing protocols such as OSPF/BGP).
* Strong working knowledge of VoIP technologies (QoS, SIP Flow, Codec Negotiations, RTP, DTMF, PCAP analysis).
* Experience troubleshooting within an IP/VoIP environment, including SIP registration, call routing, and call quality diagnostics.
* Familiarity with the Broad Works/BroadSoft hosted voice platform.
* Strong communication skills — both written and verbal — with the ability to manage difficult customer conversations professionally.
* Highly detail-oriented with strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to:
* Manage multiple complex escalations simultaneously while maintaining quality and accuracy.
* Work independently and collaboratively across teams.
* Mentor junior team members and share knowledge proactively.
* Thrive in a fast-paced, customer-facing environment with tight SLA requirements.

**What is required for application?**

**Required**

* 2+ years of experience in technical support or network engineering role.
* CCNA, Network+, or equivalent networking certification, or equivalent demonstrated experience.
* Hands-on experience with SIP, TCP/IP, VoIP, and LAN/WAN troubleshooting.

**Preferred**

* Associate's or Bachelor's degree in a technical field.
* Hands-on experience with Cisco and other networking equipment.
* Experience reading and interpreting SIP traces and PCAP files.
* Prior experience supporting enterprise-level customers in a tiered support model.

title: Advanced Operations Technician (AOT)
description:
**Job Description — Advanced Operations Technician (AOT)**

**Role Summary**

The Advanced Operations Technician (AOT) is the critical first line of escalation within the Advanced Operations Support (AOS) organization. When Customer Care teams encounter carrier-related voice issues that cannot be resolved at the front line, the AOT steps in to investigate, engage directly with carriers, and drive issues toward resolution. This role is the connective tissue between Customer Care and carrier partners — ensuring customers experience reliable, high-quality voice services. When issues require deeper platform or engineering-level investigation, the AOT escalates to the Advanced Operations Engineering (AOE) team, ensuring the right expertise is applied at every step.

**What You Will Do**

* Serve as the primary escalation point of contact for front-line Customer Care teams for carrier-related voice issues, including inbound/outbound call completion, call quality, and Caller ID/CNAM problems.
* Receive, triage, prioritize, and manage escalation tickets submitted via ticketing system across all lines of business.
* Investigate carrier-side issues by analyzing call samples, SIP responses, PCAP files, and routing data using tools such as Spearline, Empirix, and VoIP Monitor.
* Open and manage external carrier escalation tickets, communicate with carrier NOC/support teams, and drive issues to resolution.
* Update all assigned tickets at a minimum of every 24 hours; escalate carrier tickets that require deeper investigation or routing changes.
* Identify ticket trends — when multiple customers report similar issues, flag for Epic creation and notify the AOS team for coordinated response.
* Escalate issues requiring Development, Product, or Engineering team involvement to the Advanced Operations Engineering (AOE) team, including a clear summary of the issue, steps taken, and outstanding questions.
* Follow all AOS Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for ticket handling, case statuses, Epic management, improper ticket identification, and carrier escalation workflows.
* Maintain awareness of active incidents and monitor relevant communication channels to ensure real-time coordination with Care teams.
* Participate in holiday and weekend coverage rotation as required by the AOS team schedule.
* Contribute to knowledge sharing and after-action reviews when complex issues are resolved, to support continued team learning and process improvement.

**What You Will Bring**

* Working knowledge of VoIP technologies including SIP, RTP, inbound/outbound call flows, and Caller ID/CNAM.
* Familiarity with carrier operations, routing principles, and the carrier escalation process.
* Ability to read and interpret call samples, SIP error responses (e.g., 503, 404), and basic routing data.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills for interacting with carrier partners and internal teams.
* Highly organized with the ability to manage a high volume of concurrent tickets while maintaining SLA compliance.
* Ability to:
* Work both independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced, 24/7 operations environment.
* Identify patterns across tickets and escalate systemic issues appropriately.
* Follow structured SOPs and contribute to continuous process improvement.

**Requirements**

**Required**

* 1–2 years of experience in a technical support, network operations, or telecommunications role.
* Familiarity with VoIP/SIP technologies and inbound/outbound call flows.
* Experience using ticketing systems (JIRA, Salesforce, or equivalent) for case management.

**Preferred**

* Associate's or Bachelor's degree in a technical field.
* Network+ or equivalent certification.
* Experience working with telecom carriers or in a carrier operations/NOC environment.
* Familiarity with tools used for VoIP monitoring or routing platforms.
* Prior experience in a tiered support model with defined escalation paths.

**Position Summary**

The Human Capital Offering Portfolio focuses on helping organizations manage and sustain their performance through their most important asset: their people. Sr. Consultant

**The team:**

* Technical experience in understanding extensions and customizations along with complex integrations is added advantage.

* Ability to work in teams and interact across all levels

title: Privacy Support Analyst
description:
**About Gen**
Gen is a global company dedicated to powering Digital Freedom through its trusted consumer brands including Norton, Avast, LifeLock, MoneyLion and more. Our combined heritage is rooted in financial empowerment and cyber safety for the first digital generations, and today we deliver award-winning cybersecurity, online privacy, identity protection and financial wellness solutions to nearly 500 million users in more than 150 countries.
  
  
Together, we share a collective passion and vision to protect consumers and help them grow, manage and secure their digital and financial lives. We’re always looking for smart, fearless and high-impact talent who see AI as a teammate – leveraging it to move faster and deliver meaningful results.
  
  
When you’re part of Gen, you’ll have the flexibility, tools and support to do your best work and grow your career – from flexible working options and time off to competitive pay, benefits and well-being programs.
  
  
At Gen, we are scrappy and relentlessly customer driven. We create room for healthy debate, experimentation and continuous learning, and we seek out people with different experiences, identities and ideas to join our team. You’ll work with people who back each other, respect each other and understand that our differences are a competitive advantage.
  
  
If this sounds like you, we’d love you to be part of Gen.
  
  
**About The Role**
The Associate Business Operations Analyst protects the profitability of the organization by providing world-class service support and 100% accuracy in member fulfillment. This role will consist of customer requests that require manual intervention and delivery of services while following strict PCI guidelines and meeting established service level agreements. * Follow established procedures to accurately process member opt-out requests across supported data brokers within defined SLAs.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Process high volumes of member opt-out requests with exceptional speed, typing accuracy, and attention to detail by navigating multiple data broker websites, completing web-based forms, and following broker-specific opt-out workflows while consistently meeting productivity, quality, and SLA targets.
* Respond to member requests and inquiries promptly and effectively using Salesforce (SFDC).

* Surface data-driven recommendations to simplify processes, reduce manual effort, and improve the customer experience.
* Collaborate with internal teams and external partners when fulfilment activities involve third-party platforms.
* Leverage AI and automation tools (e.g., AI assistants, AI-enabled spreadsheet/BI features, and knowledge management tools) to improve productivity, analyse data, and support documentation while ensuring appropriate human review.
* Demonstrate consistent, reliable, and responsive performance with minimal supervision.
* Identify and report patterns in system issues, process deviations, and operational risks to management.
* Stay current with product updates, services, marketing promotions, and operational procedures.
* Demonstrate adaptability to evolving programs, policies, and business priorities.
* Apply sound problem-solving, analytical thinking, and deductive reasoning skills to resolve operational issues.
* Exhibit strong organizational skills and the ability to effectively manage multiple priorities.
* Maintain a thorough understanding of Gen's policies, procedures, and products while consistently delivering an exceptional customer experience.
* Participate in or lead operational projects as needed, identify training opportunities, and collaborate with regional and cross-functional teams to resolve process-related issues.
* About You:
* Customer Service experience or Privacy operations
* Strong proficiency with Salesforce, ServiceNow/Jira, and contact centre platforms.
* Self-directed and self-motivated – able to work independently on a variety of tasks.
* Must be well organized and able to effectively manage own time.
* Excellent typing speed, data entry accuracy, and attention to detail, with the ability to efficiently process high volumes of repetitive, process-driven tasks involving web-based form completion and adherence to standardized multi-step opt-out workflows while consistently meeting productivity, quality, and SLA targets.
* Demonstrated ability to stay calm, professional, and solutions-oriented under pressure and tight deadlines.
* Must possess excellent communication skills, including verbal, written, interpersonal, and coaching.
* Ability and desire to effectively multitask and adapt to changing workloads in a fast-paced support environment.
* Comfortable working in a structured, ticket-driven environment with a strong focus on accurate documentation and process compliance.
* Demonstrated ability to think critically and analyze and interpret data independently

title: Implementation Senior Analyst
description:
Join us as we work to create a thriving ecosystem that delivers accessible, high-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all.
  
  
The
**Senior Analyst**
is responsible for leading complex, customer-facing technical projects from discovery through delivery. This role partners closely with clients and internal teams to define scope, shape implementation strategy, manage day-to-day execution, and ensure successful outcomes across multiple concurrent initiatives.
  
  
The ideal candidate combines strong project management and client communication skills with enough technical depth to support data analysis, troubleshooting, and scripting work as needed. This role requires someone who can confidently lead critical customer conversations, manage expectations, navigate ambiguity, and drive progress in a fast-paced environment.
  
  
Team Summary
  
  
The team supports customer-facing technical project delivery, implementation execution, and cross-functional coordination across internal and external stakeholders. Team members work together to manage complex engagements, resolve issues, support delivery quality, and improve customer outcomes.
  
  
The environment values clear communication, accountability, collaboration, and the ability to move between project management, data analysis, and technical problem-solving as needed.
  
  
**Essential Job Responsibilities**

* Lead end-to-end technical projects, including discovery, scoping, planning, execution, testing, implementation, and post-go-live support.
* Own customer-facing project conversations, including strategy sessions, status updates, risk management discussions, issue resolution, and executive-level stakeholder communication.
* Drive project scoping and strategy by translating customer needs into clear requirements, timelines, deliverables, and execution plans.
* Manage day-to-day project operations, including timelines, dependencies, action items, escalations, and cross-functional coordination.
* Partner with clients and internal stakeholders to align on goals, priorities, assumptions, and implementation approach.
* Analyze and validate data to support project decisions, troubleshoot issues, and confirm successful delivery.
* Write and maintain SQL queries to extract, validate, reconcile, and analyze data as needed.
* Develop Python scripts or utilities to streamline analysis, automate repetitive work, or support technical troubleshooting.
* Identify technical, operational, and data-related risks early and drive mitigation plans.
* Resolve complex issues involving data discrepancies, workflow mismatches, integration challenges, or process breakdowns.
* Document project scope, requirements, decisions, risks, and outcomes in a clear and organized manner.
* Work closely with engineering, product, operations, and client teams to unblock issues and ensure delivery.
* Manage multiple concurrent projects with competing priorities while maintaining high-quality execution.
* Recommend process improvements and contribute to scalable delivery methods and operational excellence.
* Serve as a trusted advisor to customers, helping them navigate technical complexity and make informed implementation decisions.
* Support onboarding or mentoring of teammates on project process, technical workflows, and best practices.
* Use AI-assisted tools to accelerate analysis, support scripting and troubleshooting, and improve project documentation while applying human judgment to verify outputs.
* Perform other duties as assigned to support team objectives and customer success.

**Additional Job Responsibilities**

* Contribute to process improvements that strengthen delivery consistency and operational excellence.
* Support collaboration across distributed teams and time zones.
* Assist in maintaining effective project reporting, tracking, and communication practices.
* Participate in knowledge sharing and best-practice development across the team.
* Help support scalable methods for managing complex customer-facing technical work.

Expected Education & Experience
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, computer science, information systems, science, or a related field.
* 5+ years of experience in technical project management, implementation, healthcare IT, and data migration.
* Strong experience managing customer-facing technical engagements and critical stakeholder conversations.
* Proven ability to drive scoping, planning, and strategy for complex technical projects.
* Hands-on experience managing projects end to end in a fast-paced environment.
* Proficiency in SQL for data querying, validation, reconciliation, and analysis.
* Experience with Python scripting for automation, data handling, or technical analysis is preferred.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with exceptional attention to detail.
* Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to engage technical and non-technical audiences.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines independently.
* Comfort working with distributed teams across geographies and time zones.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and other standard project or data tools.
* Experience with Salesforce, Smartsheet, Jira, or similar tools is a plus.
* Ability to adapt quickly, operate with urgency, and thrive in a collaborative environment.
* Experience in US healthcare, health IT, or EHR-related work is required.
* PMP certification is an added advantage.

Toku combines local strategic consulting expertise, bespoke technology, regional in-country infrastructure, connectivity, and global reach to serve the diverse needs of enterprises operating at scale. Headquartered in Singapore, Toku supports customers across APAC and beyond, with a growing footprint across global markets.

Our Network Operations Centre (NOC) is Toku’s primary line of service assurance. As a NOC Engineer, you will monitor our voice and CCaaS environment, investigate incidents, perform first-level troubleshooting and ensure issues are resolved or escalated quickly to the right teams. This is a hands-on telecom operations role where strong VoIP/SIP fundamentals, structured incident handling and operational discipline are more important than deep engineering expertise. You will thrive in this role if you stay composed during incidents, take ownership of your work and are proactive about learning and improving how things are done.

**What you will be doing**

* **Network Monitoring & Service Assurance:**
  Monitor Toku’s voice and CCaaS environment, including voice quality, service availability, capacity, carrier connectivity and operational alerts.
* **Incident Management & Triage:**
  Detect, record, classify and prioritise incidents, perform initial investigation and ensure issues are resolved at first level where possible or quickly escalated to the appropriate internal or external team.
* **VoIP & SIP Troubleshooting:**
  Investigate common voice issues such as call failures, audio quality, dropped calls, registration faults and signalling issues using SIP traces, packet captures and monitoring data.
* **Major Incident Response:**
  Follow defined processes for P1/P2 incidents, including incident bridges, timely escalation, stakeholder communication and accurate incident documentation.
* **Runbook Execution:**
  Follow established runbooks and operational procedures for known failure scenarios, including first-level remediation, route failover and traffic rerouting where applicable.
* **Voice Quality & Capacity Monitoring:**
  Track voice and network performance indicators such as jitter, latency and packet loss, identifying degradation or capacity constraints requiring action.
* **Interconnect Support:**
  Monitor interconnect performance, raise and manage fault tickets, and support routing, SIP trunking, number provisioning and interconnect activities where required.
* **CCaaS Platform Operations:**
  Monitor contact centre services including voice, queueing, routing, agent registration, call recording and integrations, resolving or escalating operational issues as appropriate.
* **Change & Problem Management:**
  Support planned changes and maintenance, participate in root cause analysis and post-incident reviews, and help identify recurring issues and opportunities to improve monitoring and operational processes.
* **Documentation & Handover:**
  Maintain clear incident records, ticket updates, runbooks and shift handovers, ensuring information is accurate and useful to colleagues, customers and other technical teams.
* **Continuous Improvement & Automation:**
  Contribute ideas for improving monitoring and repetitive operational tasks, using basic scripting or automation where appropriate.
* **Shift-Based Operations:**
  Work within a rotating 24/7 roster, including weekends, as part of Toku’s Chennai-based NOC operation.

**We’d love to hear from you if you have**

* **Relevant Experience:**
  Around three years of experience in a NOC, telecom operations, voice operations or VoIP support environment.
* **VoIP & SIP Fundamentals:**
  Hands-on understanding of SIP and VoIP technologies, including SIP call flows, common codecs and practical voice troubleshooting.
* **Troubleshooting Capability:**
  Practical experience investigating incidents using SIP traces, and monitoring tools.
* **Networking Fundamentals:**
  Working knowledge of networking concepts relevant to voice services, including routing, firewalls and VPNs.
* **Incident & Process Discipline:**
  Experience working within structured incident processes, including prioritisation, escalation, documentation, handover and following established runbooks or SOPs.
* **Linux Fundamentals:**
  Basic confidence using the Linux command line to follow diagnostic procedures, review logs and execute operational commands.
* **Monitoring Tools:**
  Experience using and interpreting operational monitoring tools and dashboards. Administration-level expertise is not required.
* **Communication:**
  Clear written and verbal English, including the ability to provide concise technical updates in tickets and communicate effectively with internal teams, carriers and customers when required.
* **Ownership & Learning Mindset:**
  A reliable, proactive approach to operational work, with the willingness to learn new technologies, support colleagues and contribute to improvements rather than simply follow routine.
* **Shift Flexibility:**
  Availability to work within a rotating 24/7 shift roster, including weekends.
* **Education:**
  A bachelor’s degree or diploma in Telecommunications, Computer Science, Electronics & Communications Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
* **Scripting & Automation – Nice to Have:**
  Basic ability to read, understand or modify scripts, with an interest in automating repetitive operational tasks.
* **Voice Infrastructure – Nice to Have:**
  Experience with SBCs or softswitch platforms
* **Certifications – Nice to Have:**
  Relevant certifications such as CCNA/CCNP Collaboration, Certified SIP Professional, ITIL 4 Foundation or vendor SBC certifications.
* **Languages – Nice to Have:**
  Proficiency in additional Asia Pacific languages.
* **Work Setup:**
  This role is based in Chennai and is primarily work-from-office, full time. Therefore candidates already based in Chennai, or willing to relocate to Chennai is mandatory

Toku has been recognised as a LinkedIn Top Startup and by the Financial Times as one of APAC’s Top 500 High Growth Companies. If you’re looking to be part of a company on a strong growth trajectory while working on meaningful, real-world challenges, we’d love to hear from you.

* Schedule and facilitate a formal Post Incident Review or After-Action Review after the resolution of critical and major incidents.
* Perform extensive problem analysis, paying attention to detail of all current and previous problems to identify repeat issues or possible trends.
* Assign and track actions resulting from Post-Incident Reviews and proactive problem investigations, ensuring accountability and timely completion
* Address process and/or training gaps with applicable teams.
* Support the governance and execution of the Problem Management process and Problem Management lifecycle
* Proactively identify problems based on trend analysis from past incidents & monitoring data associated to possible performance deterioration
* Manage and monitor key metrics (SLA’s and KPI’s) from SES and customer perspective as they pertain to Problem Management
* Creates Executive Level Problem Summary and Reports
* Facilitates Problem Management reviews quarterly to review events with no root cause, continuous improvement items and reviews open tasks to determine relevance
* Perform any other functions or duties assigned to ensure workload balance and support
* Work with operational teams for chronic issues associated outages, bugs, network and service design issues, hardware, and software problems
* Drive processes that enable identification of chronic issues and establish expectations for resolution and prevention of recurring incidents
* Drive future solutions for continuous process improvement, design changes, vendor recommendations, automation capabilities, and process improvement opportunities

* Update and/or archive Knowledge articles associated to the event or workarounds established.

competencies

title: Advanced Associate, Cloud Services Engineer
description:
**Advanced Associate, Cloud Service Engineer**

  
  

**Location:**
Chennai, India (Hybrid)

  
  

**Team:**
Atlassian Administration & Engineering

  
  

**Experience:**
2+ years in Atlassian administration or a related platform engineering role

  
  

**About the Role**

  
  

We’re looking for an Atlassian engineer with a few years of experience to join our Atlassian Administration & Engineering team. You’ll work with a team of seven engineers who support a global Atlassian Cloud platform used by about 10,000–12,000 people around the world, across Jira, Confluence, Jira Product Discovery (JPD), and Jira Service Management (JSM).

  
  

We recently finished a large migration to Atlassian Cloud, and we’re still bringing separate product instances together into one environment. The migration moved fast and left technical debt behind, so we’re now focused on cleanup: removing legacy customizations and making the platform match Atlassian Cloud best practices. You’ll own parts of that work yourself. That means spotting problems, proposing fixes, and building automation that keeps the platform clean and scalable.

  
  

**What You’ll Do**

  

  
* **Platform administration:**
  Take ownership of administration across Jira, Confluence, JPD, and JSM, including permissions, schemes, workflows, custom fields, and space and project configuration.
  
  
* **User lifecycle automation:**
  Design and maintain automated onboarding and offboarding, group management, and license management, working with identity providers and SCIM provisioning.
  
  
* **Space and project lifecycle:**
  Build repeatable, automated processes to create, standardize, and archive projects and spaces at scale.
  
  
* **Reduce legacy customizations:**
  Audit the environment for redundant custom fields, workflows, schemes, and app dependencies. Then propose and carry out plans to remove or consolidate them, using automation wherever possible.
  
  
* **Automation engineering:**
  Build and maintain Atlassian Automation rules for routine and bulk administrative work. Where built-in features fall short, design robust API-driven automation.
  
  
* **Engineering practices:**
  Treat platform automation as production code. Changes are peer-reviewed, tested, and released through a pipeline, not run ad hoc.
  
  
* **AI-assisted engineering:**
  Make AI part of your everyday workflow, from drafting scripts and analyzing configurations to writing documentation, so you deliver more without lowering the quality bar.
  
  
* **Service metrics and observability:**
  Capture service metrics through the Atlassian APIs, store them outside the platform, and build dashboards that show how the service is used and how it’s performing.
  
  
* **Solution evaluation:**
  Weigh built-in Atlassian features against custom or external solutions, and explain clearly why the chosen option is the best fit.
  
  
* **Continuous improvement:**
  Challenge processes that are overly complex, costly, or full of manual toil, and propose simpler, automated alternatives.
  
  
* **Best practices and governance:**
  Help define standards, naming conventions, and configuration guidelines for each product, and document them.
  
  
* **Instance consolidation:**
  Contribute to ongoing migration and consolidation work, including planning, data validation, and post-migration cleanup.
  
  
* **Escalations and mentoring:**
  Resolve complex platform issues, and share knowledge with less experienced teammates and stakeholders.
  

  

**What We’re Looking For**

  
  

**Required:**

  

  
* 2+ years of hands-on administration of Jira and/or Confluence, preferably in Atlassian Cloud
  
  
* Working experience with Atlassian Automation, including building and troubleshooting rules
  
  
* Scripting skills in Python, PowerShell, or a similar language, and experience building automation against REST APIs (including JSON, authentication, pagination, and rate limits)
  
  
* Hands-on experience with Git and version-controlled code or configuration, plus a working understanding of CI/CD practices: build, test, release, versioning, and branching strategies
  
  
* Daily, effective use of AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or Claude, with the judgment to validate, refine, or reject what they produce
  
  
* A solid understanding of Jira configuration: schemes, workflows, screens, fields, and permissions
  
  
* Experience managing users and groups at scale in Atlassian Admin
  
  
* The ability to analyze an existing configuration, recommend simplifications, and explain the trade-offs clearly
  
  
* Clear written and verbal communication in English, and comfort working with stakeholders around the world
  
  
* A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, or a related field, or equivalent experience
  

  

**Nice to have:**

  

  
* Atlassian certifications (ACP-120, ACP-620, or Cloud Organization Admin)
  
  
* Experience with AWS services (such as Timestream, Lambda, or S3) and with dashboards in Grafana or similar tools
  
  
* Experience administering JSM (request types, queues, SLAs, portals) or JPD
  
  
* Experience with identity integration such as Okta, Azure AD/Entra ID, SAML SSO, or SCIM
  
  
* Migration experience with JCMA/CCMA or instance merges
  
  
* Experience with ScriptRunner or other marketplace apps, and with assessing app usage
  

  

**What You’ll Gain**

  

  
* Ownership of meaningful parts of a large, enterprise-scale Atlassian Cloud platform
  
  
* Real influence over how a global platform is standardized and modernized
  
  
* A clear growth path to Specialist and Advanced Specialist roles on the Atlassian Platform Engineering team
  
  
* Support for Atlassian certifications and ongoing learning

title: ELN/LIMS configurations expert
description:
**Company Description**
DigAIT is a scientific technology and consulting partner that supports chemical and life sciences organizations in accelerating digital transformation across research, development, laboratory, manufacturing, and operations. The company combines AI, IT, scientific data, and deep domain expertise to design and implement digital solutions that make scientific processes more connected and data-driven. Its capabilities span process modeling, laboratory and manufacturing solutions, data analytics, business intelligence, and advanced AI technologies, including machine learning and generative AI. DigAIT works across the full transformation journey—from assessing current processes to implementing ELN/LIMS, integrating data, and enabling scalable analytics and AI. The team is experienced with leading platforms and tools such as LIMS, ELN, MES, ERP, SAP Signavio, BPMN, Power BI, Tableau, AWS, Azure, Python, and modern AI/LLM platforms.

**Role Description**
For Client based in Europe, we are looking for a ELN/LIMS configurations expert. This role based will be in Chennai, structured as a hybrid position that combines on-site work with some work-from-home flexibility. You will connect lab users, data science teams, and IT, ensuring that experimental data is captured in a structured, high-quality, and ML-ready form. The role combines hands-on configuration, product ownership, roll-out coordination for targeted labs and sites, and IT operations.

**Key responsibilities:**

1. Configurations and trainings

* Work with lab colleagues to design and configure workflows, data uploaders, templates, and master data especially related to formulation development process (materials, formulations, raw materials, test methods, properties, units)
* Translate lab processes in chemistry and material development into robust platform configurations
* Train users, support onboarding, and drive adoption

2. Product management

* Collect, prioritize, and manage requirements from business stakeholders
* Maintain the product backlog and roadmap, and deliver in an agile (Scrum) setup
* Run sprint planning, reviews, and stakeholder communication
* Manage releases, change requests, and configuration testing/validation

3. Integrations and IT operations

* Coordinate the development of integrations between the ELN and other systems (LIMS, ERP, PLM, instruments/CDS, data lakes, analytics/ML platforms) via APIs and interfaces
* Handle incident and problem management, second-level support, and vendor coordination
* Maintain knowledge documentation (configuration specs, SOPs, user guides, FAQs)

4. Roll-out and adoption coordination

* Coordinate roll-out activities end-to-end for specific smaller labs or sites (e.g., HTE lab, a particular site roll-out), building on the platform already established in the larger labs
* Reuse and adapt existing configurations, templates, and master data from the larger labs, and identify only the lab-specific extensions needed (e.g., HTE-specific workflows, uploaders, instrument interfaces)
* Define roll-out plans, timelines, and milestones together with the respective lab leads, IT, and data science teams
* Manage change and communication: stakeholder updates, training, user onboarding, and feedback loops
* Track adoption and roll-out KPIs (e.g., active users, workflow usage, open issues) and hand over to operations with complete documentation and support processes

5. Data governance

* Work with ML/data science teams to define rules for good data management (naming conventions, ontologies, mandatory fields, units, metadata)

**Qualifications**

* PhD or master’s degree in a relevant field such as Material science, Chemistry, physics or a related discipline is preferred.
* Experience with other ELN/LIMS/R&D platforms
  in chemical or life sciences laboratories including workflow design and data model configuration
  (Preferably Formulation data related experience). With PhD a minimum for 2-3 working experience is required and with Masters a minimum of 7-8 years working experience in required.
* Strong knowledge of application integration (REST APIs, data pipelines, SSO/identity, interfaces between lab and enterprise systems)
* Experience with Scrum/agile, backlog management, and stakeholder prioritization. Certifications such as Scrum Master/PSPO, ITIL, or relevant vendor certifications
* Experience with ITIL-based incident/change management
* Candidates should possess clear Communication skills to collaborate with scientists, IT teams, and business stakeholders and to document configurations and processes.
* Good familiarity with data science and ML concepts: data preparation, feature/data requirements, FAIR principles, data modeling
* Ability to work in a hybrid setup in Chennai, manage priorities independently, and adapt to evolving project requirements and technologies.

Job Description:
  
  
The SIRM Service Manager is responsible for the day-to-day operational management and support of the SIRM platform, ensuring the application remains stable, available, and aligned with business needs. This role acts as the primary coordinator for service operations, overseeing support requests, incidents, operational activities, and communications with stakeholders while working closely with the SIRM DevOps team, infrastructure teams, vendors, and business users. The Archer Service Manager is accountable for ensuring operational processes are executed effectively, support requests are managed within established service levels, scheduled maintenance activities are completed, and system issues are promptly identified, communicated, and resolved. The role also supports continuous service improvement through operational reporting, trend analysis, and process optimization.
  
  
Key Responsibilities:
  
  
Service Operations
  
  

* Manage the day-to-day operation of the Archer platform.
* Monitor overall platform health, availability, and performance.
* Review system alerts and scheduled jobs to ensure successful execution.
* Coordinate investigation and resolution of application performance issues, failed jobs, and operational incidents.
* Ensure routine operational activities are completed according to established schedules.

Incident and Problem Management
  
  

* Coordinate the response to application incidents and service disruptions.
* Lead incident communications with business stakeholders and technical teams.
* Escalate issues to Archer configurators, infrastructure teams, vendors, or Archer Support as appropriate.
* Coordinate root cause analysis and ensure corrective actions are implemented.
* Track recurring issues and recommend preventive improvements.

Service Request and Support Management
  
  

* Oversee the Archer support queue and ensure timely handling of incidents and service requests.
* Prioritize and assign work to the Archer configuration team based on business impact and urgency.
* Monitor ticket progress to ensure compliance with service level agreements (SLAs).
* Provide regular updates to requestors and stakeholders regarding ticket status and resolution timelines.

Operational Administration
  
  

* Coordinate recurring administrative activities required to maintain the platform, including:
* Monthly business unit updates.
* User account imports and updates from external data sources.
* Periodic user and organizational data maintenance. o Verification of scheduled operational tasks.
* Ensure operational procedures are documented and consistently followed.

Change and Release Coordination
  
  

* Coordinate production releases and system updates.
* Support change management activities, including planning, scheduling, communications, and post-implementation validation.
* Ensure production changes are implemented following established governance processes.
* Maintain awareness of upcoming Archer product updates and coordinate implementation activities.

Reporting and Governance
  
  

* Prepare operational reports and dashboards related to:
* User activity. o System utilization.
* Incident and service request metrics.
* SLA performance.
* Platform availability.
* Identify operational trends and recommend opportunities for continuous improvement.
* Maintain operational documentation, procedures, and service metrics.

Stakeholder Communication
  
  

* Contribute to the prioritization of platform improvements in collaboration with business stakeholders and the Archer configuration team.
* Serve as the primary operational point of contact for Archer service-related matters.
* Communicate planned maintenance activities, outages, incidents, and service updates to business users.
* Facilitate coordination between business stakeholders, technical teams, and vendors.
* Support governance meetings by providing operational status updates and service performance metrics.

Qualifications and Skills:
  
  

* 5+ years of experience supporting enterprise applications in a service management or application support role.
* Experience coordinating application support, incident management, and operational activities.
* Experience working with governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) platforms is desirable.
* Experience with RSA Archer (Archer Integrated Risk Management platform) is desirable.

description:
**Job Description**
Infrastructure Technology Lead Analyst (Red Hat Linux, GRID Infrastructure L3 Support Engineer)
  
  
The Infrastructure Technology Lead Analyst is an intermediate-level technical role responsible for providing Level 3 support, engineering, remediation, and operational excellence across the Unified Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) estate consisting of more than 100,000+ servers. The role requires deep expertise in Linux administration, troubleshooting complex infrastructure issues, security hardening, automation, and configuration management. The overall objective is to leverage advanced infrastructure technology knowledge, operational policies, and engineering best practices to maintain platform stability, security, compliance, and service availability.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Provide Level 3 technical support for complex Red Hat Enterprise Linux, GRID infrastructure server incidents, escalations, and critical production outages across a large-scale enterprise environment.
* Lead troubleshooting and resolution of high-impact operating system, kernel, performance, storage, networking, and server infrastructure issues to restore services within agreed SLAs.
* Perform detailed Root Cause Analysis (RCA) following service restoration and implement corrective and preventive actions to eliminate recurring issues.
* Design and implement server security hardening standards in accordance with enterprise security policies, regulatory requirements, and industry best practices.
* Manage vulnerability remediation activities, security patching, operating system lifecycle management, and compliance controls across the Red Hat server estate.
* Administer and troubleshoot infrastructure agents including monitoring, security, backup, automation, compliance, and endpoint management agents deployed across Linux servers.
* Develop, maintain, and optimize Ansible playbooks for server provisioning, configuration management, patching, security remediation, and operational automation.
* Automate repetitive operational tasks and develop engineering solutions to improve platform stability, efficiency, and operational resilience.
* Review infrastructure requirements, define operating system standards, and update operational processes, procedures, and technical documentation as required.
* Conduct proactive system health reviews, capacity planning, performance tuning, and operational risk assessments.
* Provide technical leadership, mentorship, and strategic guidance to team members and operational support teams.
* Collaborate with security, application, middleware, storage, network, and infrastructure teams to resolve cross-functional technical challenges.
* Support operating system upgrades, migrations, disaster recovery exercises, and business continuity initiatives.
* Ensure ongoing compliance with regulatory requirements, corporate governance standards, and security frameworks.
* Act as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) for Red Hat Enterprise Linux platforms and associated technologies when engaging with senior stakeholders, engineering teams, and project groups.
* Operate independently with minimal supervision while demonstrating strong ownership, sound judgment, and decision-making capabilities.
* Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients, and assets by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules, and regulations; adhering to policy; applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct, and business practices; and escalating, managing, and reporting control issues with transparency.

**Required Technical Skills**

* Strong expertise in Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) administration, GRID infrastructure and troubleshooting.
* Advanced knowledge of Linux kernel, system performance tuning, networking, storage, LVM, multipathing, clustering, and filesystem management.
* Experience in enterprise server security hardening, vulnerability management, and compliance frameworks.
* Hands-on experience with Ansible automation and playbook development.
* Experience with Chef configuration management and infrastructure-as-code practices.
* Knowledge of monitoring, backup, security, and compliance agents deployed in enterprise Linux environments.
* Experience supporting mission-critical production environments at large scale.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, incident management, and root cause analysis skills.
* Familiarity with virtualization, cloud technologies, and DevOps practices is advantageous.

**Education:**

* 6-8 years of experience in relevant technologies.
* Bachelor’s/University degree or equivalent experience

title: Technical Customer Support Professional
description:
**Empower Structural Innovation as a Technical Support Professional – Tekla Structures (Concrete, Precast, & Rebar)**
Are you a customer-focused structural professional who loves deconstructing complex software challenges? Trimble is seeking a high-caliber Technical Support Professional to join our dedicated Customer Support network. In this high-impact position, you will serve as the premier point of contact for enterprise clients navigating advanced workflows within
**Tekla Structures**
, specifically focusing on the Concrete, Precast, and Rebar modules. Your immediate technical expertise will ensure engineering and detailing teams around the world minimize downtime and achieve structural precision.
  
  
**About Us**
Dedicated to the world’s tomorrow, Trimble is a technology company delivering solutions that enable our customers to work in new ways to measure, build, grow and move goods for a better quality of life. Core technologies in positioning, modeling, connectivity and data analytics connect the digital and physical worlds to improve productivity, quality, safety, transparency and sustainability. From purpose-built products and enterprise lifecycle solutions to industry cloud services, Trimble is transforming critical industries such as construction, geospatial, agriculture and transportation to power an interconnected world of work. For more information about Trimble (NASDAQ: TRMB), visit: www.trimble.com
  
  
**Our Product Ecosystem:**
Tekla software solutions are the global standard for advanced Building Information Modeling (BIM) and structural engineering. From massive cast-in-place concrete structures to complex precast components and high-density reinforcement detailing, Tekla drives structural lifecycle efficiency from design to the job site.
  
  
**What Makes This Role Great**
In this role, you will transition from a day-to-day detailer or modeller into a highly valued structural subject matter expert. Operating within our state-of-the-art hubs in Chennai or Navi Mumbai, you will have the technical autonomy to reverse-engineer software anomalies, troubleshoot localized configurations, and configure cross-platform cloud integrations. You will work closely with global helpdesks and act as a crucial voice-of-the-customer, directly collaborating with Trimble’s Product Development teams to advocate for product updates and eliminate architectural bottlenecks.
  
  
Key Exciting Responsibilities
  
  

* Complex Modeling Resolution: Provide clear, step-by-step technical guidance to resolve advanced structural modeling and parametric geometry issues faced by global engineering accounts.
* Database & Catalog Orchestration: Manage, audit, and troubleshoot intricate software databases, custom reinforcement catalogs, and automated Bar Bending Schedules (BBS).
* Deliverable Configuration Support: Assist detailers in configuring and optimizing General Arrangement (GA) drawings, Cast Unit drawings, automated rebar schedules, and custom Template Editor (.tpl) reports.
* Environment Architecture Troubleshooting: Diagnose and resolve localized company environment bugs, including custom parametric components, complex drawing layouts, custom attributes, and enterprise firm/project folder paths.
* Cloud & Interoperability Engineering: Support collaborative cloud workspaces by resolving interoperability bottlenecks across Trimble Connect, Tekla Model Sharing, and open BIM data exchanges (IFC, DWG, DXF, BVBS).
* Bug Replication & Product Escalation: Systematically replicate user-reported software errors, document system limitations, and escalate unresolved code defects to global development teams while populating internal knowledge bases.

**Essential Skills & Experience**

* Professional Experience: 4+ years of direct, hands-on experience utilizing or supporting Tekla Structures. Highly preferred experience operating within an RCC, Precast detailing, or high-fidelity BIM production environment.
* Technical Deep-Dive Mastery: Complete mastery of Tekla Structures software functionality, system configurations, directory folders, detailing standards, and reinforcement modules.
* Diagnostic Capabilities: Strong analytical and diagnostic skills with a proven capability to investigate system logs, reverse-engineer software errors, and troubleshoot severe system crashes under pressure.
* Communication & Deadline Focus: Exceptional, patient, and highly professional written and verbal communication skills to deliver technical solutions clearly to users working under strict engineering deadlines.
* Education: Bachelor’s Degree in Civil Engineering, Structural Engineering, or Mechanical Engineering.

**Bonus Points For**

* Workflow Automation Tooling: Practical knowledge or script exposure to Tekla Open API, C#, or Grasshopper for parametric workflow automation.
* Advanced Component Customization: Direct experience developing complex parametric Custom Components and custom software macros.
* Cross-Domain Competency: Prior structural background or foundational workflow knowledge in structural steel detailing and fabrication logic.

**Logistics**

* Locations: Chennai or Navi Mumbai, India
* Department: Customer Support / Technical Services
* Job Type: Full-Time

We build innovative solutions designed to solve the world's most critical challenges. From construction sites to transportation hubs, our work tangibly improves how people live, build, move, and grow.

title: Senior Aviation Customer Support Analyst
description:
Job Type
  
  
Full-time
  
  
**Description**
**Why We Need You – The Mission**
Veryon develops and continuously enhances technology that supports aircraft maintenance tracking, inventory management, diagnostics, publications, and flight operations. Our mission is to reduce operational disruption, improve efficiency, and help aviation teams keep aircraft ready for their missions.
  
  
As a Senior Aviation Customer Support Analyst, you will provide global support across Veryon product lines, with an initial focus on Tracking+. You will be a trusted first point of contact for customers, owning the triage, investigation, communication, and resolution of application questions and incidents. You will work closely with Product, Engineering, QA, and other teams to deliver timely, accurate, and sustainable solutions.
  
  
The ideal candidate brings experience in aviation or aviation software, strong SQL capability, and an investigative mindset. You enjoy solving difficult problems, following evidence, asking thoughtful questions, and translating technical findings into clear, reassuring customer communication.
  
  
**What You’ll Accomplish – Key Responsibilities**

* Provide responsive, professional global support for Veryon products, initially concentrating on Tracking+ and expanding across other product lines as business needs require.
* Own incoming support calls and cases from initial triage through investigation, resolution, escalation, and closure, in line with service-level commitments.
* Troubleshoot application behaviour, data issues, access and configuration problems, integrations, and reported defects using structured diagnostic methods.
* Use SQL confidently to investigate data, validate records, analyse query results, and support root-cause analysis. Follow approved access, data-handling, and change-control procedures; do not make unauthorised production changes.
* Reproduce customer-reported issues, collect relevant logs and evidence, document findings, and provide clear technical details to Engineering and Product teams.
* Communicate proactively with customers about progress, impact, next steps, risks, and expected follow-up, setting clear expectations throughout the support lifecycle.
* Collaborate with Engineering, Product, QA, and internal stakeholders to coordinate fixes, validate solutions, identify workarounds, and reduce repeat incidents.
* Create and maintain accurate case notes, troubleshooting guides, knowledge-base articles, and process documentation to improve team consistency and customer self-sufficiency.
* Identify recurring issues, trends, and opportunities for prevention, automation, and service improvement; contribute practical recommendations that improve resolution time and product stability.
* Manage competing priorities calmly and methodically, particularly during critical incidents, customer-impacting events, and periods of high case volume.
* Support knowledge sharing and coach newer team members as experience grows, helping strengthen technical capability and consistent support practices.

**Requirements**
**Essential Experience and Technical Skills**

* Experience in aviation, aircraft maintenance, aviation operations, or aviation software support. Candidates with hands-on experience supporting aviation maintenance or operations systems are strongly preferred.
* Strong SQL knowledge and practical experience querying and analysing relational data to investigate application or data-related issues.
* A demonstrated passion for troubleshooting, with the patience and persistence to investigate complex problems, test hypotheses, identify root causes, and verify solutions.
* Experience supporting B2B customers, enterprise users, or key accounts, preferably in an international or multi-time-zone environment.
* Ability to interpret technical information, reproduce reported issues, gather useful evidence, and communicate findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Fluent English at C2 proficiency level, with excellent spoken and written communication skills.
* Strong organisational and time-management skills, including the ability to prioritise multiple cases and meet agreed deadlines and service levels.
* Ability to remain calm under pressure, adapt to changing priorities, and maintain a customer-first approach during critical or high-impact incidents.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office tools, particularly Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Teams; familiarity with Jira and Confluence or similar case-management and knowledge-sharing tools.

**Preferred Attributes**

* Experience with aviation maintenance tracking, technical records, inventory, publications, diagnostics, or related operational systems.
* Understanding of application support processes, incident management, escalation management, and service-level agreements.
* Familiarity with databases, application logs, APIs or integrations, and structured root-cause analysis.
* A proactive mindset: you look beyond the immediate symptom, recognise patterns, and suggest ways to prevent issues from recurring.
* A collaborative approach and willingness to share knowledge, seek input, and work constructively across teams with competing priorities.

**First 30 Days – Build a Strong Foundation**

* Complete onboarding and become familiar with Veryon’s culture, support processes, escalation paths, tools, and team structure.
* Review the supported applications, including Tracking+, Tracking, Publications, and Diagnostics, with attention to their purpose, key workflows, architecture, and interdependencies.
* Learn the customer environment and common aviation maintenance and operational concepts relevant to the supported products.
* Shadow experienced analysts and begin resolving straightforward incidents under guidance, following established troubleshooting and documentation standards.
* Demonstrate SQL investigation skills and learn the approved procedures for validating application and data behaviour.
* Contribute clear case notes and initial knowledge articles, and observe how complex issues are escalated to Engineering or Product.

**First 90 Days – Increase Ownership and Independence**

* Resolve a broader range of support cases independently, using a structured approach to diagnosis, evidence gathering, testing, and customer communication.
* Apply SQL to investigate data-related issues and validate findings accurately within approved permissions and procedures.
* Manage case priorities, customer expectations, and follow-up actions consistently against support commitments.
* Identify recurring issues and recommend improvements to troubleshooting guides, workflows, and knowledge articles.
* Build effective working relationships with Engineering, Product, QA, and customer stakeholders.

**First 6 Months – Deliver Advanced Support and Continuous Improvement**

* Handle complex incidents with greater independence, demonstrating sound aviation software knowledge, strong troubleshooting discipline, and clear ownership.
* Triage inbound calls and cases across global customers and Veryon product lines, ensuring accurate prioritisation and routing.
* Contribute to root-cause analysis, proactive monitoring, repeat-incident reduction, and support process or automation improvements.
* Share technical knowledge and assist with onboarding or mentoring newer team members.
* Bring evidence-based recommendations to team discussions that improve customer experience, product stability, and operational efficiency.

**Personal Competencies That Matter**
**Customer-first ownership:**
Understand the customer’s operational needs, take accountability for progress, and work toward solutions that minimise disruption and build trust.
  
  
**Analytical troubleshooting:**
Approach problems with curiosity and discipline. Use facts, SQL, logs, testing, and evidence to isolate causes rather than relying on assumptions.
  
  
**Clear and proactive communication:**
Provide timely, transparent updates, explain technical matters in plain language, and raise risks early with clear next steps.
  
  
**Prioritisation and composure:**
Assess urgency and business impact, balance competing demands, and remain calm and methodical under pressure.
  
  
**Collaboration and teamwork:**
Build productive relationships across Support, Engineering, Product, QA, and customer teams to move issues forward effectively.
  
  
**Continuous improvement:**
Capture knowledge, identify repeat patterns, and recommend practical changes that improve reliability, efficiency, and the customer experience.
  
  
**Adaptability and learning:**
Develop product and aviation-domain knowledge continuously, respond positively to feedback, and adapt to evolving customer and business needs.
  
  
**About Veryon**
Veryon is a provider of aviation software and information services, helping aircraft operators, maintenance organisations, MROs, airlines, and OEMs improve aircraft availability and operational performance. Our technology supports critical activities across maintenance, operations, manuals, inventory, and diagnostics, helping aviation teams reduce avoidable downtime and work more efficiently.
  
  
**How We Work – Our Core Values**

* Fueled by Customers – We listen closely, understand customer needs, and focus on outcomes that make a meaningful difference.
* Win Together – We collaborate, share knowledge, and succeed through mutual trust and accountability.
* Innovate to Elevate – We challenge assumptions, learn continuously, and improve how we work and serve customers.
* Make It Happen – We take ownership, act with purpose, and follow through to deliver results.

**THE PROFILE WE’RE SEEKING**
A technically strong, aviation-aware support professional who loves solving problems, uses SQL and evidence to get to the root cause, communicates with confidence and empathy, and takes ownership of delivering reliable outcomes for customers.
  
  
**Notice of AI Use in Job Application Review**
As part of our commitment in creating a fair, efficient, and consistent hiring process we may use artificial intelligence (AI) to help our recruiting teams organize, summarize, and analyze information provided by candidates, including resumes, application responses, and other materials submitted during the application process.AI may be used to identify patterns, highlight relevant skills, and experience, and assist in comparing a candidate’s qualifications with the requirement of a specific role. These tools are to improve efficiency and consistency while supporting more informed hiring decisions, which will ultimately be made by the hiring team.

in

title: Network Operations Center Engineer II
description:
Alation is pioneering the next era of
**data intelligence — powered by AI agents and trusted data**
. Organizations around the world rely on
**Alation**
to drive self-service analytics, cloud transformation, data governance, and AI innovation. Our technology helps enterprises connect people and data to make faster, smarter, and more confident decisions. With more than $340M in funding – valued at over $1.7 billion and more than 650 customers, including 40% of the Fortune 100.
  
  
As data becomes the foundation of every business, Alation is leading the way in helping organizations unlock their full potential. By bringing intelligence, automation, and trust to every interaction, we empower customers to scale data-driven innovation with confidence and speed.
  
  
Joining Alation means being part of a
**winning team shaping the future of AI-powered data intelligence**
. We move fast, think big, and deliver results together.
  
  
**Job Description**
**About the Role**
We're looking for a hands-on NOC Engineer who can also handle security monitoring and incidents. You'll monitor, troubleshoot, and resolve issues across our AWS and Kubernetes environments, respond to security alerts, and automate repetitive work — thinking clearly under pressure and owning incidents end to end
  
  
**Network / Cloud Operations (NOC)**

* Monitor the health, availability and performance of AWS infrastructure, Kubernetes clusters, applications and networks, 24x7 on a rotational basis.
* Act as L2 escalation point: triage, troubleshoot, debug and resolve incidents escalated from L1 or raised by monitoring tools.
* Analyze logs, metrics and traces to find root causes across compute, network, storage, database and application layers.
* Troubleshoot Kubernetes workloads (pods, deployments, services, ingress, nodes) using kubectl and related tools.
* Escalate to engineering, cloud and vendor teams with clear, complete technical context when needed.
* Tune alerts and dashboards to reduce noise and improve signal quality.
* Support change, maintenance and release windows, including validation and rollback checks.

**Security Operations (SOC)**

* Monitor security alerts from SIEM, cloud security tools (e.g., AWS GuardDuty, Security Hub, CloudTrail) and endpoint/network sources.
* Triage, investigate and classify security events; separate false positives from real threats.
* Execute first response on security incidents: containment, evidence collection, escalation and follow-up.
* Identify suspicious activity such as unauthorized access, IAM misuse, unusual network traffic, malware or data exfiltration indicators.
* Follow and improve security incident response playbooks.
* Support vulnerability management, access reviews and audit evidence requests.

**Automation and Continuous Improvement**

* Automate repetitive operational and security tasks using scripting (Python, Bash, PowerShell, Go, etc.) or low-code / no-code tools (e.g., n8n, Zapier, Power Automate, SOAR platforms, Lambda, AWS Systems Manager).
* Build auto-remediation, alert enrichment and ticket auto-creation workflows.
* Write and maintain runbooks, SOPs and knowledge base articles.
* Identify recurring issues and drive problem management to permanent fixes.

**Incident, Ticketing and ITIL Process**

* Manage incidents, service requests, problems and changes in ticketing tools (e.g., Jira Service Management, ServiceNow, PagerDuty, Opsgenie).
* Meet SLAs for acknowledgement, response and resolution.
* Lead or support major incident bridges; provide clear status updates to stakeholders.
* Write post-incident reviews / RCAs with action items.
* Provide clean, documented shift handovers.

**Required Skills And Qualifications**
Strong communication and team coordination are mandatory. Security monitoring/incident response, automation, and troubleshooting/debugging are critical. AWS fundamentals, observability tooling, and ITIL/ticketing experience are high priority. Kubernetes is medium-to-high priority; coding in any language is a plus.
  
  
**Specifically, We're Looking For**

* Hands-on security experience (SIEM tools, AWS security services, awareness of MITRE ATT&CK/OWASP Top 10)
* A track record of automating manual work (scripting or low-code/no-code)
* Working AWS knowledge (VPC, EC2, IAM, CloudWatch, etc.) and Kubernetes (EKS preferred)
* Strong troubleshooting ability and comfort with Linux CLI
* 3–6 years in NOC, SOC, cloud ops, or SRE/DevOps support, with ITIL and ticketing experience
* Bachelor's degree in CS/IT/Electronics or equivalent experience

**Good to Have**
AWS/Security certifications (Security+, CEH, CKA), SOAR platform experience, Terraform/Git basics, and exposure to SOC 2/ISO 27001/GDPR.
  
  
**Behavioral Competencies**
Calm under pressure, strong communicator, ownership mindset, quick learner open to cross-training across NOC and SOC, and documents/hands over work cleanly.
  
  
**Shift & Work Conditions**
Rotational 24x5 today, expanding to 24x6/24x7 — includes night/weekend shifts and on-call per roster, with shift allowance and comp-off per policy.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regards to that individual’s race, color, religion or creed, national origin or ancestry, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender identity, age, physical or mental disability, veteran status, genetic information, ethnicity, citizenship, or any other characteristic protected by law.*
