title: TechOps Engineer
description:
Role Summary:
  
We are seeking a Technical Operations Engineer to support the Staples Promotional Products application portfolio. This hands-on engineering role will focus on proactive application health management, daily operational review, observability support, technical incident investigation, environment validation, runbook execution, operational automation, and backup support for core DevOps delivery processes.
  
The role is intended for an engineer who can help SPP become more proactive and efficient by identifying issues before business users report them, improving dashboard and alert coverage, producing clear investigation summaries, turning recurring operational work into repeatable processes or automation, and providing operational continuity when the primary DevOps Engineer is unavailable or release activity requires additional support. The engineer will not own release governance, release scheduling, release communications, or DevOps management responsibilities; those responsibilities remain with the DevOps Manager.
  
  
Duties & Responsibilities:
  
• Perform a daily operational health review for critical SPP applications, integrations, scheduled jobs, services, and business-critical paths using New Relic or similar observability tools.
  
• Review overnight and current-day alerts, error spikes, failed jobs, integration failures, service health indicators, and recurring support patterns to identify concerns before they become business-impacting incidents.
  
• Maintain a practical daily operations view or health summary that identifies green/yellow/red application status, open risks, investigation needs, and follow-up actions for the SPP technology team.
  
• Create and maintain New Relic dashboards or similar operational dashboards that provide actionable visibility into application availability, error trends, performance signals, failed jobs, integrations, and post-deployment health.
  
• Recommend improvements to alert coverage, dashboard design, alert thresholds, noise reduction, and early-warning indicators based on recurring issues and operational trends.
  
• Support technical incident investigation by reviewing logs, traces, monitoring data, application behavior, database indicators, service errors, failed jobs, and integration failures.
  
• Partner with business support and QA resources to reproduce issues, validate defects, collect evidence, and produce concise technical investigation summaries for development, infrastructure, security, DevOps, and leadership review.
  
• Maintain and execute environment health validation checks for lower and production environments, including application availability, service readiness, configuration concerns, recurring failures, deployment validation signals, and operational readiness indicators.
  
• Develop and maintain runbooks, troubleshooting guides, operational handoff notes, dashboard documentation, health-check procedures, and incident investigation playbooks for recurring issues.
  
• Identify repetitive operational, support, validation, monitoring, and environment tasks that can be automated through scripts, workflow tooling, dashboards, checklists, or standard operating procedures.
  
• Develop working knowledge of Azure DevOps, Octopus Deploy, TFS workflows, GitHub repositories, deployment pipelines, and release automation processes to provide backup coverage and operational continuity when primary DevOps resources are unavailable.
  
• Assist with deployment execution support, deployment validation, pipeline monitoring, release readiness checks, and post-deployment verification during high-volume release periods or DevOps resource gaps.
  
• Support first-level troubleshooting for deployment failures, pipeline execution issues, Octopus deployment/package issues, environment readiness concerns, and source control integration issues; escalate complex engineering changes to the DevOps Engineer or DevOps Manager as appropriate.
  
• Maintain familiarity with core DevOps tooling documentation, deployment runbooks, pipeline support procedures, and release-support handoff processes to reduce single points of failure across the SPP technology organization.
  
• Support security and compliance follow-up by helping identify certificate concerns, vulnerability evidence, configuration issues, dependency concerns, recurring risks, and technical remediation needs.
  
• Track operational improvement opportunities and recommend practical changes that reduce reactive work, improve mean time to investigation, increase system visibility, and strengthen SPP operational maturity.
  
  
  
Requirements
  
  
Minimum Years of Experience: 3+ years
  
Minimum of 3 years of experience in Technical Operations, Application Operations, DevOps, Production Support Engineering, or related field.
  
  
Basic Qualifications:
  
• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  
• 3+ years of professional experience in Technical Operations, Application Operations, DevOps, Production Support Engineering, or related field.
  
• Hands-on experience supporting application health, operational monitoring, incident investigation, technical triage, and production or lower-environment troubleshooting.
  
• Experience with monitoring, alerting, logging, dashboards, and production troubleshooting using New Relic or similar observability tools.
  
• Ability to review alerts, failed jobs, integrations, error trends, and operational signals to identify issues and summarize follow-up actions.
  
• Working knowledge of CI/CD concepts, release automation, deployment validation, source control management, and software delivery lifecycle practices.
  
• Familiarity with Azure DevOps, Octopus Deploy, TFS, GitHub, or similar software delivery and deployment platforms.
  
• Ability to investigate application issues by analyzing logs, traces, metrics, failed jobs, application behavior, database indicators, and service dependencies.
  
• Scripting and automation skills using PowerShell, Python, Shell, SQL, YAML, Power Automate, or similar technologies.
  
• Experience creating technical documentation, operational runbooks, troubleshooting guides, investigation summaries, dashboard documentation, deployment validation notes, health-check procedures, and support handoff notes.
  
• Problem-solving skills with the ability to address monitoring, application support, deployment validation, environment, operational readiness, and recurring issue patterns.
  
• Good written and verbal communication skills with the ability to explain technical findings to cross-functional stakeholders.
  
• Ability to work independently, manage technical tasks across time zones, produce clear handoff documentation, and collaborate with GCC and CST-based teams.
  
  
Preferred Qualifications
  
• Experience with New Relic dashboard creation, alert tuning, service health reporting, recurring error trend analysis, post-deployment health checks, or production-readiness reporting.
  
• Experience supporting release validation, deployment monitoring, post-deployment verification, pipeline monitoring, or production readiness activities.
  
• Experience with Azure DevOps, Octopus Deploy, TFS, GitHub, Windows/IIS application hosting, SQL troubleshooting, enterprise application support, or similar operational environments.
  
• Experience building or improving a daily operations review model, system health scorecard, operational checklist, or proactive monitoring process.
  
• Exposure to DevSecOps or security operations support including certificate monitoring, vulnerability remediation tracking, dependency review, configuration risk tracking, or security scan follow-up.
  
• Experience supporting business-facing applications, incident evidence collection, application reproduction support, or collaboration with QA/manual testing resources.
  
• Exposure to workflow automation, Power Automate, infrastructure automation, configuration management, cloud operations, or automation tools such as Terraform, Ansible, Bicep, ARM templates, or similar technologies.
  
• Interest or experience with AI technologies to automate operational workflows, system management, documentation, monitoring analysis, incident investigation, and release-support tasks.

title: CAPEX Excellence specialist
description:
**Support CAPEX planning, execution and reporting**
Join NKT in a role that connects CAPEX governance, system support, and business improvement across an international organization. You will own day-to-day support, adoption, and continuous improvement of the CAPEX tool, helping teams work with consistent data, reliable reporting, and clear processes. This is a valuable opportunity to contribute to the green transition by supporting investment decisions across the business. Are you motivated by combining systems, process standards, and user support in one role?
  
  
**Keep CAPEX operations stable and consistent**
In this role, you will act as the main business contact for the CAPEX tool and related process standards. You will support users, coordinate incidents and improvement requests with, and help maintain common templates, workflows, and reporting standards. The role also includes governance of master data, backlog prioritization, UAT coordination, and communication around releases and changes. You will work closely with CAPEX project managers, finance, procurement, IT, and process owners to support reliable planning, execution, and tracking across sites and functions.
  
  
**Your Responsibility Will Be To**

* Provide first-line functional support and coordinate further support when needed
* Maintain user guides, SOPs, and training materials
* Govern usage standards, workflows, and documentation requirements
* Support reports and dashboards with consistent KPI definitions
* Coordinate UAT, releases and backlog priorities

You will work across manufacturing sites and shared functions, in close collaboration with CAPEX project managers, site controllers, procurement and IT.
  
  
**Structured communicator with a clear quality focus**
We are looking for someone who is service-minded, and organized, with a practical approach to user support and process governance. You communicate clearly with both end users and management, work carefully with documentation and change control, and are comfortable balancing business needs with standard ways of working. The right person is initiative-taking, detail-oriented, and able to move issues forward while keeping compliance, auditability, and data quality in focus.
  
  
**You Also Have**

* 5+ years of experience in CAPEX controlling, project execution, PMO, finance, or a similar area using CAPEX, ERP, or project portfolio tools
* Experience translating business needs into system requirements and supporting UAT, training, and change management
* Good understanding of data structures, reporting, and integrations with finance or ERP systems
* Experience acting as system or product owner
* Training or certification in ERP/PM systems or project management

**Help improve investment quality for a greener future**
NKT is committed to developing a diverse organization and culture where people of diverse backgrounds can grow and are inspired to do their best. We are motivated to establish gender diversity at NKT and encourage all interested candidates to apply – even if you don’t tick all the boxes described. We believe that a diverse organization enables long-term performance, and that an inclusive and welcoming culture creates a better work environment.
  
  
In this role, you will be part of a collaborative international setting where you can broaden your skills in CAPEX governance, systems, reporting, and change processes. You will work with colleagues across business functions and sites, contribute to continuous improvement, and support reliable investment planning that matters to NKT’s ongoing journey and the wider green transition.
  
  
“This role is ideal for someone who enjoys connecting systems, process standards, and user needs to create reliable CAPEX planning and reporting across the business,” says Hiring Manager, Karim Damiani
  
  
Read more about our offer and listen to some voices of NKT Connectors here!
  
  
We will review applications continuously, but we recommend you apply no later than 20th November 2026. Be aware that personality and cognitive tests might be included in the recruitment process. Please note that due to the GDPR regulations we cannot accept any applications via e-mail.
  
  
We collect confidential candidate experience feedback to improve our recruitment process. Your responses are for quality development only and do not affect hiring decisions.
  
  
Be a Connector of the green tomorrow!
  
  
**About NKT**
*NKT connects a greener world with high-quality power cable technology and takes centre stage as the world moves towards green energy. NKT designs, manufactures and installs low-, medium- and high-voltage power cable solutions enabling sustainable energy transmission. Since 1891, NKT has innovated the power cable technology building the infrastructure for the first light bulbs to the megawatts created by renewable energy today. NKT is headquartered in Denmark and employs 6,500 people. NKT is listed on Nasdaq Copenhagen and realised a revenue of EUR 3.6 billion in 2025. We connect a greener world. www.nkt.com*

Full-Time

**1. Position Overview**

We are seeking a motivated and technically inclined AIDC & Vision Engineer with knowledge of barcode scanning, industrial printing, machine vision systems, RFID solutions, and industrial automation technologies.

The candidate will work closely with customers to understand their requirements, implement technical solutions, and provide installation, commissioning, troubleshooting, and post-deployment support across industries such as pharmaceuticals, manufacturing, logistics, e-commerce, and warehousing.

**2. Key Responsibilities**

**A. AIDC (Automatic Identification and Data Capture)**

* Configure, install, deploy, and troubleshoot industrial barcode scanners and fixed readers from brands such as Zebra, Honeywell, and Hikrobot.
* Implement and support RFID systems and RFID printers, including solutions from Zebra, TSC, Toshiba, and other relevant manufacturers.
* Set up and integrate handheld mobile computers, including Zebra TC Series and Honeywell EDA Series devices.
* Conduct customer site surveys, proof of concepts (POCs), product demonstrations, and performance validation.
* Integrate AIDC devices with ERP, WMS, MES, PLC systems, and industrial automation networks.
* Provide customer training, prepare technical documentation, and deliver post-deployment support.

**B. Machine Vision & Industrial Automation**

* Assist in implementing machine vision applications using platforms such as Zebra Aurora VS Series, Cognex In-Sight/DataMan, Hikrobot Vision Systems, and similar technologies.
* Configure vision inspection tools for OCR, OCV, pattern recognition, defect detection, and barcode grading.
* Assist in selecting and integrating appropriate lenses, lighting systems, filters, mounting accessories, and triggering hardware.
* Work with PLCs, sensors, I/O modules, and industrial communication protocols such as Ethernet/IP, Modbus, and TCP/IP.
* Troubleshoot inspection and image-processing issues and optimize system accuracy, throughput, and lighting conditions.

**3. Required Skills & Technical Knowledge**

The candidate should have knowledge of or hands-on exposure to the following technologies:

**Machine Vision Systems**

* Hikrobot Vision Systems
* Zebra Aurora VS Series
* Cognex In-Sight and DataMan platforms

**AIDC Devices & Industrial Printing**

* Barcode scanners and fixed readers from Zebra, Honeywell, and Hikrobot
* RFID systems and RFID printers
* Industrial barcode printers from Zebra, TSC, and Toshiba

**Technical Skills**

* Understanding of 1D and 2D barcode symbologies, DataMatrix codes, and GS1 standards.
* Basic knowledge of lighting principles, optical setups, and industrial imaging.
* Familiarity with industrial automation protocols and basic PLC integration.
* Strong troubleshooting, communication, and customer-handling skills.
* Ability to understand technical requirements and recommend suitable solutions.

****Job Description****
**Position Summary**
The I.T. Systems Administrator is responsible for the support, administration, maintenance, monitoring, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement of business-critical enterprise applications and supporting infrastructure within a complex manufacturing environment.
  
  
This position requires an experienced, highly self-motivated IT professional who can work independently while collaborating effectively within a global IT organization. The successful candidate will support a diverse portfolio of ERP, warehouse management, engineering, manufacturing, analytics, and legacy business systems while ensuring their stability, performance, security, and long-term supportability.
  
  
Working as part of the Enterprise Applications team, this role collaborates closely with Infrastructure, Network, Development, Data, Project, and Service Desk teams, as well as external software vendors and service providers.
  
  
The ideal candidate is a strong technical generalist with expertise across enterprise applications, Microsoft SQL Server technologies, and supporting infrastructure platforms. The ability to independently learn unfamiliar systems and assume operational ownership of business-critical applications is essential.
  
  
This position is fully onsite and reports remotely within a global IT organization.
  
  
****Key Responsibilities****

* Administer, support, monitor, and troubleshoot business-critical enterprise applications, including ERP, warehouse management, engineering, manufacturing, analytics, and other operational systems.
* Develop technical expertise and operational ownership of assigned applications and services.
* Proactively identify technical debt, supportability risks, and opportunities for improvement across enterprise applications and supporting infrastructure.
* Contribute to projects and continuous improvement initiatives aimed at reducing technical debt, improving system stability, and modernizing legacy technologies.
* Troubleshoot issues across application, database, operating system, infrastructure, authentication, and integration layers.
* Administer and support Microsoft SQL Server environments, including clustered installations, Enterprise Data Warehouse (EDW) platforms, and related technologies such as SSIS, SSAS, and SSRS.
* Collaborate with Development, Data, BI, and DBA teams to identify and resolve database and application performance issues.
* Administer and support Microsoft Windows Server environments.
* Support Active Directory administration, authentication services, and Kerberos-related troubleshooting.
* Support and maintain virtualized environments primarily based on Microsoft Hyper-V.
* Support Azure-hosted business applications, databases, and analytical solutions.
* Participate in application and infrastructure deployment projects and ensure operational readiness prior to go-live.
* Review technical documentation and ensure supported systems remain properly documented and maintainable.
* Work within established ITIL processes for Incident, Problem, Change, and Service Request Management.
* Perform Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for recurring and business-critical incidents.
* Collect and analyze diagnostic information using tools such as PerfMon, Windows Event Viewer, SQL Server tools, Dynatrace, Spotlight, and application logs.
* Create and maintain technical documentation, operational procedures, incident reports, and Root Cause Analysis documentation.
* Collaborate with software vendors, service providers, business users, project teams, and global IT teams to resolve complex technical issues.
* Participate in regular remote meetings and communications using Microsoft Teams, email, and ticket management systems.

**Education**

* Computer Science degree, Information Technology degree, or equivalent combination of education and relevant work experience.

****The Following Certifications Are Considered An Asset:****

* IT Infrastructure Library (ITIL)
* Microsoft certifications related to Windows Server, SQL Server, Azure, Infrastructure Administration, or Enterprise Applications
* Citrix certifications

****Experience & Qualifications****

* 5+ years of experience implementing, supporting, and managing enterprise applications and systems technologies in a complex, global environment.
* Strong hands-on experience administering Microsoft Windows Server environments.
* Strong hands-on experience administering Microsoft SQL Server environments.
* Experience supporting ERP and business-critical enterprise applications.
* Experience supporting ERP solutions such as Microsoft Dynamics AX.
* Experience supporting Enterprise Data Warehouse (EDW) environments and Microsoft SQL Server technologies including SSIS, SSAS, and SSRS.
* Experience troubleshooting SQL Server performance issues and supporting clustered SQL Server environments.
* Experience administering Microsoft Active Directory and supporting Microsoft Hyper-V environments.
* Experience working within ITIL-based support processes.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting skills.
* Ability to independently learn and support unfamiliar business systems and technologies.
* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
* Experience working with globally distributed teams.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Ability to create technical documentation, operational procedures, incident reports, and Root Cause Analysis documentation.

****Preferred Qualifications****

* Experience supporting manufacturing, engineering, warehouse management, and other business-critical enterprise applications. Experience with Teamcenter, NX, CAD/PDM/PLM platforms, WMS, OFS, TDM, or comparable business systems is considered an asset.
* Experience with Azure, Citrix, Linux, Docker, or related infrastructure technologies.
* Experience with Dynatrace monitoring solutions.
* Experience troubleshooting Kerberos authentication issues.
* Experience with PowerShell scripting and automation.

**Key Competencies**

* Self-motivated and highly independent.
* Strong sense of ownership and accountability.
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.
* Excellent communication and collaboration abilities.
* Strong organizational and documentation skills.
* Continuous learning mindset.

**Success Profile**
The ideal candidate is an experienced IT professional who combines strong enterprise application support, Microsoft SQL Server administration, and infrastructure troubleshooting skills. They are comfortable working in an environment consisting of both legacy and modern systems, can independently acquire expertise in unfamiliar technologies, and take ownership of ensuring the long-term stability, performance, and supportability of business-critical applications.

The Advanced Technical Support Engineer works closely with Sectigo’s customer base and sales department and handles the day-to-day customer issues reported and manages identified issues through to resolution, including assisting customers technical issues by researching, diagnosing, troubleshooting, and identifying solutions to resolve reported issues. **https://www.worldbank.org/en/who-we-are/ibrd**
**ITS Vice Presidency Context**
The Information and Technology Solutions (ITS) Vice Presidential Unit (VPU) enables the World Bank Group to achieve its mission of ending extreme poverty and boost shared prosperity on a livable planet by delivering transformative information and technologies to its staff working in over 150+ locations. For more information on ITS, see this video:
**https://www.youtube.com/watch?reload=9&v=VTFGffa1Y7w**
**Role Overview**
The ETC – Endpoint Management supports the design, implementation, and optimization of enterprise endpoint management solutions with a primary focus on Microsoft Intune for iOS, Android, and macOS platforms. Under supervision, the role contributes to the provisioning, configuration, and lifecycle management of mobile and desktop devices across the organization, ensuring secure, compliant, and cost-effective IT environments. The role also supports print infrastructure and collaborates with cross-functional teams to address integration challenges, enhance connectivity, and maintain reliability across diverse deployment models. The engineer contributes to automation and self service principles as well as operates within an Agile delivery framework aligned to SAFe principles.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Endpoint Management & Mobile Device Management (MDM)
  
  

* Design, implement, and manage Microsoft Intune policies for iOS, Android, and macOS devices, ensuring compliance with organizational security standards.
* Enroll, configure, and maintain corporate and BYOD devices across all supported platforms, including application deployment, conditional access policies, and device compliance baselines.
* Troubleshoot device enrollment, configuration profile, and policy assignment issues across iOS, Android, and macOS endpoints.
* Maintain and update endpoint configurations to align with evolving security requirements and platform OS updates.

**Print Infrastructure Support**

* Support the administration and maintenance of enterprise print environments, including print server management, driver deployment via Intune, and printer policy configuration.
* Assist in troubleshooting printing issues across Windows, macOS, iOS, and Android devices, ensuring seamless print connectivity for end users.
* Contribute to the evaluation and implementation of cloud-based printing solutions integrated with the existing MDM ecosystem.

**Infrastructure Design and Implementation**

* Assist in developing and implementing scalable infrastructure solutions across cloud and on-premises environments to improve system performance and reliability, including operating system maintenance and backup processes.
* Support cross-functional collaboration to define network, storage, compute, and connectivity requirements, ensuring alignment with project goals and business objectives.
* Contribute to infrastructure design reviews by validating adherence to best practices and assisting with documentation for automation and Infrastructure as Code (IaC).

**Continuous Monitoring and Improvement**

* Monitor device compliance, endpoint health, and Intune policy effectiveness, assisting with troubleshooting to maintain uptime and operational reliability.
* Help evaluate and integrate new technologies to optimize endpoint management capabilities and support cost efficiency.
* Participate in regular infrastructure assessments to identify areas for improvement, ensuring endpoint security posture and disaster recovery (DR) readiness.

**Security Controls Embedded in Infrastructure**

* Support collaboration with security teams to implement and maintain secure device configurations, encryption, and compliance measures across endpoint infrastructure components.
* Assist with vulnerability assessments and remediation activities, contributing to a secure and resilient IT environment.
* Help validate HA and DR plans to ensure alignment with security and continuity requirements.

**Job Family, Sub-Job Family & Area of Focus
  
  
Job Family:**
Information and Technology Solutions
  
  
**Sub-Job Family:**
Engineering
  
  
**Area of Focus:**
Infrastructure Engineering — with specialization in Endpoint Management, MDM, and Print Services.
  
  
Selection Criteria
  
  

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, with a minimum of 2 years of relevant experience; or equivalent combination of education and experience (e.g., Bachelor's Degree in IT with at least 1 year of related work experience).
* Demonstrated hands-on experience with Microsoft Intune managing iOS, Android, and macOS device fleets in an enterprise environment.
* Familiarity with enterprise print infrastructure administration and cloud print solutions is required.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Intune and endpoint operating systems (iOS, Android, macOS, and Windows), demonstrating strong expertise in device and platform management.
* Skilled in cloud computing, networking, and configuration management, enabling effective deployment, maintenance, and optimization of enterprise IT environments.
* Experienced in implementing and supporting security control frameworks and print infrastructure/cloud print services to ensure secure and reliable IT operations.
* Proficient in Agile methodologies (SAFe) and project support, contributing effectively to project planning, execution, and delivery.
* Strong analytical reasoning skills with the ability to assess issues, identify solutions, and support data-driven decision-making.
* Working knowledge of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and System Development Life Cycle (SDLC) concepts, with the ability to apply and support modern technology solutions.
* Demonstrates business competencies including sense of urgency, thoughtful risk-taking, empowerment, accountability, and the ability to influence stakeholders effectively.

**Recommended Certifications**

* Microsoft Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate (MD-102) or similar (preferred)
* Apple Certified Support Professional (ACSP) or equivalent macOS management credential (preferred)
* SAFe Practitioner (SP) (preferred)
* SAFe for Teams or higher SAFe certification (preferred)
* Cloud Network Engineering Certification (AWS / Azure / GCP / OCI) (advantageous)

title: CloudOps Engineer III
description:
PDI Technologies is looking for a Cloud Operations Engineer III to join our CloudOps team, supporting managed cloud infrastructure for our enterprise customers on AWS. This is a senior operational role for someone who can take ownership of complex, high-impact environments, work confidently and independently, and act as a clear communication point between customers, Professional Services, and the wider CloudOps team.

  
  

You'll combine hands-on technical delivery with strong stakeholder communication — leading incident response and change activity, running and contributing to governance and status meetings, and keeping the team informed and aligned. You'll be trusted to use your own judgement and initiative to drive issues to resolution, backed by the support and expertise of an experienced team.

**Job Responsibilities:**

  
* Manage and support enterprise customers' cloud infrastructure on AWS, ensuring availability, performance, and security of production environments
  
* Monitor and respond to alerts via observability tooling, triaging and resolving incidents in line with agreed SLAs and SLOs.
  
* Lead incident response and root cause analysis (RCA) for complex or high-severity issues, producing clear write-ups and remediation actions.
  
* Carry out change management activities — including deployments, security patching, and infrastructure updates following established change control and CR governance processes.
  
* Administer and optimise AWS database infrastructure (e.g. RDS), including performance tuning, troubleshooting, and exposure/risk remediation.
  
* Support compliance and audit activity (e.g. SOC audits), ensuring operational practices meet security and regulatory requirements.
  
* Identify and help deliver cloud cost optimisation opportunities.
  
* Maintain accurate tickets, documentation, and workaround registers, and help close down accumulated technical debt
  
  

**Communication & stakeholder management:**

  
* Communicate clearly and confidently with customers, Professional Services, and internal stakeholders, both verbally and in writing
  
* Plan, schedule, and run operational and governance meetings — setting clear agendas, driving decisions, and tracking follow-up actions to completion.
  
* Provide regular, well-structured status updates and reporting back to the wider CloudOps team, keeping colleagues informed of progress, risks, and changes.
  
* Represent CloudOps professionally in customer-facing forums, translating technical detail into clear, actionable communication for a range of audiences.
  
  

**Requirements :**

  
* Significant experience in a Cloud Operations, DevOps, or Site Reliability Engineering role, ideally within AWS environments
  
* Strong working knowledge of core AWS services (e.g. EC2, RDS) and cloud infrastructure operations
  
* Experience with monitoring/observability tooling, incident management, and change management processes.
  
* Understanding of security patching and compliance/audit processes (e.g. SOC 2).
  
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the confidence and credibility to lead meetings and communicate outcomes back to the team and to customers.
  
* Strong organisational skills and the proven ability to manage competing priorities under your own initiative.
  
* A collaborative team player who is equally comfortable working independently and knowing when to seek support from the team.
  
* Relevant AWS certification(s) desirable.
  
  

**Behavioral Competencies:**
  

  
* Cultivates Innovation
  
* Decision Quality
  
* Manages Complexity
  
* Drives Results
  
* Business Insight

  

PDI is committed to offering a well-rounded benefits program, designed to support and care for you, and your family throughout your life and career.  This includes a competitive salary, market-competitive benefits, and a quarterly perks program. We encourage a good work-life balance with ample time off [time away] and, where appropriate, hybrid working arrangements.  Employees have access to continuous learning, professional certifications, and leadership development opportunities. Our global culture fosters diversity, inclusion, and values authenticity, trust, curiosity, and diversity of thought, ensuring a supportive environment for all.

  

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

****Job Description****
The IT Application Support Analyst role is responsible for the end-to-end investigation and resolution of ERP incidents requiring deeper functional or technical expertise, including root-cause analysis, integration troubleshooting, solution validation, documentation, and effective escalation to Level 3 when required.
  
  
****Key Responsibilities/Areas Of Accountability****
**Incident investigation and resolution**

* Analyze ERP incidents escalated from Level 1.
* Identify root causes and provide functional or technical solutions/workarounds.
* Reproduce issues and distinguish between configuration, master data, integration, application, and infrastructure problems.

**Functional support**

* Provide expertise across assigned ERP modules and business processes.
* Troubleshoot transactional errors and incorrect system behavior.
* Assist users with complex process or application-related questions.

**Integration troubleshooting**

* Investigate failures between the ERP and connected applications.
* Analyze interfaces, error messages, batch jobs, queues, and data flows.
* Coordinate resolution with other application/support teams when the problem crosses system boundaries.

**Escalation to Level 3**

* Determine when an issue requires development, product expertise, infrastructure changes, or vendor intervention.
* Provide Level 3 with a complete analysis, including reproduction steps, logs, examples, expected versus actual results, and business impact.
* Validate the solution after Level 3 implementation.

**Problem management and root-cause analysis**

* Identify recurring incidents and underlying systemic problems.
* Lead or contribute to root-cause analysis.
* Recommend permanent corrective and preventive actions.

**Change and release support**

* Assess the impact of fixes, configuration changes, and ERP updates.
* Perform functional/system testing and coordinate business validation when appropriate.
* Support deployments and post-deployment verification.

**Monitoring and operational support**

* Monitor critical ERP processes, scheduled jobs, integrations, and interfaces.
* Investigate failures proactively where monitoring is available.
* Ensure critical business processes are restored within agreed service levels.

**Ticket and SLA management**

* Own assigned incidents through resolution rather than simply forwarding them.
* Prioritize according to severity and business impact.
* Maintain clear, accurate ticket documentation and regular communication with users.

**Knowledge management**

* Document solutions, known errors, troubleshooting procedures, and recurring issues.
* Create knowledge articles that enable Level 1 to resolve more incidents independently.
* Share knowledge with other ERP support team members.

**Business and IT coordination**

* Act as a bridge between business users and technical teams.
* Translate business symptoms into technical/functional requirements for specialists.
* Communicate technical findings in language understandable to business stakeholders.

****CRITICAL CAPABILITIES****

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* ERP Functional Expertise
* Strong understanding of core ERP processes and assigned functional areas (BaanIV, Infor LN, or Microsoft Dynamics AX 2012).
* Ability to understand how transactions flow across modules.
* Ability to distinguish process, configuration, master-data, and system issues.

**Advanced Troubleshooting & Root-Cause Analysis**

* Systematic investigation of complex incidents.
* Identify symptom vs. root cause.
* Analyze application errors, logs, jobs, interfaces, and transaction history.
* Develop and validate workarounds when immediate resolution is unavailable.

**Integration & End-to-End Process Understanding**

* Understand ERP interfaces with upstream and downstream applications.
* Trace transactions across systems.
* Determine where a failure occurred and which team/application owns it.
* Understand dependencies between ERP, middleware, databases, reporting, and external systems.

**Incident Ownership & Prioritization**

* Take ownership from escalation through resolution.
* Assess business impact, urgency, and priority.
* Drive resolution across multiple technical or functional teams.
* Maintain clear communication with impacted users and stakeholders.

**Technical Analysis**

* Ability to investigate application logs, batch processes, queues, interfaces, and error messages.
* Basic understanding of databases and data structures.
* Ability to perform data analysis and queries where appropriate.
* Understand enough of the ERP technical architecture to engage effectively with developers and infrastructure teams.

****Requirements****

* EDUCATION: Bachelor's Degree/College Diploma in a technical discipline (Engineering or IT related)
* EXPERIENCE: 3+ years of experience as an ERP application support or ERP analyst preferred.
* 3+ years of process improvement, data, or technology project experience would be a strong asset.
* 2+ years of experience working with BaanIV, Infor LN or Microsoft Dynamics AX 2012.

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a competitive compensation and benefits package and excellent opportunities for growth and advancement. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and respect, value and welcome diversity in our workplace. This role is responsible for managing and resolving integration-related issues across our warehouse and logistics platforms, ensuring customers receive clear, accurate, and timely updates.

Working closely with internal engineering teams and customers, you'll investigate failed integrations, identify root causes, perform system checks, and provide practical next steps. This is an excellent opportunity for someone with application support, service desk, or integration support experience who enjoys problem-solving, analysing data, and delivering excellent customer service.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Manage and prioritise the integrations support queue throughout UK business hours.
* Investigate failed messages, warehouse transactions, and integration errors to identify root causes.
* Review API responses, file transfers, and system error logs to determine appropriate actions.
* Verify whether shipment orders, advance shipping notices, item records, and other documents have been successfully processed within warehouse systems.
* Communicate findings clearly to customers, providing concise explanations and recommended next steps.
* Maintain accurate ticket records, documenting investigations, checks performed, actions taken, and closure reasons.
* Escalate recurring incidents, defects, and integration issues to the engineering team with supporting evidence.
* Liaise with internal stakeholders to follow up on outstanding actions, corrected files, and missing data.
* Ensure support tickets are resolved efficiently while maintaining a high standard of customer service.
* Identify trends and recurring issues that could improve overall integration stability and operational performance.

**What We're Looking For**

**Essential:**

* At least 2 years' experience in Application Support, Service Desk, Technical Support, or Integration Support roles.
* Ability to interpret system, API, and file processing errors and determine appropriate troubleshooting steps.
* Experience working with JSON files, spreadsheets, and ticket management systems.
* Strong written communication skills with the ability to produce clear, professional, customer-focused responses.
* Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities.
* Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and thrive in a live support environment.
* Comfortable supporting stakeholders and customers during UK business hours from Chennai.

**Desirable:**

* Experience within logistics, warehousing, supply chain, EDI, or transport environments.
* Familiarity with ITSM platforms such as Halo.
* Experience using Postman or similar tools to perform API investigations and checks.
* Basic SQL knowledge for data validation and record checking.
* Understanding of system integrations, data mapping, and file-based data exchanges.

**What You'll Bring:**

* A proactive and customer-focused approach.
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
* The ability to remain organised while managing a busy support queue.
* A collaborative mindset and willingness to share knowledge with colleagues.
* Professionalism, reliability, and a commitment to delivering excellent service.

If you're passionate about technology, enjoy solving complex problems, and want to play a key role in supporting business-critical integrations, we'd love to hear from you. Apply today and become part of a team that keeps our systems and customers connected.

title: DRM Administrator
description:
To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology.
   

  

**Group/Division**
 The KLA Services team consists of Service Sales, Marketing, Spares Supply Chain Management, Field Operations, Engineering, Product Training, Digital Solutions and Analytics, and Technical Product Support. Our services organization maximizes the value of our customers' KLA assets – with highly trained service and product support engineers providing installation services and 24/7 technical support and parts delivery through our extensive supply chain network.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
 In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high\-impact work across your area of expertise.
   

  

 KLA is seeking a highly motivated
 **Digital Rights Management (DRM) Administrator** 
 to manage and enhance the company's enterprise content protection ecosystem. This role is responsible for protecting KLA intellectual property, technical documentation, service procedures, AI\-generated content, and knowledge assets through the administration of digital rights management technologies, primarily Seclore DRM. Responsibilities are based on the operational scope of KLA's DRM program, including DRM administration, incident management, reporting, integrations, and project initiatives.
   

  

 This position combines enterprise application administration, cybersecurity, content governance, customer support, and systems integration, requiring close collaboration with IT, Security, Infrastructure, Product Divisions, and external vendors.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**DRM Platform Administration**
* Administer and maintain the Seclore DRM environment, including Policy Server, Federation Console, and supporting infrastructure.
* Configure and manage DRM policies, security controls, permissions, access rights, and content protection settings.
* Monitor platform health, system availability, performance, and operational compliance.
* Support software upgrades, patching, and environment enhancements.


**Access and Security Governance**
* Manage user provisioning, permissions, content sharing rights, and reviewer access workflows.
* Register customers, fabs, authorized users, and access groups within DRM environments.
* Enforce content access controls, watermarking, copy restrictions, and printing restrictions.
* Support secure external collaboration while maintaining IP protection standards


**Incident \& Operational Support**
* Serve as the primary point of contact for DRM\-related incidents, service requests, and escalations.
* Investigate and resolve user, system, authentication, policy, and access issues.
* Coordinate with IT Infrastructure, Security, Networking, Windows, Linux, and Application teams to resolve operational problems.
* Drive root\-cause analysis and implement preventive actions.


**Reporting \& Compliance**
* Generate weekly and monthly DRM operational reports.
* Produce DRM usage analytics and document activity reports
* Monitor unusual activity and security incidents and coordinate investigation efforts.
* Maintain audit readiness and support compliance requirements.


**Enterprise Integrations**
* Support enterprise DRM integrations across: SharePoint Online, Microsoft Teams, OneDrive, Customer Portal, and Document Servers.


**Documentation \& Training**
* Create and maintain operational procedures, installation guides, support documentation, and runbooks
* Conduct administrator and end\-user training sessions.


 Lead knowledge transfer activities and maintain operational continuity plans.
   

  

**Minimum Qualifications**
**Preferred Qualifications**
**Education**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Security, Engineering, or related discipline.


**Experience**
* 7\-10 years of experience supporting enterprise applications, content management systems, security platforms, or information governance technologies.
* Experience administering access control, content protection, or identity management systems.


**Technical Skills**
* Digital Rights Management (DRM) platforms
* Seclore administration (highly desirable)
* Microsoft 365 ecosystem
* SharePoint Online and Teams administration
* Entra ID / Active Directory
* Windows and Linux server environments
* REST APIs and application integrations
* Security operations and compliance management
* ITIL\-based incident and problem management


**Desired Attributes**
* Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management
* Ability to work across global teams
* Customer\-focused mindset
* Strong documentation and process discipline
* Passion for protecting intellectual property and sensitive information


**About KLA**
 We provide advanced inspection tools, metrology systems, process solutions, and computational analytics that make electronics possible, tackling complex challenges. From electron and photon optics to machine learning and data analytics, we seek perfection at the most fundamental level of matter in the universe. If you want to make electronics that push industries forward and make the world a better place, join us.

description:
Role Summary
   

  

 The internship role is intended to support the Smart Document System (SDS) project, which focuses on migrating paper\-based logbooks and forms into a controlled digital platform. * Ability to work with cross\-functional teams and follow defined instructions.

title: Procurement Specialist
description:
**Position** 




**Procurement SME** 




  





**About JiBe** 




 JiBe is the leading cloud based fully integrated ERP system for the shipping industry. Our goal is to allow shipping companies to improve productivity, efficiency and safety levels, while reducing costs. JiBe ERP enables increased automation and streamlining of processes, creating pre\-defined workflows and reducing the usage of email and paper
 



 We are looking for candidates who can be the ambassador of the procurement module of JiBe to all its clients.
 



 The Senior Procurement SME leverages their in\-depth knowledge of procurement processes and ERP systems to drive the successful implementation, optimization, and support of Procurement and procurement related modules. The focus is on ensuring a successful implementation of JiBe and enabling client organizations to streamline procurement workflows, achieve cost savings, and improve overall supply chain management through technology\-driven innovations using the JiBe ecosystem.
 



  





**Job responsibilities** 



* Ensure the successful implementation of the JiBe procurement, Logistics, Inventory, Contracts and Supplier Registry module by providing the best possible training and management of change processes.
* Create and manage comprehensive training materials, including user manuals, guides, video tutorials to support the education and onboarding of clients in using procurement modules.
* Maintain up\-to\-date documentation of system configurations, procurement workflows, and processes.
* Ensure that all the process changes, enhancements and configurations are fully documented for future reference.
* Analyze and document clients’ existing procurement process, identifying gaps \& opportunities for improvement and aligning them with the system capabilities.
* Provide comprehensive training to end users on procurement functionalities within the system, ensuring smooth adoption and operation of the system.
* Guide and support the implementation team to configure, customize the procurement module to meet specific client requirements
* Provide ongoing support to the clients’ posts implementation, troubleshooting any procurement related issues and offering system updates or process improvements when necessary.
* Guide and mentor other Procurement SMEs, providing them with the necessary support, feedback, and training to enhance their knowledge and review their work, ensuring that the deliverables meet the quality standards and align with the overall scope and client expectations.
* Work with product owners and managers in ensuring user stories are delivering the intended user, product and business requirements.



  





**Qualifications and Skills** 



* Strong communication skills, verbal and oral and fluent in English.
* Bachelor’s degree in supply chain management, Procurement, or related fields or an equivalent knowledge through work experience.
* Proven experience with Marine ERP Systems or other supply chain platforms such as SAP, Oracle.
* Minimum 5 years of experience in Marine Procurement or supply chain management, preferably within a Shipping company.
* Ability to create user friendly training materials, including manuals, and conduct workshops.
* Strong Presentation and facilitation skills to conduct training sessions for clients and internal teams.
* Ability to map business processes to ERP System functionalities.
* Ability to analyze business processes and provide solutions to optimize procurement workflows.
* Skilled with change management principles to ensure smooth transitions during implementation, including handling resistance and facilitating user training and adoption.
* You can apply agile analysis techniques in transforming business requirements into technical specifications.



  





**Additional Qualifications** 



* Certification in project management (e.g. PMP, Prince2\) is a plus but not mandatory.
* Team player with good interpersonal and communication skills
* Strong data analysis skills for reviewing procurement data and ensuring accuracy of ERP.
* Experience in Accounting and invoices processes is advantageous.
* Excellent delegation and coaching skills to manage team workload and ensure high quality outputs.
* Ability to engage stakeholders and manage team dynamics during transition and process changes.

description:
Who We Are
   

  

 Vultr is on a mission to make high\-performance cloud infrastructure easy to use, affordable, and locally accessible for enterprises and AI innovators around the world. With 33 global cloud data center locations, Vultr is trusted by hundreds of thousands of active customers across 185 countries for its flexible, scalable, global Cloud Compute, Cloud GPU, Bare Metal, and Cloud Storage solutions. In December 2024 Vultr announced an equity financing at a $3\.5 billion valuation. Founded by David Aninowsky and self\-funded for over a decade, Vultr has grown to become the world’s largest privately\-held cloud infrastructure company.
   

  

**Vultr Cares**
* Medical Insurance stipend paid annually
* 9 Company\-Paid Holidays
* Generous Leave Policy \+ 1 month paid sabbatical every 5 years \+ Anniversary Bonus each year
* Professional Development Reimbursement
* Internet reimbursement
* Fitness membership reimbursement
* Company paid Wellable subscription


**Join Vultr**
 Vultr is expanding its India presence and is building its first
 **Global Integrated Operations Command Center (GIOC) in Chennai** 
 — the 24x7 nerve center for monitoring, triage, and first response across Vultr’s global
 **cloud, systems, network, and security operations.**
 We are seeking
 **Senior Systems Engineers** 
 to serve as the first line of response for Vultr’s systems estate —
 **compute, storage, operating systems, and virtualization.** 
 This is a frontline operations role for engineers who thrive in a fast\-paced, alert\-driven environment and want to grow into deeper SRE, systems, and platform engineering careers. You must be comfortable working a rotational shift model — including nights, weekends, and holidays — to sustain follow\-the\-sun coverage.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 The
 **Senior Systems Engineer** 
 is the entry point of the GIOC incident lifecycle. You monitor health signals across Vultr’s systems estate, acknowledge and triage alerts within
 **defined first\-response SLAs,** 
 execute documented runbooks to resolve common issues, and escalate cleanly to Senior Engineers when an issue falls outside L2 scope. The role ensures
 **fast, accurate first response** 
 that protects customer experience and keeps incidents moving toward resolution.
   

  

 You operate from a consolidated
 **single\-pane\-of\-glass dashboard,** 
 classifying and routing incidents by severity and tower while owning accurate, complete documentation of every action. Success is measured by
 **first\-response SLA adherence, triage accuracy, and runbook resolution rate.** 
 The role runs on a
 **rotational schedule** 
 to sustain 24x7 coverage.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Alert Monitoring \& First Response**
* Monitor systems\-estate health signals (compute, storage, OS, virtualization) from a consolidated single\-pane\-of\-glass dashboard
* Acknowledge alerts and incidents within first\-response SLA targets
* Perform initial review — read the alert, check recent changes, and review the CMDB before acting


**Triage \& Severity Classification**
* Classify each incident by severity and customer impact, confirming the owning tower (Systems / Network / Security / cross\-tower)
* Route and assign tickets accurately to the correct tower or escalation path
* Sustain triage accuracy at or above the GIOC go\-live standard
* Reassess severity as impact evolves, and declare higher when in doubt


**Runbook\-Driven Resolution**
* Match alert signatures to documented runbooks and execute permitted L2 actions
* Resolve common, well\-understood systems issues end to end within L2 scope
* Document every step taken, with supporting evidence, in the incident ticket


**Escalation \& Handoff**
* Escalate unresolved or out\-of\-scope issues to L2/L3 with a clean, complete handoff (symptom
* evidence collected
* steps tried
* current state)
* Flag missing or ineffective runbooks as runbook gaps for review and continuous improvement
* Initiate and support major\-incident (Sev\-0 / Sev\-1\) bridges per the escalation matrix
* Track escalations to closure and confirm service is restored before resolving the ticket


**Operational Documentation \& Communication**
* Maintain accurate shift logs, ticket updates, and incident timelines
* Provide clear, timely status communication to stakeholders and customers per severity
* Produce thorough shift\-handover notes for seamless continuity


**Continuous Improvement**
* Identify recurring alerts and noise as candidates for tuning and automation
* Contribute to and improve runbooks and knowledge\-base articles
* Participate in post\-incident reviews (PIR) and trend reviews


**Qualifications \& Experience**
* Graduate/Engineer in a relevant field (B.E./B.Tech, or equivalent)
* 5\-8 years of experience in systems administration, NOC/SOC, or IT operations, including hands\-on Linux and/or Windows server administration
* Working knowledge of operating systems — processes, services, and log analysis (Linux and/or Windows)
* Familiarity with compute, storage, and virtualization concepts — VMs, hypervisors, and basic networking
* Understanding of incident\-management fundamentals and severity\-based triage
* Exposure to monitoring/observability tools and ticketing systems (alerting consoles, ITSM)
* Strong written communication for accurate documentation and clean escalation handoffs; willingness and ability to work a rotational 24x7 shift model, including nights, weekends, and holidays
* Proficient in English verbal and written communication


**Preferred Qualifications**
* ITIL V4 Foundation certification or equivalent ITSM knowledge
* Linux certification (RHCSA / LFCS) or a cloud\-fundamentals certification
* Scripting familiarity (Bash, Python, or PowerShell) for routine automation
* Exposure to cloud platforms and GPU / high\-density infrastructure
* Prior experience in a 24x7 NOC, SOC, or command\-center environment, and tools such as JIRA, Confluence, PagerDuty, and observability platforms


**Inclusion \& Privacy**
 We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and experiences, and we prohibit discrimination based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected status under applicable laws. Vultr will consider qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records in accordance with applicable laws and will not conduct a background check until after an offer of employment has been extended and accepted.
   

  

 We also take your privacy seriously. We handle personal information responsibly and follow applicable laws, including U.S. privacy rules and India’s Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023\. Your data is used only for legitimate business purposes and is protected with proper security measures.

title: ThreatLocker Specialist
description:
09 \- Senior Specialist, Information Security
   

  

 Req ID: 137491
   

  

 Remote Position: Hybrid
   

  

 Hiring Manager: Paul Stanners
   

  

 Band: 09
   

  

 Region: Asia
   

  

 Country: India
   

  

 State/Province: Chennai
   

  

 City: Guindy, Chennai
   

  

**Summary**
 This role is critical for ensuring endpoint application control remains secure and usable for engineering teams, particularly by acting as a dedicated support function during the stabilization phase of a "Default\-Deny" rollout.
   

  

 In this role, you will be responsible for designing, implementing, auditing, and maintaining ThreatLocker policies across our organization (and/or client environments). You will play a critical role in preventing ransomware, malware, and unauthorized software execution by managing Application Whitelisting (Allowlisting), Ringfencing, Storage Control, and Elevation Control.
   

  

 The ideal candidate has a strong background in system administration or cybersecurity, possess a deep understanding of Windows operating systems, and is passionate about achieving a true Zero Trust security posture.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 ThreatLocker Administration \& Management
   

  

* Policy Creation \& Tuning: Design, implement, and maintain ThreatLocker Application Allowlisting policies to ensure only authorized software can execute.
* Ringfencing: Configure and manage Ringfencing policies to restrict what authorized applications can do (e.g., stopping PowerShell from talking to the internet or blocking Word from launching cmd.exe).
* Elevation Control: Implement and manage least\-privilege access, creating rules for users to run specific applications as administrators without granting full local admin rights.
* Storage Control: Define and enforce policies for securing USB drives, network shares, and local files against unauthorized access or data exfiltration.
* Manage allowlisting, Learning Mode, and temporary exceptions.


 Monitoring, Auditing \& Incident Response
   

  

* Approval Queue Management: Monitor and process daily ThreatLocker approval requests from users efficiently, balancing security with operational productivity.
* Learning Mode Audits: Review, analyze, and baseline new endpoints during the "Learning Mode" phase to ensure seamless transitions to "Secured Mode."
* Log Analysis \& Reporting: Investigate blocked files, denied executions, and policy violations. Use ThreatLocker audit logs to identify potential security incidents or shadow IT.
* Integration: Collaborate with the SOC/SIEM team to forward ThreatLocker logs and integrate them into the broader security monitoring ecosystem.
* Triage blocked applications, scripts, DLLs, and installers.
* Track service metrics to ensure business productivity.


 Maintenance \& Strategy
   

  

* Environment Maintenance: Keep ThreatLocker agents updated across all endpoints and servers.
* Testing \& Validation: Test software updates and patch deployments in a sandbox environment to ensure they comply with existing ThreatLocker rules before company\-wide rollout.
* Documentation: Maintain clear, up\-to\-date documentation of standard operating procedures (SOPs), policy exceptions, and approval workflows.
* Maintain Ringfencing and policy standards.


**Required Experience**
* ThreatLocker Expertise: Minimum of 3 years of hands\-on experience specifically managing, configuring, and troubleshooting ThreatLocker in a production environment.
* IT/Cybersecurity Background: 3\+ years of experience in System Administration, Helpdesk Tier 3, Network Engineering, or a Cybersecurity operations role.
* OS Proficiency: Deep, foundational knowledge of Windows OS (Registry, File Systems, Services, Active Directory, and Group Policy). Experience with macOS or Linux is a strong plus.
* Scripting: Basic familiarity with PowerShell or Command Prompt for troubleshooting and automation.


 Knowledge/Skills/Competencies
   

  

 Soft Skills
   

  

* Analytical Thinking: Ability to dissect complex application dependencies (e.g., figuring out why a niche accounting software was blocked by a specific DLL file).
* Customer\-Centric Communication: Ability to explain security restrictions to non\-technical staff diplomatically and find ways to enable business operations safely.
* Attention to Detail: Zero Trust requires precision; a misplaced rule can either cause a security gap or halt business operations.


**Preferred Certifications (A Plus, Not Required)**
* ThreatLocker Professional or ThreatLocker Expert certifications.
* CompTIA Security\+, CySA\+, or Network\+.
* Microsoft Certified: Windows Server or Azure Administrator.


 Physical Demands
   

  

* Duties are primarily performed in an office environment but may require occasional on\-call availability and emergency response.
* Extended periods of sitting, as well as visual concentration on security dashboards, logs, and reports.


 Notes
   

  

 This job description is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties and responsibilities of the position. Employees are held accountable for all duties of the job. Job duties and the % of time identified for any function are subject to change at any time.
   

  

 Celestica is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against on any protected status (including race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran or disability status or other characteristics protected by law).

* Apply strong

description:
Who We Are
   

  

 Vultr is on a mission to make high\-performance cloud infrastructure easy to use, affordable, and locally accessible for enterprises and AI innovators around the world. With 33 global cloud data center locations, Vultr is trusted by hundreds of thousands of active customers across 185 countries for its flexible, scalable, global Cloud Compute, Cloud GPU, Bare Metal, and Cloud Storage solutions. In December 2024 Vultr announced an equity financing at a $3\.5 billion valuation. Founded by David Aninowsky and self\-funded for over a decade, Vultr has grown to become the world’s largest privately\-held cloud infrastructure company.
   

  

**Vultr Cares**
* Medical Insurance stipend paid annually
* 9 Company\-Paid Holidays
* Generous Leave Policy \+ 1 month paid sabbatical every 5 years \+ Anniversary Bonus each year
* Professional Development Reimbursement
* Internet reimbursement
* Fitness membership reimbursement
* Company paid Wellable subscription


**Join Vultr**
 Vultr is expanding its India presence and is building its first
 **Global Integrated Operations Command Center (GIOC) in Chennai** 
 — the 24x7 nerve center for monitoring, triage, and first response across Vultr’s global
 **cloud, systems, network, and security operations.**
 We are seeking
 **Systems Engineers** 
 to serve as the first line of response for Vultr’s systems estate —
 **compute, storage, operating systems, and virtualization.** 
 This is a frontline operations role for engineers who thrive in a fast\-paced, alert\-driven environment and want to grow into deeper SRE, systems, and platform engineering careers. You must be comfortable working on a rotational shift model (24x7\) — including nights, weekends, and holidays, to ensure we have full coverage.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 The
 **Systems Engineer** 
 is the entry point of the GIOC incident lifecycle. You monitor health signals across Vultr’s systems estate, acknowledge and triage alerts within
 **defined first\-response SLAs,** 
 execute documented runbooks to resolve common issues, and escalate cleanly to Senior Systems Engineer when an issue falls outside L1 scope. The role ensures
 **fast, accurate first response** 
 that protects customer experience and keeps incidents moving toward resolution.
   

  

 You operate from a
 **consolidated single\-pane\-of\-glass dashboard** 
 , classifying and routing incidents by severity and tower while owning accurate, complete documentation of every action. Success is measured by
 **first\-response SLA adherence, triage accuracy, and runbook resolution rate.** 
 The role runs on a
 **rotational schedule** 
 to sustain 24x7 coverage.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Alert Monitoring \& First Response**
* Monitor systems\-estate health signals (compute, storage, OS, virtualization) from a consolidated single\-pane\-of\-glass dashboard
* Acknowledge alerts and incidents within first\-response SLA targets
* Perform initial review — read the alert, check recent changes, and review the CMDB before acting


**Triage \& Severity Classification**
* Classify each incident by severity and customer impact, confirming the owning tower (Systems / Network / Security / cross\-tower)
* Route and assign tickets accurately to the correct tower or escalation path
* Sustain triage accuracy at or above the GIOC go\-live standard
* Reassess severity as impact evolves, and declare higher when in doubt


**Runbook\-Driven Resolution**
* Match alert signatures to documented runbooks and execute permitted L1 actions
* Resolve common, well\-understood systems issues end to end within L1 scope
* Document every step taken, with supporting evidence, in the incident ticket


**Escalation \& Handoff**
* Escalate unresolved or out\-of\-scope issues to Senior Engineers with a clean, complete handoff (symptom
* evidence collected
* steps tried
* current state)
* Flag missing or ineffective runbooks as runbook gaps for review and continuous improvement
* Initiate and support major\-incident (Sev\-0 / Sev\-1\) bridges per the escalation matrix
* Track escalations to closure and confirm service is restored before resolving the ticket


**Operational Documentation \& Communication**
* Maintain accurate shift logs, ticket updates, and incident timelines
* Provide clear, timely status communication to stakeholders and customers per severity
* Produce thorough shift\-handover notes for seamless continuity


**Continuous Improvement**
* Identify recurring alerts and noise as candidates for tuning and automation
* Contribute to and improve runbooks and knowledge\-base articles
* Participate in post\-incident reviews (PIR) and trend reviews


**Qualifications \& Experience**
* Graduate/Engineer in a relevant field (B.E./B.Tech, or equivalent)
* 3–5 years of experience in systems administration, preferably in NOC/SOC, or IT operations
* Good understanding of Linux/Windows
* Working knowledge of operating systems — processes, services, and log analysis (Linux/Windows)
* Familiarity with compute, storage, and virtualization concepts — VMs, Hypervisors, and basic networking
* Understanding of incident\-management fundamentals and severity\-based triage
* Exposure to monitoring/observability tools and ticketing systems (alerting consoles, ITSM)
* Strong written communication for accurate documentation and clean escalation handoffs; willingness and ability to work a rotational 24x7 shift model, including nights, weekends, and holidays
* Proficient in English verbal and written communication


**Preferred Qualifications**
* ITIL V4 Foundation certification or equivalent ITSM knowledge
* Linux certification (RHCSA / LFCS) or a cloud\-fundamentals certification
* Scripting familiarity (Bash, Python, or PowerShell) for routine automation
* Exposure to cloud platforms and GPU / high\-density infrastructure
* Prior working experience in a 24x7 NOC, SOC or Command\-Center environment
* Experience in using tools such as JIRA, Confluence, PagerDuty, and observability platforms


**Inclusion \& Privacy**
 We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and experiences, and we prohibit discrimination based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected status under applicable laws. Vultr will consider qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records in accordance with applicable laws and will not conduct a background check until after an offer of employment has been extended and accepted.
   

  

 We also take your privacy seriously. We handle personal information responsibly and follow applicable laws, including U.S. privacy rules and India’s Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023\. Your data is used only for legitimate business purposes and is protected with proper security measures.
   

  

 Where allowed by law, applicants may request details about the data we collect, access or delete their information, withdraw consent for its use, and opt out of nonessential communications. For more details, please see our Privacy Policy.

title: Junior Engineer - EUC & IT Procurement
description:
Junior Engineer \- EUC \& IT Procurement
 



  





 Gradiant India Private Limited Chennai, India
 



  





 Gradiant is a Different Kind of Water Company. With a full suite of differentiated and proprietary end\-to\-end solutions for advanced water and wastewater treatment powered by the top minds in water, the company serves its clients’ mission\-critical operations in the world’s essential industries, including semiconductors, pharmaceuticals, food \& beverage, lithium and critical minerals, and renewable energy. Gradiant’s innovative solutions reduce water used and wastewater discharged, reclaim valuable resources, and renew wastewater into freshwater. The Boston\-headquartered company was founded at MIT and has over 1,400 employees worldwide.
 



 Discover us at www.gradiant.com.
 



  





**Job Overview** 




 The L1 IT Infrastructure Administrator \& IT Procurement Specialist is responsible for providing first\-level IT infrastructure support and managing end\-user computing services, while playing a key role in IT procurement activities. A significant focus of this role is engaging with internal business stakeholders to understand their technology requirements, identifying and evaluating suitable vendors and solutions, coordinating procurement activities, and ensuring partner deliverables are tracked and fulfilled on time. Contract negotiation and partner finalization are handled by a dedicated Procurement team; this role focuses on the upstream requirements and solution\-alignment work as well as downstream delivery follow\-up.
 



  





**Responsibilities**

* Track IT contracts, software subscriptions, and warranties; proactively manage renewals.
* Maintain accurate IT asset inventory including hardware, software licenses, and accessories.

* Support vendor onboarding documentation and maintain updated supplier records.
* Assist in budgeting, cost tracking, and identifying IT cost optimization opportunities.
* Ensure all procurement activities adhere to company policies, approval workflows, and audit standards.



**IT Infrastructure Support (L1\)**

* Support Microsoft 365 services such as Outlook, Teams, OneDrive, SharePoint, and Office applications.
* Manage user accounts in: Active Directory, Azure AD / Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft 365
* Handle device onboarding, offboarding, and lifecycle management.
* Troubleshoot hardware, software, network, VPN, and connectivity issues.
* Assist in deployment and management of Microsoft Intune\-managed devices.
* Support endpoint security tools including: Antivirus, BitLocker, Conditional Access policies
* Monitor IT alerts and escalate issues to higher support levels when needed.
* Maintain IT documentation, SOPs, and knowledge base articles.
* Support office infrastructure including switches, Wi\-Fi access points, conference room systems, and ISP connectivity.
* Coordinate with vendors for hardware repairs, warranty claims, and service requests.



  





**Requirements** 




 Diploma or Bachelor’s Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration, or a related field.
 



**Procurement \& Vendor Management Skills :** 
 Business Requirements Gathering \& Stakeholder Engagement, Vendor Research, Identification \& Shortlisting, Solution Evaluation \& Fit Assessment, Quotation Evaluation \& Vendor Comparison Reporting, Purchase Requisition (PR) \& Purchase Order (PO) Process, Partner Delivery Tracking \& Follow\-Up, Contract and Renewal Tracking, Inventory \& Asset Management, Cost Analysis and Spend Optimization.
 



**Technical Skills :** 
 Windows 10/11 Administration, Microsoft 365 Administration, Active Directory \& Azure AD, Microsoft Intune (basic administration), Networking Fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPN, Wi\-Fi), Hardware troubleshooting and deployment, IT Service Management (ITIL Foundation preferred)
 



**Experience :** 
 2–5 years of experience in IT Infrastructure Support with minimum 2 years in supporting IT Procurement
 



**Certificate :** 
 ITIL Foundation certification is an advantage.
